SELECT DISTINCT
  main.service_line1_short,
  main.sa_type_code,
  main.job_ini_value_v3,
  main.contract_value_v3,
  main.effective_date,
  main.ProductCode,
  matcher.string_field_3 AS sa_type_description
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.vw_tdw_stage2_Contract_V2_HY` AS main
LEFT JOIN 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.bundlemapping` AS matcher
ON 
  main.sa_type_code = matcher.string_field_0
WHERE 
  DATE(main.effective_date) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR)
   AND NOT (
    main.job_ini_value_v3 = 0 AND 
    main.contract_value_v3 = 0
  )

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS RowID,
  *
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialWorkOrderDate.vw_unf_WorkOrder_MappedWithCustomer`

SELECT DISTINCT
  Contract,
  CASE
    WHEN Contract = '20903191' THEN 'CBRE MICROSOFT COMBINED'
    WHEN Contract = '20967204' THEN 'CBRE MICROSOFT COMBINED'
    WHEN Contract = '20931119' THEN 'SHOE CARNIVAL'
    WHEN Contract = '20955233' THEN 'AUNTIE ANNES'
    WHEN Contract = '20955175' THEN 'DISH NETWORK'
    WHEN Contract = '20954129' THEN 'BEACON ROOFING'
    ELSE customer_name
  END AS customer_name
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialWorkOrderDate.Joined_Iris_Mission_PP_Customers`

SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.customer_name AS customer_name,
    TRIM(CAST(i.ID_1 AS STRING)) AS Contract
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_unf_WorkOrder` w
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialArchive.vw_iris_IDsAndNames` i
    ON TRIM(CAST(w.Contract AS STRING)) = TRIM(CAST(i.ID_1 AS STRING))

  UNION DISTINCT

  SELECT DISTINCT
    customer_name,
    TRIM(CAST(Contract AS STRING)) AS Contract
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialWorkOrderDate.MappingOfCustomersV1`
)
WHERE Contract != '0'
  AND customer_name IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_name != '0'

SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.customer_name AS customer_name,
    TRIM(CAST(i.ID_3 AS STRING)) AS Contract
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_unf_WorkOrder` w
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialArchive.vw_iris_IDsAndNames` i
    ON TRIM(CAST(w.Contract AS STRING)) = TRIM(CAST(i.ID_3 AS STRING))

  UNION DISTINCT

  SELECT DISTINCT
    customer_name,
    TRIM(CAST(Contract AS STRING)) AS Contract
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialWorkOrderDate.MappingOfCustomersV1`
)
WHERE Contract != '0'
  AND customer_name IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_name != '0'

SELECT DISTINCT customer_name, contract
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.CommercialWorkOrderDate.vw_unf_ContractWithInactive`
WHERE CustomerType IN ('COM','NAT')
AND Contract IS NOT NULL
AND customer_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    'TDW'                       AS Source,
  a.sales_agreement_number      AS Contract,
  a.market_type                   AS MarketType,
  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product)  AS ServiceType,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.Mapped_Service)) AS ProductCode,
  item_code,
  sa_type_code,
  service_line1_long            AS ProductGroup,
  MAX(accounting_date)          AS SellDate,
  MAX(effective_date)           AS StartDate, --MAX(original_effective_date) StartDate - Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(a.cancel_date)            AS CancelDate,
  MAX(a.inactive_date)          AS InactiveDate,
  --MAX(next_scheduled_date)      AS next_scheduled_date,
  MAX(NS.scheduled_date)        AS next_scheduled_date,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedBranch,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  division_code_assigned,
  region_code_assigned,
  postal_code                   AS Geography,
  state_code                    AS State,
  employee_id                   AS SalesPersonID,
  SalesPerson                   AS SalesPerson,
  job_code_description          AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  NULL                          AS SalesRole,
  employee_jde_number           AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  customer_name,
  customer_phone,
  a.customer_email,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)          AS ContractValue,   --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS InitialValue,    --Added 01/30/2024
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM')) AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(rawsale_amt) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    ELSE  SUM(excess_initial_value_cv)
  END AS ExcessInitialValue,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)                           AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)   AS TotalJobValue, -- Initial value + JobNonRecurringValue
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(annual_value_cv) + (SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)) + SUM(spc_value_cv) 
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
  END AS TotalValue,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS JobINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
  SUM(spc_value_cv)             AS JobNonINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
--  CASE
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)) -- For TC INI Value has the first year value -- 02/06/2025
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
--    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
--    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
--  END AS TotalValue_v2, --Added 02/06/2025
  (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv) + SUM(annual_value_cv)) AS TotalValue_V2,
  SUM(base_qty)                 AS BaseQty,
  SUM(raw_qty)                  AS raw_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS ContractCount,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonRecurringCount,  --SPC counts -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  0   AS ExcessInitialCount, -- For tmx count is part of ContractCount -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
    END AS JobRecurringCount, -- InitialCount -- -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  (
  CASE
    WHEN (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) <> 'C') OR (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  ) AS TotalJobCount, --Total job counts  
  1 AS TotalCount, -- To be removed 02/06/2025
 
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobINICount, -- InitialCount Added 02/06/2025 - New count column for INI, to be used AS a seperate Dashboard and not part of TotalCount_v2, AS it is counted with Contract count.
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonINICount, -- Added 02/06/2025 - Non INI SPC counts are only counted in TotalCount_v2,
  (
  -- Added 02/06/2025 - Contract Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract so the 1 is represents the contract not the INI 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  )
  +
  (
-- Added 02/06/2025 - Jobs(Non-INI): One-time or Special Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract. 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  ) AS TotalCount_v2,
  --(ContractCount + JobNonINICount)  -- Changed 02/06/2025 based on new logic considering INI count part of contract
  --Maybe consider TotalCount_v2 as just 1 or in the next stage do ContractCount+JobNonINICount for a more streamlined and business look
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(effective_date) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE  'N'
  END AS StartedYN, -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(a.cancel_reason_code) AS cancel_reason_code,
  MAX(indTAP_YN) AS indTAP_YN,
  MAX(TAPType) AS TAPType,
  MAX(lead_employee_id) AS lead_employee_id,
  -- Calculated fields
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN effective_date IS NULL
        THEN annual_value_cv -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
      ELSE
        starts_value
    END
     ) AS ContractValue_cv,
  SUM(recurring_value)        AS RecurringValue_cv,
  SUM(raw_value)              AS RawValue_cv,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)       AS InitialValue_cv,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)           AS SpcValue_cv,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)        AS AnnualValue_cv,
  SUM(discount_amt)           AS discount_amt_cv,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN  (service_type_code <> 'RNL') THEN rawsale_amt
      ELSE  0
    END
    ) AS rawsale_amt_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN  employee_primary_designation_code = 'SUMMSLS' THEN 'HAWX - Summer Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS SummerSalesIND,
  TMXR.Status AS RenewalStatus,

  -- Mission new values for values - Steven McCaffrey 3/22/2025
  SUM(contract_value_v3) as contract_value_v3,
  SUM(job_nonrecurring_value_v3) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_value_v3) AS job_ini_value_v3,
  SUM(job_recurring_count_v3) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_count_v3) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  SUM(contract_count_v3) AS contract_count_v3


FROM      bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_tdw_stage2_Contract_V2          AS a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Product_Mission_PestPac_Service_Map`   AS p    ON TRIM(a.sa_type_code) = TRIM(p.Template)
                                                                                               AND TRIM(a.item_code) = TRIM(p.Item)
LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tmx_termite_renewals    AS TMXR ON a.sales_agreement_number = TMXR.SalesAgreement_Number 
LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S3.WO_NextScheduled_Date NS ON a.sales_agreement_number = NS.sales_agreement_number


GROUP BY
  a.market_type,
  buncod_assigned,
  division_code_assigned,
  region_code_assigned,
  postal_code,
  state_code,
  employee_id,
  SalesPerson,
  job_code_description,
  employee_jde_number,
  a.sales_agreement_number,
  p.Mapped_Service,
  sa_type_code,
  item_code,
  service_line1_long,
  employee_primary_designation_code,
  customer_name,
  customer_phone,
  customer_email,
  TMXR.Status

SELECT
    source                  AS Source,
    SalesCategory,
    locationID,  
    locationCode,
    BillToID,
    BillToCode,
    setupID                 AS Contract,
    SetupInvoiceOrderNum    AS salesID,
    setupID,
    orderNum,
    invoiceNum,
    division,  
  CASE
    WHEN division IN ('C', 'DC', 'SCH') THEN 'COM' --DC is DayCare AND SCH is School. Added under Commercial or COM. Added by Steven McCaffrey by 11/5/2024
    WHEN division = 'R' THEN 'RES'
    WHEN division IN ('NATION', 'NATIONAL' ) THEN 'NAT'
    ELSE 'UNIDENTIFIED'
  END AS MarketType,  --RES COM NAT
  contract_Job_or_Product  AS ServiceType,
  UPPER(TRIM(serviceCode)) AS ProductCode,
  productGroup             AS ProductGroup,
  serviceDesc,
  SellDate, --- ActgDate  
  CASE
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' AND sTbl = 'SS' THEN IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(StartDate AS DATE))
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product IN ('P' ,'J','I','C') AND sTbl = 'IN' AND `type` <> 'NS' THEN startDate
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(NULL AS DATE)
  END                      AS StartDate, --- Logic: For maintanence contracts, only if INI is linked it is started  ELSE not started
  cancelDate               AS CancelDate,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS InactiveDate,
  MarketCode               AS MarketCode,
  RegionCode               AS RegionCode,
(case when length(branchID) = 4 then lpad(CAST(branchID AS string), 4,'0') else lpad(CAST(branchID AS string), 3,'0') end) as AssignedBranch,
(case when length(ServiceBranchID) = 4 then lpad(CAST(ServiceBranchID AS string), 4,'0') else lpad(CAST(ServiceBranchID AS string), 3,'0') end) as AssignedServiceBranch,
  postalCode               AS Geography,
  a.state                    AS State,
  employee_ID              AS SalesPersonID,
  salesPerson              AS SalesPerson,
  employeeJobTitle         AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  jr.SalesRole             AS SalesRole,
  employeeNum              AS SalesEmployeeNumberPP,
  rtxEmp.Employee_Number   AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  customer_name,
  customer_phone,
  a.customer_email,
  ContractValue,        -- Added 01/30/2024
  ContractValue_calc, 
  InitialValue,         -- Added 01/30/2024
  ExcessInitialValue ,  -- Added 01/30/2024
  JobNonRecurringValue, -- Added 01/30/2024
  JobINIValue,          -- Added 02/06/2025
  JobNonINIValue,       -- Added 02/06/2025
  (InitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)                             AS TotalJobValue,
  (ContractValue + ExcessInitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)       AS TotalValue,
  (ContractValue_calc + ExcessInitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)  AS TotalValue_calc,   --Added 01/30/2024    
  (JobINIValue + JobNonINIValue)                                    AS TotalJobValue_v2,  -- Added 02/06/2025
  (ContractValue + JobINIValue + JobNonINIValue )                   AS TotalValue_v2,     -- Added 02/06/2025
  ContractCount,  
 
    ExcessInitialCount,   -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
    JobNonRecurringCount, -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
    JobRecurringCount,    -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
   
  TotalJobCount,          -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
  JobINICount,            -- Added 02/06/2025 - New count column for INI, to be used as a seperate Dashboard AND not part of TotalCount_v2 as it is counted with Contract count.
  JobNonINICount,         -- Added 02/06/2025 - Non INI is only counted in TotalCount_v2
   
  (ContractCount + ExcessInitialCount + JobNonRecurringCount)       AS TotalCount,-- Changed 02/05/2025 based on new logic -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
  (ContractCount + JobNonINICount)                                  AS TotalCount_v2, -- Changed 02/06/2025 based on new logic considering INI count part of contract
  CASE
    WHEN (firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate IS NOT NULL OR StartDate IS NOT NULL) 
          AND contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' 
          AND sTbl = 'SS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product IN ('P','J','I','C') 
          AND sTbl = 'IN' 
          AND `type` <> 'NS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS StartedYN,
  cancelReason,
  CASE
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) OR (IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) ) THEN ('Y')  
    ELSE ('N')
  END AS IndTAP_YN,
  CASE
    WHEN (IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) THEN ('TechSale')
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) AND (IFNULL(tech4_SalesPersonSoldID,0) <> 0)) THEN ('TechLead')
    ELSE ('')
    END AS TAPType,
  lead_employee_id,
  `type`,
  ServiceClass,
  phone,
  altphone,
  NULL AS SummerSalesIND,
  OldsetupNum,
  RNAR.Status AS RenewalStatus,
  freq_code,
  service_has_an_initial,
  next_scheduled_date
FROM      `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_RNA.vw_rpp_stage3_Contract_V2     AS a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production`.Reference.unf_ref_sales_jobroles_tbl  AS jr      ON a.employeeJobTitle = jr.JobTitle
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production`.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees                 AS rtxEmp  ON SAFE_CAST(a.employeeNum AS STRING) = rtxEmp.UKG_Legacy_ID
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_rna_termite_renewals`  AS RNAR ON a.setupid = RNAR.Setup_ID   -- Added so we can pull the renewal status. Once confirmed can make it where it only shows null values.
WHERE
  a.rankValueContract = 1
  AND a.MigratedYN = 'N'
  AND (cancelReason <> 'ADMNVOID' OR cancelReason IS NULL)
  AND LENGTH(TRIM(OldSetupNum)) = 0

SELECT
  a.`SOURCE`, --tdw
  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS Contract,
  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS salesID ,
  a.MarketType AS CustomerType,
  a.ServiceType,
  CASE
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'C'   THEN  'Contract (Recurring)'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'I'   THEN 'Job - INI'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'J'   THEN  'Job'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'P'   THEN  'Product'
  END AS ServiceType_Description,
  a.ProductCode,
  --a.ProductGroup, Old Product Group. This comes from Mission. The new ones below are pulled from the new source
	
  sc.product_category_nm AS Category, 
	sc.service_line_nm	AS ServiceLine,
	sc.service_desc AS Service_Code_Description,
	sc.product_group_nm AS ProductGroup,
	sc.lob_cd AS LOB,
	sc.lob_desc AS LOB_Description,

  SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) SellDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) StartDate ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYearMonth ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.CancelDate AS DATE) CancelDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(inactivedate AS DATE) AS InactiveDate,
  a.cancel_reason_code CancelReasonCode,
  a.division_code_assigned AS MarketCode,
  a.region_code_assigned AS RegionCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedBranch) >= 3 THEN  a.AssignedBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedBranchCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedServiceBranch) >= 3 THEN  a.AssignedServiceBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedServiceBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  --a.AssignedBranch AS AssignedBranchCode, --Commentted out to add the code above in order to add leading 0's
  a.`Geography` AS Zip,
  a.State ,
  customer_name,-- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_phone, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_email, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  IFNULL(a.SalesPersonID, '')                   AS SalesPersonID,
  IFNULL(a.SalesPerson, '')                     AS SalesPerson,
  IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(a.SalesRole AS STRING), '')  AS SalesRole,
  IFNULL(a.SalesPersonJobTitle,'')              AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue,0)                     AS ContractValue,  
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue_cv,0)                  AS ContractValue_calc,
  IFNULL(a.InitialValue,0)                      AS InitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.ExcessInitialValue,0)                AS ExcessInitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.JobNonRecurringValue,0)              AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0)                     AS TotalJobValue,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0)                        AS TotalValue,  --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0)                        AS TotalValue_calc,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue_v2,0)                     AS TotalValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0)                     AS TotalJobValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue,0)                     AS ContractValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.JobINIValue,0)                       AS JobINIValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.JobNonINIValue,0)                    AS JobNonINIValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.BaseQty, 1)                          AS BaseQty,
  raw_qty                                       AS raw_qty,
  ContractCount                                 AS ContractCount,
  JobNonRecurringCount                          AS JobNonRecurringCount,
  ExcessInitialCount                            AS ExcessInitialCount,
  JobRecurringCount                             AS JobRecurringCount,--Initial count
  TotalJobCount                                 AS TotalJobCount,
  TotalCount                                    AS TotalCount,
  TotalCount_V2                                 AS TotalCount_V2,
  ContractCount                                 AS ContractCount_V2,
  JobINICount                                   AS JobINICount_V2,
  JobNonINICount                                AS JobNonINICount_V2,
  a.StartedYN                                   AS StartedInd,



  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN='Y' AND a.Startdate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.StartDate, a.SellDate, DAY) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS DaysToStart,        
  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' THEN  'Y' 
    ELSE 'N' 
  END AS RawCancelInd,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' AND a.CancelDate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.CancelDate , a.SellDate, DAY) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS DaysToRawCancel,
  IndTAP_YN                                       AS TAPInd,
  TAPType                                         AS TAPType,
  lead_employee_id                                AS lead_employee_id,
  SAFE_CAST('' AS STRING)                         AS SetupOrderType ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.SalesEmployeeNumberRTX AS STRING)   AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS LocationID,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS LocationCode,
	SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS BillToID,
	SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS BillToCode,
  SAFE_CAST(SummerSalesIND AS STRING)             AS SummerSalesIND,
  CASE
    WHEN  
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      OR
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      THEN  'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY,
  CASE
    WHEN a.StartDate IS NULL THEN  NULL
      WHEN  
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        OR
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        THEN  'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY_Start,
  '' AS OldSetupNum,
  RenewalStatus,
  '' AS freq_code, -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as blank
  false AS service_has_an_initial,  -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as null
  next_scheduled_date,



  IFNULL(contract_value_v3,0) AS contract_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_nonrecurring_value_v3,0) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_value_v3,0) AS job_ini_value_v3,

  IFNULL(job_recurring_count_v3,0) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_count_v3,0) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  IFNULL(contract_count_v3,0) AS contract_count_v3

WITH cte AS (
-- TDW beginning value
SELECT 
  src_system,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM snp_date) * 100 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM snp_date) AS yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  CAST(zip AS STRING) AS zip,
  branch_code,
  branch_code AS branch_code_latest,
  root_serviceline,
  contract_id, -- ✅ NEW
  SUM(annual_value) AS beginning_value,
  SUM(units) AS beginning_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS terminations_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS terminations_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS deductions,
  SUM(NULL) AS deductions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS additions,
  SUM(NULL) AS additions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS price,
  SUM(NULL) AS new_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS new_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS acquisitions,
  SUM(NULL) AS acquisitions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS adjustments,
  SUM(NULL) AS adjustments_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS ending_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS ending_units
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly_v2` p
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` s
  ON p.service_code = s.service_line_code
WHERE Portfolio_Started_ind = 'Y'
GROUP BY 
  src_system,
  yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  zip,
  branch_code,
  branch_code_latest,
  root_serviceline,
  contract_id -- ✅ NEW

UNION ALL

-- TDW ending value
SELECT 
  src_system,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE_SUB(CAST(snp_date AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) * 100 +
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_SUB(CAST(snp_date AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  CAST(zip AS STRING) AS zip,
  branch_code,
  branch_code AS branch_code_latest,
  root_serviceline,
  contract_id, -- ✅ NEW
  SUM(NULL) AS beginning_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS beginning_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS terminations_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS terminations_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS deductions,
  SUM(NULL) AS deductions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS additions,
  SUM(NULL) AS additions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS price,
  SUM(NULL) AS new_value,
  SUM(NULL) AS new_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS acquisitions,
  SUM(NULL) AS acquisitions_units,
  SUM(NULL) AS adjustments,
  SUM(NULL) AS adjustments_units,
  SUM(annual_value) AS ending_value,
  SUM(units) AS ending_units
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly_v2` p
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` s
  ON p.service_code = s.service_line_code
WHERE Portfolio_Started_ind = 'Y'
GROUP BY 
  src_system,
  yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  zip,
  branch_code,
  branch_code_latest,
  root_serviceline,
  contract_id -- ✅ NEW
),

agg AS (
  SELECT 
    src_system,
    yearmonth,
    customer_type,
    zip,
    branch_code,
    branch_code_latest,
    root_serviceline,
    contract_id, -- ✅ NEW
    SUM(beginning_value) AS beginning_value,
    SUM(beginning_units) AS beginning_units,
    SUM(terminations_value) AS terminations_value,
    SUM(terminations_units) AS terminations_units,
    SUM(deductions) AS deductions_value,
    SUM(deductions_units) AS deductions_units,
    SUM(additions) AS additions_value,
    SUM(additions_units) AS additions_units,
    SUM(price) AS price,
    SUM(new_value) AS new_value,
    SUM(new_units) AS new_units,
    SUM(acquisitions) AS acquisitions_value,
    SUM(acquisitions_units) AS acquisitions_units,
    SUM(adjustments) AS adjustments_value,
    SUM(adjustments_units) AS adjustments_units,
    SUM(ending_value) AS ending_value,
    SUM(ending_units) AS ending_units
  FROM cte
  GROUP BY 
    src_system,
    yearmonth,
    customer_type,
    zip,
    branch_code,
    branch_code_latest,
    root_serviceline,
    contract_id -- ✅ NEW
)

SELECT *
FROM agg

SELECT *,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) AS StartYear,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CancelDate) AS EndYear,

  -- Annual portfolio allocation
  ROUND((CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01') < '2022-01-01'
      OR IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01') > '2022-12-31' THEN 0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF(
           LEAST(IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01'), DATE '2022-12-31'),
           GREATEST(IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '2022-01-01'),
           MONTH
         ) + 1
  END) / 12 * contract_value_v3, 2) AS x2022Portfolio,

  ROUND((CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01') < '2023-01-01'
      OR IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01') > '2023-12-31' THEN 0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF(
           LEAST(IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01'), DATE '2023-12-31'),
           GREATEST(IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '2023-01-01'),
           MONTH
         ) + 1
  END) / 12 * contract_value_v3, 2) AS x2023Portfolio,

  ROUND((CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01') < '2024-01-01'
      OR IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01') > '2024-12-31' THEN 0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF(
           LEAST(IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01'), DATE '2024-12-31'),
           GREATEST(IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '2024-01-01'),
           MONTH
         ) + 1
  END) / 12 * contract_value_v3, 2) AS x2024Portfolio,

  ROUND((CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01') < '2025-01-01'
      OR IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01') > '2025-12-31' THEN 0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF(
           LEAST(IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01'), DATE '2025-12-31'),
           GREATEST(IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '2025-01-01'),
           MONTH
         ) + 1
  END) / 12 * contract_value_v3, 2) AS x2025Portfolio,

  -- ✅ 1. Current 2025 Portfolio (Jan–Jun 2025 only)
  ROUND((CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01') < '2025-01-01'
      OR IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01') > '2025-06-30' THEN 0
    ELSE DATE_DIFF(
           LEAST(IFNULL(CancelDate, DATE '2079-01-01'), DATE '2025-06-30'),
           GREATEST(IFNULL(StartDate, DATE '1900-01-01'), DATE '2025-01-01'),
           MONTH
         ) + 1
  END) / 12 * contract_value_v3, 2) AS Current_2025_Portfolio,

  -- Job Nonrecurring Values by Start Year
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2022 THEN job_nonrecurring_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2022_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2023 THEN job_nonrecurring_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2023_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2024 THEN job_nonrecurring_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2025 THEN job_nonrecurring_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2025_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,

  -- ✅ 2. 2025 Job Nonrecurring Value only if StartDate between Jan–Jun
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2025 AND DATE(StartDate) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    THEN job_nonrecurring_value_v3 ELSE 0 
  END AS x2025_job_nonrecurring_value_v3_JanJun,

  -- Job INI Values by Start Year
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2022 THEN job_ini_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2022_job_ini_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2023 THEN job_ini_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2023_job_ini_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2024 THEN job_ini_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2024_job_ini_value_v3,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2025 THEN job_ini_value_v3 ELSE 0 END AS x2025_job_ini_value_v3,

  -- ✅ 3. 2025 Job INI Value only if StartDate between Jan–Jun
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM StartDate) = 2025 AND DATE(StartDate) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    THEN job_ini_value_v3 ELSE 0 
  END AS x2025_job_ini_value_v3_JanJun

    WHEN a.StartedYN='Y' AND a.Startdate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.StartDate, a.SellDate, DAY) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS DaysToStart,

    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' THEN  'Y' 
    ELSE 'N' 
  END AS RawCancelInd,

    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' AND a.CancelDate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.CancelDate , a.SellDate, DAY)

        DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      OR
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND

SELECT
  t1.Contract,
  t1.MarketType,
  SUM(t1.WorkOrderAmount) AS total_WorkOrderAmount,
  SUM(t1.ActualDuration) AS total_ActualDuration,
  SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024Portfolio, 0)) AS x2024Portfolio,
  SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3, 0)) AS x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3, 0)) AS x2024_job_ini_value_v3,
  
  -- Sum of all 3 columns = total value
  SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024Portfolio, 0) +
      COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3, 0) +
      COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3, 0)) AS x2024_Total_Value,

  -- Absolute Difference in amount
  ROUND(ABS(
    SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024Portfolio, 0) +
        COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3, 0) +
        COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3, 0)) -
    SUM(t1.WorkOrderAmount)
  ), 2) AS value_diff_amount,

  -- Absolute Difference in percentage
  ROUND(ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(COALESCE(t2.x2024Portfolio, 0) +
        COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3, 0) +
        COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3, 0)) -
    SUM(t1.WorkOrderAmount),
    SUM(t1.WorkOrderAmount)
  )), 2) AS value_diff_pct

FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.WorkOrderCustomerPulls.UNF_WorkOrderWithID_071625` t1
LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.Prorated_Per_Year_HY_v2` t2
ON
  CAST(t1.Contract AS STRING) = t2.Contract
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.EndDate) = 2024
GROUP BY
  t1.Contract,
  t1.MarketType

WITH base_table AS (
  SELECT
    t1.Contract,
    t1.MarketType,
    SUM(t1.WorkOrderAmount) AS total_WorkOrderAmount,
    SUM(t1.ActualDuration) AS total_ActualDuration,
    t2.x2024Portfolio,
    t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
    t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3,
    COALESCE(t2.x2024Portfolio, 0) +
    COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3, 0) +
    COALESCE(t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3, 0) AS x2024_Total_Value
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.WorkOrderCustomerPulls.UNF_WorkOrderWithID_071625` t1
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.Prorated_Per_Year_HY_v2` t2
  ON
    CAST(t1.Contract AS STRING) = t2.Contract
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.EndDate) = 2024
  GROUP BY
    t1.Contract,
    t1.MarketType,
    t2.x2024Portfolio,
    t2.x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
    t2.x2024_job_ini_value_v3
)

SELECT
  MarketType,
  CASE
    WHEN x2024Portfolio IS NULL AND x2024_job_nonrecurring_value_v3 IS NULL AND x2024_job_ini_value_v3 IS NULL THEN 'No Match'
    ELSE 'Match'
  END AS MatchStatus,
  COUNT(DISTINCT Contract) AS distinct_contract_count
FROM base_table
GROUP BY
  MarketType,
  MatchStatus
ORDER BY
  MarketType,
  MatchStatus

SELECT
  src_system as Source_System,
  branch_code as Branch_Code,
  -- COALESCE(ty.branch_code) AS Branch_Code,
  COALESCE(left(ty.zip,5)) AS Zip,
  COALESCE(ty.yearmonth) AS Year_Month,
  NULL AS Zip_Mapped_Branch_Code,
  service_code,
  CASE 
    WHEN root_serviceline = 'PEST' THEN 'PEST'
    WHEN root_serviceline = 'TERMITE' THEN 'TERMITE'
    WHEN root_serviceline = 'HOME & BLDG SERVICES' THEN 'HOME & BLDG SERVICES'
    ELSE 'OTHERS OR NULL'
  END AS Product_Category,
  COALESCE(ty.customer_type) AS Customer_Type,

  -- Value Stack
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.beginning_value, 0)) AS `01_Beginning_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.terminations_value, 0)) AS `02_Terminations_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.deductions_value, 0)) AS `03_Deductions_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.additions_value, 0)) AS `04_Additions_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.price, 0)) AS `05_Price`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.new_value, 0)) AS `06_New_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.acquisitions_value, 0)) AS `07_Acquisitions_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.adjustments_value, 0)) AS `08_Adjustments_Value`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.ending_value, 0)) AS `09_Ending_Value`,
  
  -- Units Stack
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.beginning_units, 0)) AS `10_Beginning_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.terminations_units, 0)) AS `11_Terminations_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.deductions_units, 0)) AS `12_Deductions_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.additions_units, 0)) AS `13_Additions_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.new_units, 0)) AS `14_New_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.acquisitions_units, 0)) AS `15_Acquisitions_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.adjustments_units, 0)) AS `16_Adjustments_Units`,
  SUM(COALESCE(ty.ending_units, 0)) AS `17_Ending_Units`

FROM agg ty

WHERE COALESCE(ty.yearmonth) in (202412, 202504)
group by Source_System, Branch_Code, Zip, Year_Month, Product_Category, Customer_Type, service_code
ORDER BY Source_System, Branch_Code, Zip, Product_Category, Customer_Type, Year_Month

SELECT

  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS Contract,
  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS salesID ,
  a.MarketType AS CustomerType,
  a.ServiceType,
  CASE
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'C'   THEN  'Contract (Recurring)'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'I'   THEN 'Job - INI'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'J'   THEN  'Job'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'P'   THEN  'Product'
  END AS ServiceType_Description,
  a.ProductCode,
  --a.ProductGroup, Old Product Group. This comes from Mission. The new ones below are pulled from the new source
	
  sc.product_category_nm AS Category, 
	sc.service_line_nm	AS ServiceLine,
	sc.service_desc AS Service_Code_Description,
	sc.product_group_nm AS ProductGroup,
	sc.lob_cd AS LOB,
	sc.lob_desc AS LOB_Description,

  SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) SellDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) StartDate ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYearMonth ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.CancelDate AS DATE) CancelDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYear ,
  a.cancel_reason_code CancelReasonCode,
  a.division_code_assigned AS MarketCode,
  a.region_code_assigned AS RegionCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedBranch) >= 3 THEN  a.AssignedBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedBranchCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedServiceBranch) >= 3 THEN  a.AssignedServiceBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedServiceBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  --a.AssignedBranch AS AssignedBranchCode, --Commentted out to add the code above in order to add leading 0's
  a.`Geography` AS Zip,
  a.State ,
  customer_name,-- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_phone, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_email, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  IFNULL(a.SalesPersonID, '')                   AS SalesPersonID,
  IFNULL(a.SalesPerson, '')                     AS SalesPerson,
  IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(a.SalesRole AS STRING), '')  AS SalesRole,
  IFNULL(a.SalesPersonJobTitle,'')              AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue,0)                     AS ContractValue,  
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue_cv,0)                  AS ContractValue_calc,
  IFNULL(a.InitialValue,0)                      AS InitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.ExcessInitialValue,0)                AS ExcessInitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.JobNonRecurringValue,0)              AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0)                     AS TotalJobValue,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0)                        AS TotalValue,  --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0)                        AS TotalValue_calc,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue_v2,0)                     AS TotalValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0)                     AS TotalJobValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue,0)                     AS ContractValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.JobINIValue,0)                       AS JobINIValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.JobNonINIValue,0)                    AS JobNonINIValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.BaseQty, 1)                          AS BaseQty,
  raw_qty                                       AS raw_qty,
  ContractCount                                 AS ContractCount,
  JobNonRecurringCount                          AS JobNonRecurringCount,
  ExcessInitialCount                            AS ExcessInitialCount,
  JobRecurringCount                             AS JobRecurringCount,--Initial count
  TotalJobCount                                 AS TotalJobCount,
  TotalCount                                    AS TotalCount,
  TotalCount_V2                                 AS TotalCount_V2,
  ContractCount                                 AS ContractCount_V2,
  JobINICount                                   AS JobINICount_V2,
  JobNonINICount                                AS JobNonINICount_V2,
  a.StartedYN                                   AS StartedInd,



  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN='Y' AND a.Startdate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.StartDate, a.SellDate, DAY) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS DaysToStart,        
  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' THEN  'Y' 
    ELSE 'N' 
  END AS RawCancelInd,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' AND a.CancelDate >= a.SellDate THEN  DATE_DIFF(a.CancelDate , a.SellDate, DAY) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS DaysToRawCancel,
  IndTAP_YN                                       AS TAPInd,
  TAPType                                         AS TAPType,
  lead_employee_id                                AS lead_employee_id,
  SAFE_CAST('' AS STRING)                         AS SetupOrderType ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.SalesEmployeeNumberRTX AS STRING)   AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,

  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS LocationCode,

	SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING)                       AS BillToCode,
  SAFE_CAST(SummerSalesIND AS STRING)             AS SummerSalesIND,
  CASE
    WHEN  
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      OR
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      THEN  'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY,
  CASE
    WHEN a.StartDate IS NULL THEN  NULL
      WHEN  
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        OR
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        THEN  'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY_Start,
  '' AS OldSetupNum,
  RenewalStatus,
  '' AS freq_code, -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as blank
  false AS service_has_an_initial,  -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as null
  next_scheduled_date,



  IFNULL(contract_value_v3,0) AS contract_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_nonrecurring_value_v3,0) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_value_v3,0) AS job_ini_value_v3,

  IFNULL(job_recurring_count_v3,0) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_count_v3,0) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  IFNULL(contract_count_v3,0) AS contract_count_v3

FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tdw_Contract_V2 a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_product` sc ON a.ProductCode = UPPER(TRIM(sc.service_cd))

  (ContractValue + ExcessInitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)       AS TotalValue,

  (ContractValue + JobINIValue + JobNonINIValue )                   AS TotalValue_v2,     -- Added 02/06/2025
  ContractCount,  
 
    ExcessInitialCount,   -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
    JobNonRecurringCount, -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
    JobRecurringCount,    -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
   
  TotalJobCount,          -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
  JobINICount,            -- Added 02/06/2025 - New count column for INI, to be used as a seperate Dashboard AND not part of TotalCount_v2 as it is counted with Contract count.
  JobNonINICount,         -- Added 02/06/2025 - Non INI is only counted in TotalCount_v2
   
  (ContractCount + ExcessInitialCount + JobNonRecurringCount)       AS TotalCount,-- Changed 02/05/2025 based on new logic -- *** TO BE REMOVED ***
  (ContractCount + JobNonINICount)                                  AS TotalCount_v2, -- Changed 02/06/2025 based on new logic considering INI count part of contract
  CASE
    WHEN (firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate IS NOT NULL OR StartDate IS NOT NULL) 
          AND contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' 
          AND sTbl = 'SS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product IN ('P','J','I','C') 
          AND sTbl = 'IN' 
          AND `type` <> 'NS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS StartedYN,
  cancelReason,
  CASE
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) OR (IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) ) THEN ('Y')  
    ELSE ('N')
  END AS IndTAP_YN,
  CASE
    WHEN (IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) THEN ('TechSale')
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) AND (IFNULL(tech4_SalesPersonSoldID,0) <> 0)) THEN ('TechLead')
    ELSE ('')
    END AS TAPType,
  lead_employee_id,
  `type`,
  ServiceClass,
  phone,
  altphone,
  NULL AS SummerSalesIND,
  OldsetupNum,
  RNAR.Status AS RenewalStatus,
  freq_code,
  service_has_an_initial,
  next_scheduled_date

LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production`.Reference.unf_ref_sales_jobroles_tbl  AS jr      ON a.employeeJobTitle = jr.JobTitle
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production`.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees                 AS rtxEmp  ON SAFE_CAST(a.employeeNum AS STRING) = rtxEmp.UKG_Legacy_ID

WHERE
   a.MigratedYN = 'N'
  AND cancelReason <> 'ADMNVOID'
  AND LENGTH(TRIM(OldSetupNum)) = 0

SELECT
    'TDW'                       AS Source,
  a.sales_agreement_number      AS Contract,
  a.market_type                   AS MarketType,
  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product)  AS ServiceType,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.Mapped_Service)) AS ProductCode,
  item_code,
  sa_type_code,
  service_line1_long            AS ProductGroup,
  MAX(accounting_date)          AS SellDate,
  MAX(effective_date)           AS StartDate, --MAX(original_effective_date) StartDate - Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(a.cancel_date)            AS CancelDate,
  --MAX(next_scheduled_date)      AS next_scheduled_date,
  MAX(NS.scheduled_date)        AS next_scheduled_date,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedBranch,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  division_code_assigned,
  region_code_assigned,
  postal_code                   AS Geography,
  state_code                    AS State,
  employee_id                   AS SalesPersonID,
  SalesPerson                   AS SalesPerson,
  job_code_description          AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  NULL                          AS SalesRole,
  employee_jde_number           AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_phone,
  a.customer_email,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)          AS ContractValue,   --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS InitialValue,    --Added 01/30/2024
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM')) AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(rawsale_amt) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    ELSE  SUM(excess_initial_value_cv)
  END AS ExcessInitialValue,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)                           AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)   AS TotalJobValue, -- Initial value + JobNonRecurringValue
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(annual_value_cv) + (SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)) + SUM(spc_value_cv) 
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
  END AS TotalValue,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS JobINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
  SUM(spc_value_cv)             AS JobNonINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
--  CASE
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)) -- For TC INI Value has the first year value -- 02/06/2025
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
--    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
--    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
--  END AS TotalValue_v2, --Added 02/06/2025
  (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv) + SUM(annual_value_cv)) AS TotalValue_V2,
  SUM(base_qty)                 AS BaseQty,
  SUM(raw_qty)                  AS raw_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS ContractCount,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonRecurringCount,  --SPC counts -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  0   AS ExcessInitialCount, -- For tmx count is part of ContractCount -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
    END AS JobRecurringCount, -- InitialCount -- -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  (
  CASE
    WHEN (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) <> 'C') OR (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  ) AS TotalJobCount, --Total job counts  
  1 AS TotalCount, -- To be removed 02/06/2025
 
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobINICount, -- InitialCount Added 02/06/2025 - New count column for INI, to be used AS a seperate Dashboard and not part of TotalCount_v2, AS it is counted with Contract count.
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonINICount, -- Added 02/06/2025 - Non INI SPC counts are only counted in TotalCount_v2,
  (
  -- Added 02/06/2025 - Contract Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract so the 1 is represents the contract not the INI 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  )
  +
  (
-- Added 02/06/2025 - Jobs(Non-INI): One-time or Special Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract. 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  ) AS TotalCount_v2,
  --(ContractCount + JobNonINICount)  -- Changed 02/06/2025 based on new logic considering INI count part of contract
  --Maybe consider TotalCount_v2 as just 1 or in the next stage do ContractCount+JobNonINICount for a more streamlined and business look
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(effective_date) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE  'N'
  END AS StartedYN, -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(a.cancel_reason_code) AS cancel_reason_code,
  MAX(indTAP_YN) AS indTAP_YN,
  MAX(TAPType) AS TAPType,
  MAX(lead_employee_id) AS lead_employee_id,
  -- Calculated fields
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN effective_date IS NULL
        THEN annual_value_cv -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
      ELSE
        starts_value
    END
     ) AS ContractValue_cv,
  SUM(recurring_value)        AS RecurringValue_cv,
  SUM(raw_value)              AS RawValue_cv,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)       AS InitialValue_cv,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)           AS SpcValue_cv,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)        AS AnnualValue_cv,
  SUM(discount_amt)           AS discount_amt_cv,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN  (service_type_code <> 'RNL') THEN rawsale_amt
      ELSE  0
    END
    ) AS rawsale_amt_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN  employee_primary_designation_code = 'SUMMSLS' THEN 'HAWX - Summer Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS SummerSalesIND,
  TMXR.Status AS RenewalStatus,

  -- Mission new values for values - Steven McCaffrey 3/22/2025
  SUM(contract_value_v3) as contract_value_v3,
  SUM(job_nonrecurring_value_v3) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_value_v3) AS job_ini_value_v3,
  SUM(job_recurring_count_v3) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_count_v3) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  SUM(contract_count_v3) AS contract_count_v3


FROM      bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.vw_tdw_stage2_Contract_V2_withcustomer_id         AS a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Product_Mission_PestPac_Service_Map`   AS p    ON TRIM(a.sa_type_code) = TRIM(p.Template)
                                                                                               AND TRIM(a.item_code) = TRIM(p.Item)

LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S3.WO_NextScheduled_Date NS ON a.sales_agreement_number = NS.sales_agreement_number


GROUP BY

  employee_id,

    MAX(IF(CAST(price_increase AS FLOAT64) < 0, 1, 0)) AS has_decrease
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Portfolio_Pull_COM.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly_20230101_20250501_view`
  GROUP BY contract_id, snp_month
)

  contract_id,
  MAX(IF(has_increase = 1, snp_month, NULL)) AS latest_price_increase_snp_month,
  MAX(IF(has_decrease = 1, snp_month, NULL)) AS latest_price_decrease_snp_month
FROM monthly
GROUP BY contract_id;

WITH BaseData AS (
  SELECT
    UniqueCustomerID_Dataset, 
    Customer_Name,
    WorkOrderAmount, 
    MarketType, 
    WorkOrder
  FROM bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverBaseCleaningPreMarketTagging.Input_WorkOrderData_Table),

CustomerMarketFlags AS (
  SELECT
    UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,
    MAX(CASE WHEN MarketType = 'NAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Has_NAT,
    MAX(CASE WHEN MarketType = 'COM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Has_COM
  FROM BaseData
  GROUP BY
   UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
),

LabeledData AS (
  SELECT 
    b.UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,
    b.Customer_Name,
    b.WorkOrderAmount,
    b.MarketType,
    b.WorkOrder,

    -- total work order amount per customer + source
    SUM(b.WorkOrderAmount) OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
    ) AS Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer,

    CASE 
      WHEN b.MarketType = 'RES' AND f.Has_NAT = 1 THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS NatCheck,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.MarketType = 'RES' AND f.Has_COM = 1 THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS ComCheck
  FROM BaseData b
  LEFT JOIN CustomerMarketFlags f
    ON b.UniqueCustomerID_Dataset = f.UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
),

AggregatedData AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,
    Customer_Name, 
    Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer,
    MarketType, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT WorkOrder) AS Distinct_WorkOrder_Count,
    MAX(NatCheck) AS NatCheck,
    MAX(ComCheck) AS ComCheck
  FROM LabeledData
  GROUP BY 
    UniqueCustomerID_Dataset, 
    Customer_Name, 
    Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer,
    MarketType
)

SELECT 
  *,
  CASE 
    WHEN MarketType != 'RES' THEN MarketType
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 0 AND ComCheck = 0 
         AND Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer>= 50000 THEN 'NAT' 
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 0 AND ComCheck = 0 
        AND Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer < 50000 THEN 'COM'
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 1 AND ComCheck = 0 THEN 'NAT'
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 0 AND ComCheck = 1 THEN 'COM'
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 1 AND ComCheck = 1 
         AND Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer>= 50000 THEN 'NAT'
    WHEN MarketType = 'RES' AND NatCheck = 1 AND ComCheck = 1 
         AND Total_WorkOrder_Amount_By_Customer < 50000 THEN 'COM'
  END AS TrueMarketType
FROM AggregatedData
WHERE 
  Distinct_WorkOrder_Count > 18
ORDER BY Distinct_WorkOrder_Count DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
  UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,
  MarketType,

  -- Total WorkOrderAmount across all MarketTypes for each customer
  SUM(WorkOrderAmount) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer,

  -- Total number of rows across all MarketTypes for each customer
  COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS Total_Row_Count_By_Customer,

  -- Number of distinct market types each customer has
  COUNT(DISTINCT MarketType) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS Distinct_MarketType_Count,


  MAX(CASE WHEN MarketType = 'RES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS HasRes,

  MAX(CASE WHEN MarketType = 'COM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS HasCom,

  MAX(CASE WHEN MarketType = 'NAT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
    PARTITION BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset
  ) AS HasNat

FROM bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverBaseCleaningPreMarketTagging.Input_WorkOrderData_Table
ORDER BY Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN Distinct_MarketType_Count = 1
         AND Total_Row_Count_By_Customer > 18
         AND MarketType = 'RES'
         AND Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer > 50000
      THEN 'NAT'

    WHEN Distinct_MarketType_Count = 1
         AND Total_Row_Count_By_Customer > 18
         AND MarketType = 'RES'
         AND Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer < 50000
      THEN 'COM'

    WHEN HasRes = 1 AND HasCom = 1 AND HasNat = 0
      THEN 'COM'

    WHEN HasRes = 1 AND HasNat = 1 AND HasCom = 0
      THEN 'NAT'

    WHEN HasNat = 1 AND HasCom = 1 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer > 50000
      THEN 'NAT'

    WHEN HasNat = 1 AND HasCom = 1 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount_By_Customer < 50000
      THEN 'COM'

    ELSE MArketType  -- catch-all for anything that doesn’t meet criteria
  END AS TrueMarketType

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverBaseCleaningMarkettagging.Step1a_IncorrectMarketTaggingIDs`;

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT DISTINCT *

SELECT

  CASE

    ELSE 'No'
  END AS FlaggedDuration,

  -- Over5KOrder column
  CASE 
    WHEN WorkOrderAmount > 5000 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS Over5KOrder,

  -- Over5KCost column
  CASE 
    WHEN WorkOrderAmount > 5000 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ProductKey, r'^[A-Z]+-1-7-') 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ProductKey, r'^[A-Z]+-3-')

WITH clean_base AS (

    UniqueCustomerID,
    ProductKey,
    ActualDuration
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverBaseCleaningMarkettagging.Step4_Flag_Duration_and_WOAmount_ADDOver5KCost_Column`

),

-- Full data (no FlaggedDuration filter)
full_base AS (

    UniqueCustomerID,
    ProductKey,
    ActualDuration
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverBaseCleaningMarkettagging.Step4_Flag_Duration_and_WOAmount_ADDOver5KCost_Column`
),

productkey_avg AS (

    AVG(ActualDuration) AS ProductKeyAvg
  FROM clean_base
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),

has_inrange AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID,
    ProductKey
  FROM full_base
  GROUP BY UniqueCustomerID, ProductKey
  HAVING COUNTIF(ActualDuration BETWEEN 5 AND 480) > 0
),

customer_avg AS (

    ProductKey,
    AVG(ActualDuration) AS AvgActualDuration_NoFlag
  FROM clean_base

SELECT

  "Used_Customer_Avg" AS SourceFlag

JOIN has_inrange h

SELECT

  "Used_Global_Avg" AS SourceFlag
FROM full_base fb
LEFT JOIN has_inrange h
  ON fb.UniqueCustomerID = h.UniqueCustomerID AND fb.ProductKey = h.ProductKey

WITH CostCalc AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    11.65 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS SVC_MGT_Cost,
    13.48 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS OFFSITE_Cost,
    50.24 * (Sum_Sum_NewTrueDurationAYXFinal / 60) AS TOJ_Cost,
    0.21 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS SVC_Support,
    2.29 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS Subcontract_Cost,
    9.28 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count * (49.7 / (Sum_Sum_NewTrueDurationAYXFinal / Count_Distinct_Visit_Count)) AS Material_Cost,
    4.30 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS VehicleFuel_Cost,
    4.55 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS VehicleActual_Cost,
    2.10 * Count_Distinct_Visit_Count AS OtherServiceCost,
    Sum_Sum_Over5KCostNew AS BirdENDCOST
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverFirstRoundCleaninginAlteryx.Step11_Customer_Branch_Tabulation_Table`
  WHERE Count_Distinct_Visit_Count IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT *,
  (
    SVC_MGT_Cost +
    OFFSITE_Cost +
    TOJ_Cost +
    SVC_Support +
    Subcontract_Cost +
    Material_Cost +
    VehicleFuel_Cost +
    VehicleActual_Cost +
    OtherServiceCost +
    BirdENDCOST
  ) AS TotalCost
FROM CostCalc

SELECT
  UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,

  Customer_name,
  TrueMarketType,
  SUM(Sum_Sum_NewTrueDurationAYXFinal) AS TotalDuration,
  SUM(Sum_Sum_WorkOrderAmount) AS Total_WorkOrderAmount,
  SUM(TotalCost) AS Total_Cost,
  (SUM(Sum_Sum_WorkOrderAmount) - SUM(TotalCost)) / NULLIF(SUM(Sum_Sum_WorkOrderAmount), 0) AS Margin,
  60*(SUM(Sum_Sum_WorkOrderAmount) / NULLIF(SUM(Sum_Sum_NewTrueDurationAYXFinal), 0)) AS Productivity
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step1_Appending_Costs`
GROUP BY UniqueCustomerID_Dataset, Source, Customer_name, TrueMarketType

SELECT
  a.*,
  b.EarliestEndDate
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step2_EndCost_and_Margin` AS a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverPriceIncreaseChecker.Step5JoinedViewEarliestworkOrderbyCustomer` AS b

SELECT

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step3_TenureAdded` AS a

SELECT * FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step4_PriceChangeAdded` 
WHERE TrueMarketType = "COM"

SELECT
  *,
  CONCAT(
    Production_Type,
    Margin_Tranche,
    Productivity_Tranche
  ) AS ConcatSegments
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step6_Margin_Productivity_Segments`;

SELECT
  *,
  -- Production Type
  CASE
    WHEN Total_WorkOrderAmount < 5000 THEN 'SMBUnder5K'
    WHEN Total_WorkOrderAmount >= 5000 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount <= 50000 THEN 'SMB5to50K'
    WHEN Total_WorkOrderAmount > 50000 THEN 'SMBOver50K'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS Production_Type,

  -- Margin Tranche
  CASE
    WHEN Margin < -0.20 THEN 'Under -20%'
    WHEN Margin >= -0.20 AND Margin < 0 THEN '-20% to 0%'
    WHEN Margin >= 0 AND Margin <= 0.25 THEN '0% to 25%'
    WHEN Margin > 0.25 THEN 'Over 25%'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS Margin_Tranche,

  --  Productivity Tranche
  CASE
    WHEN Productivity >= 0 AND Productivity <= 70 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount < 5000 THEN '0 to 70'
    WHEN Productivity > 70 AND Productivity <= 90 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount < 5000 THEN '70 to 90'
    WHEN Productivity > 90 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount < 5000 THEN 'Above 90'
    WHEN Productivity >= 0 AND Productivity <= 100 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount > 5000 THEN '0 to 100'
    WHEN Productivity > 100 AND Productivity <= 200 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount > 5000 THEN '100 to 200'
    WHEN Productivity > 200 AND Total_WorkOrderAmount > 5000 THEN 'Above 200'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS Productivity_Tranche,

FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step5_COMCustomerModel`

SELECT
  a.*,
  b.Rate
FROM
  bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step6B_Margin_Productivity_Segments AS a
LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      Concat,
      Rate
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.RateCapFieldsJoiner`
  ) AS b
ON
  a.ConcatSegments = b.Concat;

SELECT
  *,
  GREATEST((Total_Cost - Total_WorkOrderAmount), 0) AS Uplift_to_0pct_Margin,

  ((Total_Cost / 0.6) - Total_WorkOrderAmount) AS Uplift_to_40pct_Margin,

  (Rate * Total_WorkOrderAmount) AS Uplift_to_Rate
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step7_Recomended_Price_Increase_List`
WHERE
  Margin < 0.25;

SELECT
  *,
  GREATEST(
    Uplift_to_0pct_Margin,
    LEAST(Uplift_to_40pct_Margin, Uplift_to_Rate)
  ) AS Uplift
FROM
  bidata-sharedus-production.HandoverCustomerBranchlevelWOs.Step8_Uplift_Scenarios_For_InScope_AccountsTABLE;

SELECT 
  UniqueCustomerID_Dataset,
  Source,
  Customer_name,
  TrueMarketType,
  ROUND(TotalDuration, 2) AS TotalDuration,
  ROUND(Total_WorkOrderAmount, 2) AS Total_WorkOrderAmount,
  ROUND(Total_Cost, 2) AS Total_Cost,
  ROUND(Margin, 2) AS Margin,
  ROUND(Productivity, 2) AS ProductivityPerHour,
  EarliestEndDate AS TenureDate,
  IFNULL(
    CAST(LatestPriceChangeDate AS STRING),
    'No recorded price change'
  ) AS LatestPriceChangeDate,

  CONCAT(

  CASE
    WHEN TrueDuration > (AVG(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher) + (2 * STDDEV(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher))) 
      THEN AVG(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher)
    WHEN TrueDuration < (AVG(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher) - (2 * STDDEV(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher))) 
      THEN AVG(TrueDuration) OVER (PARTITION BY IDKEYMatcher)

calc AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT WorkOrder) OVER (PARTITION BY BCGVisitConcat) AS CountDistinct_WO_Count,

    SUM(NewTrueDurationAYX) OVER (PARTITION BY BCGVisitConcat) AS Sum_NewTrueDurationAYX,

    CASE

SELECT DISTINCT * 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.New_W3_WorkOrderTaxonomy.Tier1_AddedUniqueCustIDToTable`
WHERE Status = "Completed"
  AND DATE(EndDate) BETWEEN DATE('2024-05-01') AND DATE('2025-04-30')
  AND NOT (PlannedDuration = 0 AND ActualDuration = 0)
  AND NOT (PlannedDuration IS NULL AND ActualDuration IS NULL)
  AND WorkOrderAmount < 250000

SELECT 
  *, 
  -- FlaggedDuration column
  CASE 
    WHEN ActualDuration < 5 OR ActualDuration > 480 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS FlaggedDuration,

  -- Over5KOrder column
  CASE 
    WHEN WorkOrderAmount > 5000 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS Over5KOrder,

  -- Over5KCost column
  CASE 
    WHEN WorkOrderAmount > 5000 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ProductKey, r'^[A-Z]+-1-7-') 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ProductKey, r'^[A-Z]+-3-') 
    THEN 0.5 * WorkOrderAmount
    ELSE 0
  END AS Over5KCost

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.New_W3_WorkOrderTaxonomy.Tier2_DateFilter`;

-- Part 1: Clean rows (FlaggedDuration = "No")
WITH clean_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
    ProductKey,
    ActualDuration
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.New_W3_WorkOrderTaxonomy.Tier3_FlaggedWorkOrder5KCostAdded`
  WHERE FlaggedDuration = "No"
),

-- Full data (no FlaggedDuration filter)
full_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
    ProductKey,
    ActualDuration
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.New_W3_WorkOrderTaxonomy.Tier3_FlaggedWorkOrder5KCostAdded`
),

productkey_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ProductKey,
    AVG(ActualDuration) AS ProductKeyAvg
  FROM clean_base
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),

has_inrange AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
    ProductKey
  FROM full_base
  GROUP BY UniqueCustomerID_DataSet, ProductKey
  HAVING COUNTIF(ActualDuration BETWEEN 5 AND 480) > 0
),

customer_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
    ProductKey,
    AVG(ActualDuration) AS AvgActualDuration_NoFlag
  FROM clean_base
  GROUP BY UniqueCustomerID_DataSet, ProductKey
)

-- Final output
SELECT 
  ca.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
  ca.ProductKey,
  ca.AvgActualDuration_NoFlag,
  "Used_Customer_Avg" AS SourceFlag
FROM customer_avg ca
JOIN has_inrange h
  ON ca.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet = h.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet AND ca.ProductKey = h.ProductKey

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  fb.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet,
  fb.ProductKey,
  p.ProductKeyAvg AS AvgActualDuration_NoFlag,
  "Used_Global_Avg" AS SourceFlag
FROM full_base fb
LEFT JOIN has_inrange h
  ON fb.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet = h.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet AND fb.ProductKey = h.ProductKey
JOIN productkey_avg p
  ON fb.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE h.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet IS NULL
GROUP BY fb.UniqueCustomerID_DataSet, fb.ProductKey, p.ProductKeyAvg

SELECT

 --lead_attributes

 coalesce(lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,new_lead_source,lead_source) as lead_source,
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_1,

  lppm.Solution_Mapped as primary_pest_solution,
--lead_field_assingment 
coalesce(upper(b.brand_nm),upper(lfa.brand)) as brand,
  case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end as assigned_branch, 
   case when assigned_branch is null then (case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end ) else (case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end  ) end as report_branch, 
  coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee) as assigned_employee,
  --lae.Job_Family_Group as assigned_employee_job_role,   
--lead_proposals
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then sum(lpp.quantity) else sum(lp.quantity) end as services_proposed,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then sum(lpp.service_amount) else sum(lp.service_amount) end as value_proposed,
--lead_sales */
  --'Not yet available' as start_date,
  min(ls.eff_date) as sold_date,
  sum(ls.quantity) as services_sold,
  sum(ls.total_amount) as value_sold_raw,
  sum(ls.job_amount) as sold_job_amount,
  sum(ls.contract_amount) as sold_contract_amount,
  sum(ls.product_amount) as sold_product_amount,
  --lead_sales_link to contractstarted
  sum(starts.value_sold_started) as value_sold_started,
  sum(starts.started_contract_count) as started_contract_count,
  --lead_stage
  sum(lstag.contacts_stage_count) as contacts_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.MQL_stage_count) as MQL_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.SQL_stage_count) as SQL_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.scheduled_stage_count) as scheduled_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.inspected_stage_count) as inspected_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.proposed_stage_count) as proposed_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.sold_stage_count) as sold_stage_count,
--lead_status
  coalesce(lcrm.Cancel_Reason_Mapped, concat('Not Mapped - ',cancel_reason)) as cancel_reason,  
  count(lstat.cancel_date) as canceled_count,
  count(lstat.closed_lost_date) as closed_lost_count,
  count(lstat.closed_won_date) as closed_won_count
FROM
  (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct rtx_lead_sid, src_system, src_system_attr_id, src_system_attr_id_value, upstream_src_system, upstream_src_system_attr_id, upstream_src_system_attr_id_value, src_system_cre_date from unnest (lead_source_system) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system` ) l
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_business` lb on l.src_system = lb.Source_System
  inner join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct market_type,lead_type,lead_source,primary_pest from unnest (attributes) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes` )  la on l.rtx_lead_uid = la.rtx_lead_uid
   left join (select rtx_lead_uid, lead_source as new_lead_source from `bidata-sharedus-production.Playground.rtx_leads_tdw_attributes_new_version_202508_copy`) tdw on l.rtx_lead_uid = tdw.rtx_lead_uid
  left join (select `Key`,Lead_Source_Mapped,Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,Lead_Type_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_lead_source`) lsm on upper(lsm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",coalesce(lead_type,""),"|",coalesce(new_lead_source,lead_source,"")))
  left join (select `Key`,Pest_Name_Mapped, Pest_Report_Group_Mapped, Pest_Type_1_Mapped, Solution_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_primary_pest`) lppm on upper(lppm.key) = concat(Mapping,"|",upper(primary_pest))
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,

             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' then assignment_value end as assigned_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as assigned_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'originating_branch' then assignment_value end as originating_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'originating_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'sales_employee' then assignment_value end as sales_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'sales_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'brand' then assignment_value end as brand 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'brand' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`
              ) lfa on l.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid
  left join   (select branch_num, brand_nm from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch`) b on lfa.assigned_branch = b.branch_num
  left join (select `Key`,Cancel_Reason_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_cancel_reason`) lcrm on upper(lcrm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",cancel_reason))
 -- left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` lae on lfa.assigned_employee = lae.Employee_Number
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid, sum(quantity) as quantity,sum(service_amount) as service_amount,max(eff_date) as eff_date
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_proposals` group by rtx_lead_uid
             ) lp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lp.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, service_amount, eff_date from unnest (proposals) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`  
  )           lpp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lpp.rtx_lead_uid --lpp take last record because proposals can be deleted in Winning Formula
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, total_amount, job_amount, contract_amount, product_amount, eff_date from unnest (sales) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_sales`  
  )           ls on l.rtx_lead_uid = ls.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Cancelled' then eff_date end as cancel_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Cancelled' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Lost' then eff_date end as closed_lost_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Lost' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Won' then eff_date end as closed_won_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Won'order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
               from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_status`) lstat on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstat.rtx_lead_uid
    left join (select
              rtx_lead_uid,
              sum(contacts_multiplier) as contacts_stage_count,
              sum(mql_multiplier) as mql_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) as sql_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(scheduled_multiplier) as scheduled_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(inspected_multiplier) as inspected_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(proposed_multiplier) as proposed_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(sold_multiplier) as sold_stage_count
              from (SELECT 
              s.rtx_lead_uid,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then 1 else 0 end as contacts_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then 1 else 0 end as mql_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' and cancel_reason is null then 1 else 0 end as sql_multiplier,--to exclude bad source
              case when stage = 'Scheduled' then 1 
              when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1
              else 0 end as scheduled_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment` )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid and cancel_reason in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data')  
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid
  left join    (select sl.rtx_lead_uid, sum(TotalValue) as value_sold_started, sum(ContractCount) as started_contract_count
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_sale_link` sl
              left join (select Contract, TotalValue, ContractCount from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractStarted_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw`
              )  ss on sl.sale_system_attr_id_value = ss.Contract
              group by sl.rtx_lead_uid) starts on l.rtx_lead_uid = starts.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(src_system_cre_date, DAY) >= TIMESTAMP("2023-01-01")
GROUP BY 
business,
  date_trunc(l.src_system_cre_date,day)  ,
  l.src_system,
 --lead_attributes
  market_type, 
  lead_type, 
  lsm.Lead_Type_Mapped,
  lead_source,
  lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,
  lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,
  lsm.Lead_Channel_2_Mapped, 
  primary_pest,
  lppm.Pest_Report_Group_Mapped,
  lppm.Pest_Type_1_Mapped,
  lppm.Solution_Mapped,
--lead_field_assingment 
coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee),
  lfa.assigned_branch,
  originating_branch,
   cancel_reason,
   coalesce(upper(b.brand_nm),upper(lfa.brand))
