WITH rpp_clean AS (
  SELECT
    salesID,
    locationcode,
    servicecode,
    salesperson,
    orderdate,
    adddate,
    contract_job_or_product,
    adduserID
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_RNA.vw_rpp_stage3_Contract_V2`
  WHERE adduserID IS NOT NULL
),

-- Fallback deduplicated version for non-sales_id joins
rpp_fallback_deduped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY locationcode, servicecode, salesperson, orderdate, adddate, contract_job_or_product
        ORDER BY salesID  -- or another tie-breaker if available
      ) AS row_num
    FROM rpp_clean
  )
  WHERE row_num = 1
)

SELECT
  fct.*,
  
  -- Determine which adduserID matched (either via sales_id or fallback)
  COALESCE(rpp_direct.adduserID, rpp_fallback.adduserID) AS adduserID,

  -- Classification logic
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(rpp_direct.adduserID, rpp_fallback.adduserID) = 1 THEN 'Automated'
    WHEN COALESCE(rpp_direct.adduserID, rpp_fallback.adduserID) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Manual'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS Automation_Type

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractSales_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw` fct

-- First choice: clean join on sales_id
LEFT JOIN rpp_clean rpp_direct
  ON SAFE_CAST(fct.sales_id AS INT64) = rpp_direct.salesID

-- Fallback logic if sales_id is missing
LEFT JOIN rpp_fallback_deduped rpp_fallback
  ON (
       (fct.sales_id IS NULL OR TRIM(fct.sales_id) = '')  -- Only fall back if sales_id is missing
       AND (
         (rpp_fallback.contract_job_or_product IN ('P', 'J') AND fct.sell_date = rpp_fallback.orderdate)
         OR
         (rpp_fallback.contract_job_or_product NOT IN ('P', 'J') OR rpp_fallback.contract_job_or_product IS NULL)
           AND fct.sell_date = rpp_fallback.adddate
       )
       AND IFNULL(fct.product_code, 'NA') = IFNULL(rpp_fallback.servicecode, 'NA')
       AND SAFE_CAST(fct.location_code AS INT64) = rpp_fallback.locationcode
       AND IFNULL(fct.sales_person_nm, 'NA') = IFNULL(rpp_fallback.salesperson, 'NA')
     )

WHERE (fct.sell_date_year > 2023 OR fct.start_date_year > 2023)

SELECT
  -- Geography metadata first
  d.RTX_Market_Name,
  d.RTX_Region_Code,
  d.RTX_Branch_Codes,
  d.RTX_Branch_Name,

    -- LeadState classification
  CASE
    WHEN b.scheduled_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Scheduled'
    WHEN DATE(b.scheduled_date) = DATE(b.received_date) THEN 'Scheduled (Overdue)'
    ELSE 'Scheduled (Future)'
  END AS LeadState,

  DATE(b.received_date) AS LeadDate,
  DATE(b.scheduled_date) AS ScheduleDate,

  -- Then rest of your fields
  b.business AS Brand,
  b.assigned_branch AS Branch,
  b.sales_employee AS Salesperson,
  b.lead_status AS LeadStatus,
  b.Created_By_Name AS LeadCreatedBy,
  b.lead_type AS LeadType,
  b.primary_pest AS PrimaryPest,
  b.contact_name AS Name,
  b.contact_address AS Address,
  b.contact_city AS City,
  b.contact_state AS State,
  b.contact_zip_code AS ZipCode,
  b.contact_phone AS Phone,
  b.contact_email AS Email,
  b.market_type AS CustomerType,

  -- Schedule window in hours
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(b.scheduled_date, b.received_date, HOUR) AS ScheduleWindow_Hours

FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference_User_Managed.BDRLeadsTable` b

LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Branch_BranchID_NA_T1_Vw` d
ON
  b.assigned_branch = d.current_state_branch_code

WHERE
  (
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) = 2
    AND DATE(b.received_date) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )
  OR
  (
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) != 2
    AND DATE(b.received_date) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )
  AND b.lead_status IN ('Sales_Qualified_Lead', 'Scheduled')
  AND b.assigned_branch IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY
  d.RTX_Market_Name,
  d.RTX_Branch_Codes,
  CASE
    WHEN b.scheduled_date IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN DATE(b.scheduled_date) = DATE(b.received_date) THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END

SELECT
  Business,
  Market,
  Region,
  BranchName AS Branch,
  Sales_Person AS Salesperson,
  Lead_Status,
  Created_By_Name AS Lead_Created_By,
  Lead_Type AS Lead_Type,
  Lead_Source AS Lead_Source,
  Primary_Pest AS Primary_Pest,
  Received_Date AS Lead_Date,
  Scheduled_Date AS Scheduled_Date,
  Prospect_Name AS Name,
  Address,
  City,
  State,
  Zip_Code AS Zip_Code,
  Contact_Number AS Phone,
  ContactEmail AS Email,
  Market_Type AS Customer_Type
FROM
  `bidata-us-production.ProspectPipelineNA.vRNA_TMX_SALES_COMBINED`
WHERE
  Lead_Status IN (
    '1. Not Scheduled',
    '2. Scheduled (Overdue)',
    '3. Scheduled (Future)'
  )
  AND (
    (
      -- If today is Monday, include Friday-Sunday
      EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) = 2
      AND DATE(Received_Date) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )
    OR (
      -- If not Monday, just include yesterday
      EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) != 2
      AND DATE(Received_Date) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  Market,
  BranchName,
  SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(Lead_Status, 1, 1) AS INT64)  -- Sort by numeric prefix (1, 2, 3)

 li.scheduled_date,

              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then min(eff_date) end as contacts_stage_date 
              ,case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as mql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as sql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Scheduled' then min(eff_date) end as scheduled_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Inspected' then min(eff_date) end as inspected_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Proposed' then min(eff_date) end as proposed_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sold' then min(eff_date) end as sold_stage_date
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when  assignment_value in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data') then 'bad_source' when  lower(assignment_value) like ('%duplicate%') then 'duplicate' else 'include' end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment` )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid   
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid)) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid

    BillToCode,

    SetupInvoiceOrderNum    AS salesID,

    orderNum,

    division,  
  CASE
    WHEN division IN ('C', 'DC', 'SCH') THEN 'COM'
    WHEN division = 'R' THEN 'RES'
    WHEN division IN ('NATION', 'NATIONAL' ) THEN 'NAT'
    ELSE 'UNIDENTIFIED'
  END AS MarketType,
  contract_Job_or_Product  AS ServiceType,
  UPPER(TRIM(serviceCode)) AS ProductCode,
  productGroup             AS ProductGroup,
  serviceDesc,
  SellDate,  
  CASE
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' AND sTbl = 'SS' THEN IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(StartDate AS DATE))
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product IN ('P' , 'J', 'I') AND sTbl = 'IN' AND `type` <> 'NS' THEN startDate
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' AND setupID is null AND sTbl = 'IN' AND `type` <> 'NS' THEN startDate
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(NULL AS DATE)
  END AS StartDate,
  cancelDate               AS CancelDate,
  MarketCode               AS MarketCode,

  (CASE WHEN LENGTH(branchID) = 4 THEN LPAD(CAST(branchID AS STRING), 4,'0') ELSE LPAD(CAST(branchID AS STRING), 3,'0') END) AS AssignedBranch,
  (CASE WHEN LENGTH(ServiceBranchID) = 4 THEN LPAD(CAST(ServiceBranchID AS STRING), 4,'0') ELSE LPAD(CAST(ServiceBranchID AS STRING), 3,'0') END) AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  postalCode               AS Geography,

  JobNonINIValue,
  (InitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)                             AS TotalJobValue,
  (ContractValue + ExcessInitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)       AS TotalValue,
  (ContractValue_calc + ExcessInitialValue + JobNonRecurringValue)  AS TotalValue_calc,
  (JobINIValue + JobNonINIValue)                                    AS TotalJobValue_v2,
  (ContractValue + JobINIValue + JobNonINIValue )                   AS TotalValue_v2,
  ContractCount,  
  ExcessInitialCount,
  JobNonRecurringCount,
  JobRecurringCount,
  TotalJobCount,
  JobINICount,
  JobNonINICount,
  (ContractCount + ExcessInitialCount + JobNonRecurringCount)       AS TotalCount,
  (ContractCount + JobNonINICount)                                  AS TotalCount_v2,
  CASE
    WHEN (firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate IS NOT NULL OR StartDate IS NOT NULL) 
          AND contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' 
          AND sTbl = 'SS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product IN ('P' , 'J', 'I') 
          AND sTbl = 'IN' 
          AND `type` <> 'NS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    WHEN contract_Job_or_Product = 'C' 
          AND setupID IS NULL 
          AND sTbl = 'IN' 
          AND `type` <> 'NS' 
          THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS StartedYN,
  cancelReason,
  CASE
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) OR (IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) ) THEN ('Y')  
    ELSE ('N')
  END AS IndTAP_YN,
  CASE
    WHEN (IFNULL(tech3_TechSoldID,0) <> 0) THEN ('TechSale')
    WHEN ((IFNULL(tech5_TechLeadID,0) <> 0) AND (IFNULL(tech4_SalesPersonSoldID,0) <> 0)) THEN ('TechLead')

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    CURRENT_DATE() AS today,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) AS day_of_week -- Sunday=1 ... Saturday=7
),
next_business_day AS (
  SELECT
    today,
    CASE 
      WHEN day_of_week = 6 THEN DATE_ADD(today, INTERVAL 3 DAY) -- Friday=6, so Monday next business day
      ELSE DATE_ADD(today, INTERVAL 1 DAY) -- otherwise tomorrow
    END AS next_bus_day,
    day_of_week,
    CASE 
      WHEN day_of_week = 6 THEN DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(today, INTERVAL 3 DAY), INTERVAL 2 DAY) -- version 1 end date if Friday (Mon+Sat+Sun)
      ELSE DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(today, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 0 DAY) -- version 1 end date otherwise
    END AS version_1_end_date
  FROM params
),
date_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    today,
    next_bus_day,
    day_of_week,
    version_1_end_date,
    DATE_ADD(version_1_end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS version_2_start_date,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(version_1_end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 13 DAY) AS version_2_end_date
  FROM next_business_day
),
base_query AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(COALESCE(IFNULL(F.scheduled_date, F.scheduled_stage_date), F.received_date)) AS daily_check_in_date,
    F.lead_ID,
    F.business,
    F.brand,
    F.assigned_branch,
    B.market_nm AS RTX_Market_Name,
    B.region_cd AS RTX_Region_Code,
    CONCAT(B.coa_branch_num, ' - ', B.branch_nm) AS RTX_Branch_Name,
    F.sales_employee,
    F.sales_employee_id,
    E1.job_code AS Sales_Employee_Job_Code,
    F.market_type,
    F.lead_type,
    F.lead_source,
    F.lead_channel_1,
    F.lead_channel_2,
    F.primary_pest,
    F.primary_pest_report_group,
    F.primary_pest_type_1,
    F.primary_pest_solution,
    F.contact_name,
    F.contact_address,
    F.contact_city,
    F.contact_state,
    F.contact_zip_code,
    F.contact_phone,
    F.contact_email,
    F.lead_status,
    DATE(F.received_date) AS received_date,
    DATE(IFNULL(F.scheduled_date, F.scheduled_stage_date)) AS scheduled_date,
    DATE(IFNULL(F.inspected_date, F.inspected_stage_date)) AS inspected_date,
    DATE(IFNULL(F.proposed_date, F.proposed_stage_date)) AS proposed_date,
    DATE(IFNULL(F.sold_date, F.sold_stage_date)) AS sold_date,
    F.services_proposed,
    F.value_proposed,
    F.services_sold,
    F.value_sold_raw,
    F.value_sold_started,
    DATE(F.cancel_date) AS cancel_date,
    F.cancel_reason,
    F.created_by_employee_id,
    CONCAT(E2.last_name, ', ', E2.first_name) AS Created_By_Employee_Name,
    E2.job_code AS Created_By_Employee_Job_Code,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE(COALESCE(IFNULL(F.scheduled_date, F.scheduled_stage_date), F.received_date)) BETWEEN date_ranges.today AND date_ranges.version_1_end_date THEN '2 Days'
      WHEN DATE(COALESCE(IFNULL(F.scheduled_date, F.scheduled_stage_date), F.received_date)) BETWEEN date_ranges.version_2_start_date AND date_ranges.version_2_end_date THEN 'Future'
      ELSE 'Outside Range'
    END AS date_window_flag
  FROM 
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Vw` F
  LEFT JOIN 
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch` B
    ON F.assigned_branch = B.branch_num
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` E1
    ON F.sales_employee_id = E1.Employee_Number
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` E2
    ON F.created_by_employee_id = E2.Employee_Number
  CROSS JOIN date_ranges
)

WITH
params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS end_ts,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()), 7) DAY) AS end_date_wk
),

caseQuery AS (
  SELECT
    cases.customer_case_id,
    reason.case_category_name AS reason,
    subreason.case_sub_category_name AS subreason,
    cases.location_code AS location,
    cases.customer_type AS customerType,
    cases.created_at AS caseCreatedDateTimeUTC,
    mapping.customer_ticket_id,
    cases.district_id,
    cases.call_notes AS caseNotes,
    createdby.employee_name AS caseCreatedBy,
    cases.contact_type AS contactType,
    CASE WHEN mapping.customer_ticket_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS FCR,
    CASE WHEN mapping.customer_ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS TicketFlag
  FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.customer_case` AS cases
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.case_category` AS reason
    ON cases.case_category_id = reason.case_category_id
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.case_sub_category` AS subreason
    ON cases.case_sub_category_id = subreason.case_sub_category_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.customer_case_ticket_mapping`
    WHERE DATE(updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
  ) AS mapping
    ON cases.customer_case_id = mapping.customer_case_id
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.employee` AS createdby
    ON cases.created_by = createdby.employee_id
  WHERE DATE(createdby.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
),

ticketQuery AS (
  SELECT
    tickets.customer_district_code AS did,
    brmp.coa_branch_num AS branchCode,
    brmp.branch_num AS branchNum,
    brmp.branch_nm AS branchName,
    brmp.region_cd AS region,
    brmp.market_cd AS market,
    tickets.customer_ticket_id,
    tickets.customer_ticket_ref AS ref,
    tickets.customer_account_name AS name,
    type.ticket_type_description AS type2,
    subtype.ticket_type_detail_description AS subtype2,
    tickets.date_time_created AS dateTimeCreatedUTC,
    createdby.employee_email AS createdBy,
    assignee.employee_email AS assignee,
    assignee.employee_name AS assignee_name,
    tickets.date_time_closed AS dateTimeClosedUTC,
    severity.ticket_severity_description AS severity,
    status.ticket_status_description AS status,
    resolution.resolution_description AS resolutionReason,
    tickets.follow_up_count AS chaseCount,
    CASE
      WHEN tickets.department_id IS NOT NULL THEN department.department_name
      ELSE tickets.customer_district_code
    END AS assignedLocation,
    tickets.location,
    department.department_name AS department,
    tickets.customer_ticket_notes AS ticketNotes,
    CASE
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Critical"
           AND status.ticket_status_description = "Closed"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tickets.date_time_closed, tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 2
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Critical"
           AND status.ticket_status_description != "Closed"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 2
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "High"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tickets.date_time_closed, tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 2
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "High"
           AND status.ticket_status_description != "Closed"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 2
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Medium"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tickets.date_time_closed, tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 24
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Medium"
           AND status.ticket_status_description != "Closed"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 24
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Low"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tickets.date_time_closed, tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 48
        THEN "1"
      WHEN severity.ticket_severity_description = "Low"
           AND status.ticket_status_description != "Closed"
           AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), tickets.date_time_created, HOUR) > 48
        THEN "1"
      ELSE NULL
    END AS OverdueStatus
  FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.customer_ticket` AS tickets
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.ticket_type` AS type
    ON tickets.ticket_type_id = type.ticket_type_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.ticket_type_detail`
    WHERE DATE(updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
  ) AS subtype
    ON tickets.ticket_type_detail_id = subtype.ticket_type_detail_id
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.ticket_status` AS status
    ON tickets.ticket_status_id = status.ticket_status_id
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.ticket_severity` AS severity
    ON tickets.ticket_severity_id = severity.ticket_severity_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.ticket_resolution`
    WHERE DATE(updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
  ) AS resolution
    ON tickets.ticket_resolution_id = resolution.ticket_resolution_id
  LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.tickets_us.employee` AS createdby
    ON tickets.employee_id_created_by = createdby.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT employee_id, employee_name, employee_email
    FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.employee`
    WHERE DATE(updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
  ) AS assignee
    ON tickets.employee_id_actioner = assignee.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT department_id, department_name
    FROM `data-shared-production.tickets_us.department`
    WHERE DATE(updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
  ) AS department
    ON tickets.department_id = department.department_id
  LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch` AS brmp
    ON brmp.branch_num = tickets.customer_district_code
  WHERE
    DATE(tickets.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND DATE(type.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND DATE(status.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND DATE(severity.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND DATE(createdby.updated_at) > DATE '2000-01-01'
)

SELECT
  -- cases
  cq.customer_case_id AS CaseId,

  tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC AS TicketCreatedDateTime,
  tq.dateTimeClosedUTC AS TicketClosedDateTime,
  ROUND(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC, tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC, HOUR) / 24.0, 2) AS daysToClose,
  tq.assignedLocation,
  tq.severity,
  tq.status,
  tq.department AS DepartmentName,
  tq.chaseCount,
  tq.resolutionReason,
  tq.OverdueStatus,
  tq.assignee AS EmployeeAssignedTo,

  -- open week flags using params.end_date_wk
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_ADD(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_ADD(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 7 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS current_week,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= p.end_date_wk
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > p.end_date_wk)
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_0,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 7 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_1,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 14 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_2,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 21 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 21 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_3,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 28 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 28 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_4,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 35 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 35 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_5,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 42 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 42 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_6,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 49 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 49 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_7,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 56 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 56 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_8,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 63 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 63 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_9,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 70 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 70 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_10,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) <= DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 77 DAY)
     AND (tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL OR DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) > DATE_SUB(p.end_date_wk, INTERVAL 77 DAY))
    THEN 1 END AS open_week_11,

  -- attributes
  DATETIME(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) AS `Case Date Time Created Local`,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%I:%M:%S %p', cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) AS `Case Time Created Local`,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC)) AS `yyyy_mm_ticket`,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M', tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC) AS `Ticket Date Time Created`,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%m/%d/%Y %H:%M', tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) AS TicketClosedDateTime_2,
  tq.assignee_name AS `Employee Assigned To`,
  EXTRACT(WEEK FROM DATE(tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC)) + 1 AS `Open Week`,
  CASE
    WHEN tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF((SELECT end_ts FROM params), tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC, HOUR) / 24.0
  END AS `Avg Days Open`,
  DATE(tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC) AS `Created Date`,
  CASE
    WHEN tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NOT NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC, tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC, HOUR) / 24.0
  END AS `Avg Days to Close`,
  CASE
    WHEN tq.dateTimeClosedUTC IS NOT NULL
      THEN EXTRACT(WEEK FROM DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC)) + 1
  END AS `Close Week`,
  DATE(tq.dateTimeClosedUTC) AS `Closed Date`,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tq.dateTimeCreatedUTC) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) AS is_current_year,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T %Z', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS last_refreshed
FROM caseQuery cq
LEFT JOIN ticketQuery tq
  ON cq.customer_ticket_id = tq.customer_ticket_id
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE DATE(cq.caseCreatedDateTimeUTC) BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM params)
                                         AND DATE((SELECT end_ts FROM params));

count(distinct a.WorkInspectionID) as wocount

group by a.RTX_Market_Name, a.RTX_Region_Name,a.RTX_Branch_Details, a.BranchID,a.TechID,a.TechName

),
Q7 as (

ifnull(count(distinct a.WorkInspectionID),0) as Q7YesCount,

ifnull(count(a.WorkInspectionID)/(b.wocount),0) as Q7Yes

coalesce(Q7.Q7YesCount,0)                                     as YesCount,

ifnull  (Q7.Q7Yes,0)                                          as Q7Yes,
from Q7
right join WO on WO.BranchID = Q7.BranchID and WO.TechID = Q7.TechID

SELECT 
Market,
Region,
BranchName,
BranchID,
TechID,
sum(AnsweredAtLeastOneYes) as AtLeast1Yes,
sum(EligibleWO) as EligibleWO,
sum(AnsweredAtLeastOneYes)/sum(EligibleWO) PercentOneYes
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.Reports.Tap_WO_Question_Outcome` 
Group by Market,
Region,
BranchName,
BranchID,
TechID

with Yes_CTE as (
select 
RTX_Market_Name,
RTX_Region_Name,
RTX_Branch_Name,
RTX_Branch_Codes,
br.Current_State_Branch_Code,
concat(RTX_Branch_Name,'-',RTX_Branch_Codes) as BranchName,
ifnull(TechID,0) as TechID,
TechName,
concat(ifnull(TechID,0),'-',TechName) TechNameID,
count(distinct WorkInspectionID) YesWKOrders 
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_TAPReporting_WorkInspectionID_US_Daily_Dtls_Vw` wk
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Branch_BranchID_NA_T1_Vw` as br on  safe_cast(wk.BranchID as int) = safe_cast(br.Current_State_Branch_Code as int)
WHERE(
 Q2 = 'Yes' or
  Q3 = 'Yes' or
   Q4 = 'Yes' or
    Q5 = 'Yes' or
     Q6 = 'Yes' or
      Q7 = 'Yes' or
       Q8 = 'Yes' )
Group by  RTX_Market_Name,RTX_Region_Name,RTX_Branch_Name,RTX_Branch_Codes,TechID, TechName, TechNameID, Current_State_Branch_Code
),No_CTE as (
select
RTX_Market_Name,
RTX_Region_Name,
RTX_Branch_Name,
RTX_Branch_Codes,
br.Current_State_Branch_Code,
concat(RTX_Branch_Name,'-',RTX_Branch_Codes) as BranchName,
ifnull(TechID,0) as TechID,
TechName,
concat(ifnull(TechID,0),'-',TechName) TechNameID,
count(distinct WorkInspectionID) AllNoWKOrders 
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_TAPReporting_WorkInspectionID_US_Daily_Dtls_Vw` wk
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Branch_BranchID_NA_T1_Vw` as br on safe_cast(wk.BranchID as int) = safe_cast(br.Current_State_Branch_Code as int)
WHERE(
 Q2 = 'No' and
  Q3 = 'No' and
   Q4 = 'No' and
    Q5 = 'No' and
     Q6 = 'No' and
      Q7 = 'No' and
       Q8 <> 'Yes' )
Group by  RTX_Market_Name,RTX_Region_Name,RTX_Branch_Name,RTX_Branch_Codes,TechID, TechName, TechNameID,br.Current_State_Branch_Code
), WorkOrders as(

select 
RTX_Market_Name,
RTX_Region_Name,
RTX_Branch_Name,
RTX_Branch_Codes,
br.Current_State_Branch_Code,
concat(RTX_Branch_Name,'-',RTX_Branch_Codes) as BranchName,
ifnull(TechID,0) as TechID,
TechName,
concat(ifnull(TechID,0),'-',TechName) TechNameID,
count(distinct WorkInspectionID) WOCounts
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_TAPReporting_WorkInspectionID_US_Daily_Dtls_Vw` wk
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Branch_BranchID_NA_T1_Vw` as br on safe_cast(wk.BranchID as int) = safe_cast(br.Current_State_Branch_Code as int)
Group by  RTX_Market_Name,RTX_Region_Name,RTX_Branch_Name,RTX_Branch_Codes,TechID, TechName, TechNameID,br.Current_State_Branch_Code
), FinalCte as (
select
a.RTX_Market_Name,
a.RTX_Region_Name,
a.RTX_Branch_Name,
a.RTX_Branch_Codes,
a.Current_State_Branch_Code,
a.BranchName,
a.TechID,
a.TechName,
a.TechNameID,
sum(a.YesWKOrders) as AtLeast1YesWO,
sum(ifnull (b.AllNoWKOrders,0)) as AllNoWkOrders,
sum(ifnull (c.WOCounts,0)) as WOCounts
from Yes_Cte a
left join No_Cte b on a.TechID = b.TechID 
and a.Current_State_Branch_Code = b.Current_State_Branch_Code
left join WorkOrders c 
on c.TechID = a.TechID
and a.Current_State_Branch_Code = c.Current_State_Branch_Code
group by a.RTX_Market_Name,
a.RTX_Region_Name,
a.RTX_Branch_Name,
a.RTX_Branch_Codes,
a.Current_State_Branch_Code,
a.BranchName,
a.TechID,
a.TechName,
a.TechNameID
) 

select 
RTX_Market_Name,
RTX_Region_Name,
RTX_Branch_Name,
RTX_Branch_Codes,
Current_State_Branch_Code,
BranchName,
TechID,
TechName,
TechNameID,
sum(AtLeast1YesWO) as AtLeast1YesWO,
sum(AllNoWKOrders) as AllNoWkOrders,
sum(WOCounts) as WOCounts,
sum(FinalCTE.AtLeast1YesWO)/sum(FinalCTE.WOCounts) as Q2_Q8PrnctYes
from FinalCTE
group by
RTX_Market_Name,
RTX_Region_Name,
RTX_Branch_Name,
RTX_Branch_Codes,
Current_State_Branch_Code,
BranchName,
TechID,
TechName,
TechNameID

with usagerate as (
select 
Market,
Region,
BranchID,
BranchName,
TechID,
TechName,
sum(AnsweredAtLeastOneYes)/sum(EligibleWO) as UsageRate
from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reports.Tap_WO_Question_Outcome` 
group by Market,
Region,
BranchID,
BranchName,
TechID,
TechName
),
techusage as (
select 
Market,
Region,
BranchID,
BranchName,
TechID,
TechName,
case when usagerate.UsageRate >.5 then 1 else 0 end as TechUsage
from usagerate
)
select 

usagerate.Market,
usagerate.Region,
usagerate.BranchID,
usagerate.BranchName,
usagerate.TechID,
usagerate.TechName,
sum(techusage.TechUsage)/count(distinct techusage.TechID) TechUsageRate
From usagerate 
join techusage on usagerate.Market = techusage.Market
and usagerate.Region = techusage.Region
and usagerate.BranchID = techusage.BranchID
and usagerate.TechID = techusage.TechID 
group by 
usagerate.Market,
usagerate.Region,
usagerate.BranchID,
usagerate.BranchName,
usagerate.TechID,
usagerate.TechName

select *,
case 
  WHEN Days > 365 THEN '365+'
  WHEN Days between 241 and 365 THEN '241-365' 
  WHEN Days between 211 and 240 THEN '211-240' 
  WHEN Days between 181 and 210	THEN '181-210'
  WHEN Days between 151 and 180 THEN '151-180'
  WHEN Days between 121 and 150	THEN '121-150'
  WHEN Days between 91 and 120	THEN '91-120'
  WHEN Days between 61 and 90	THEN '61-90'
  WHEN Days between 31 and 60	THEN '31-60'
  WHEN Days > 0 and Days <= 30 THEN '0-30'
  ELSE '0' end as Age,
  case
  WHEN Days > 365               THEN 10
  WHEN Days between 241 and 365 THEN 9
  WHEN Days between 211 and 240 THEN 8
  WHEN Days between 181 and 210 THEN 7
  WHEN Days between 151 and 180 THEN 6
  WHEN Days between 121 and 150 THEN 5
  WHEN Days between 91 and 120  THEN 4
  WHEN Days between 61 and 90   THEN 3
  WHEN Days between 31 and 60   THEN 2
  WHEN Days > 0 and Days <= 30  THEN 1
  ELSE 0 
end as SortAge,


EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Invoice_Date)  AS InvYear,
EXTRACT(MONTH FROM Invoice_Date) AS InvMonth
from(
select * ,
DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), invoice_date, DAY) AS Days
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.VwUnf_ar_detail`
--where Invoice_number = '6382765'
) as a

SELECT 
  p.src_system,
  p.snp_date,
  extract(year from date_sub((p.snp_date), interval 5 day)) * 100 + extract(month from date_sub(p.snp_date, interval 5 day)) as yearmonth,
  p.insert_date,
  cast(p.contract_id as string) as contract_id,
  p.effective_date,
  case 
    when date_diff(cast(p.snp_date as date), cast(p.effective_date as date), month) <= 0 then "Neg or zero months"
    when date_diff(cast(p.snp_date as date), cast(p.effective_date as date), month) = 1 then "1 month"
    when date_diff(cast(p.snp_date as date), cast(p.effective_date as date), month) <= 60 then concat(cast(date_diff(cast(p.snp_date as date), cast(p.effective_date as date), month) as string), " months")
    else ">60 months"
  end as tenure,
  p.service_code,
  s.service_line1_short as lob,
  p.market_type as customer_type,
  p.business_unit as branch_code,
  p.class_code,
  p.zip,
  p.annual_value,
  p.base_quantity as units,
  COALESCE(servline_rtx.ServiceLine, 'Unknown') AS root_serviceline,
  COALESCE(servline_rtx.template_productcode, 'Unknown') AS template_productcode,
  CASE
    WHEN s.service_line1_short = 'TC' THEN 'Y'
    WHEN pc.Portfolio_startdate <= date_sub(DATETIME(p.snp_date), interval 1 day) 
         AND s.service_line1_short <> 'TC' 
         AND pc.Portfolio_startdate is not null THEN 'Y' 
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS Portfolio_Started_ind,
  pc.Portfolio_startdate
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly` p
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` s 
  ON p.service_code = s.service_line_code
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_Dim_TDW_Portfolio_Serviceline` servline_rtx 
  ON p.contract_id = servline_rtx.sales_agreement_number 
  AND p.service_code = servline_rtx.service_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Current` pc 
  ON pc.contract_id = CAST(p.contract_id AS STRING) 
  AND p.service_code = pc.service_code;

WITH customer_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Contract,
    CustomerID,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY Contract
      ORDER BY Contract -- Replace with your actual ordering column
    ) AS rn
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.ResidentialDataTables.TDW_Contract_Customer_List`
),

customer_earliest AS (
  SELECT Contract, CustomerID
  FROM customer_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),

enriched_portfolio AS (
  SELECT 
    p.* EXCEPT(multiple_template_products_flag),
    c.CustomerID
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.Custom_Data_Tables.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly_v2_CT` p
  LEFT JOIN customer_earliest c 
    ON CAST(p.contract_id AS STRING) = CAST(c.Contract AS STRING)
),

lob_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    DATE(portfolio_startdate) AS portfolio_start_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lob) AS lob_count
  FROM enriched_portfolio
  GROUP BY CustomerID, DATE(portfolio_startdate)
)

SELECT 
  ep.*,
  CASE 
    WHEN ep.service_code LIKE 'U%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0 
  END AS Prebundle_YN,
  CASE 
    WHEN lc.lob_count > 2 AND ep.service_code NOT LIKE 'U%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0 
  END AS Multi_LOB_Flag
FROM enriched_portfolio ep
LEFT JOIN lob_counts lc 
  ON ep.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
     AND DATE(ep.portfolio_startdate) = lc.portfolio_start_date;

    WHEN IFNULL(service_line1_long, '') IN ('Merchandise Sales') THEN 'Other'
    WHEN IFNULL(service_line1_long, '') IN ('Pest Mosquito')     THEN 'Pest Control'
    ELSE IFNULL(service_line1_long, '')
  END AS service_line1_long,
  IFNULL(sa_type_code, '') sa_type_code,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.Mapped_Service)) AS ProductCode,  -- Moved here next to sa_type_code
  service_type_code,
  service_line_code,
  item_code,
  a.TMX_SA_item_SID,

  a.item_type_code,

  a.rawsale_amt,
  (is_cvForStartedUnits *
    (
        initial_value_cv

        WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * PI.OriginalPrice -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.

        WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
      ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
      END
  END AS ContractValue,

  --Added on 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation.
  CASE
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END                                         AS ContractValue_calc,

      ELSE CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE) 
   END)  AS  SalesDate, -- Reference and used for Reporting_Month and Date
  UPPER(d_bch.market_nm)                                 AS `Service_Market`, 
  d_bch.region_cd                                        AS `Service_Region`,
  TRIM(d_bch.branch_num)                                 AS Service_Branch_Num,

  CASE
      WHEN ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND ss.TechID3 IS NULL THEN PEmp5.Branch
      WHEN ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN PEmp3.Branch
  END AS `Tech_Branch`,
  CASE
      WHEN ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND ss.TechID3 IS NULL THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(EMP5.EmployeeNum, '[^0-9]', '')
      WHEN ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(EMP3.EmployeeNum, '[^0-9]', '')
  END AS `Tech_Employee_Number`,
  CASE
      WHEN ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND ss.TechID3 IS NULL THEN CONCAT(INITCAP(EMP5.fname),' ',INITCAP(EMP5.lname))
      WHEN ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(INITCAP(EMP3.fname),' ',INITCAP(EMP3.lname))
  END AS `Tech_Name`,
  ss.setupID                            AS SetupID,
  'C'                                   AS Dataset,
  ss.SetupType                          AS SetupType,
  loc.locationid                        AS LocationID,
  loc.locationcode                      AS LocationCode,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(loc.Company)) > 0 THEN UPPER(TRIM(loc.Company))     
    ELSE UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(TRIM(loc.LName), ', ', TRIM(loc.FName)))) 
  END AS `CustomerName`,
  ss.SetupType                           AS InvoiceType,  
  CAST('' AS STRING)                     AS Invoice_Number,
  CAST(ss.Initial AS INT)                AS Initial,
  CASE 
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'R' THEN 'Contract' 
    WHEN (LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 OR LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 5) AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'J' THEN 'Job'
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'P' THEN 'Product'
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) IN ('D','F') THEN 'Other'
    WHEN  CL.Code IS NULL THEN 'Unclassified' 
  END                                    AS ServiceClassType, 
  CL.code                                AS `Service_Class`,
  ss.servicecode                         AS `Service_Code`,
  UPPER(SRV.description)                 AS `Service_Code_Description`,
  CASE
    WHEN ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND ss.TechID3 IS NULL THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Direct'
  END AS `SalesGrouping`, --`Service Grouping`,  
  CASE WHEN ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN ss.TechShare3 END AS `Sales_Share`, --- 06/16/2025 Modified during testing for SalesShare
  CASE WHEN ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND ss.TechID3 IS NULL THEN ss.TechShare5 END AS `Lead_Share`,
  MAX(CAST(ss.StartDate AS DATE)) AS StartDate_SS,
 -- Adjusting the code for Migrated items into RPP. Migration only pull the outstanding Invoices so we need to pull the AddDate rather first InvoiceDate. 
 -- BI-7842
 -- Updated 12/8/25 - SM - Migrated Items in PP only pull outstanding invoices meaning the StartDate is incorrect. This will pull in the AddDate of the Contract if Migrated. userdef19 = Old Setup# in PestPac UI
  MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,'')) AS migrated_num,
  CASE 
    WHEN MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,'')) != '' THEN  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE) --If Migrated Data then use the contract adddate
    ELSE CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) ---firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate 07/31/2025 
  END AS StartDate, 

  CASE 
    WHEN MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,''))  = '' AND  (i.invoicedate IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y'  -- Not Migrated 
    WHEN MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,'')) != '' AND  (ss.adddate IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y' -- Migrated and with a AddDate. Indicates Started
    ELSE 'N' 
  END AS StartedYN,
  CAST(ss.CancelDate AS DATE) AS CancelDate, 
  CASE 
    WHEN (ss.CancelDate IS NULL)  THEN 'No'
    WHEN MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,'')) != '' AND CAST(ss.CancelDate AS DATE) <= CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE) THEN 'Yes'  -- Migrated Items, look at adddate
    WHEN MAX(IFNULL(ss.userdef19,'')) != '' AND CAST(ss.CancelDate AS DATE) > CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE) THEN 'No'  -- Migrated Items, look at adddate
    WHEN (i.invoicedate IS NULL) AND (ss.CancelDate IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes'  --Nonmigrated with a cancel date
    WHEN CAST(ss.CancelDate AS DATE) <= CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) THEN 'Yes'  --Canceldate prior to invoicedate 
    WHEN CAST(ss.CancelDate AS DATE) > CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) THEN 'No'  --Cancel after invoicedate
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `Same_Day_Cancel`, -- Added By Steven. Saw in spRouteOne_Sales   -- Changed to invoicedate 07/31/2025
  0 AS  `Canceled_Visits`,
  0 AS `Frequency_Calc_withskip`,
  freq_code                            AS `Frequency_code`,
  SUM(V.portfolio_CurrentTotal)        AS portfolio_CurrentTotal,             
  V.skip                               AS `Skip`,
  V.annualoccurrences                  AS `Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable`,
  PI.OriginalPrice                     AS `OriginalPrice_fromPriceincreaseTable`,
  SUM(ss.subtotal)                     AS `Subtotal`,
  0 AS `Route_1_Sales_Share_Applied`,
  0 AS AnnualValue,
  loc.city        AS customer_city,
  loc.state       AS customer_state,
  LEFT(loc.zip,5) AS customer_zip
FROM 
( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY setupid ORDER BY setupid, GCP_Runtime desc) rownum , ssall.*  
    FROM 
         (SELECT * 
             FROM `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.ServiceSetups` ss1 
        UNION all 
        SELECT * FROM `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.ServiceSetupsTemp` sst 
           ) ssall
) ss 
LEFT JOIN `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.Services`                   AS srv    ON    ss.servicecode = srv.code
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Employees`             AS emp3   ON    ss.techid3 = emp3.techid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Employees`             AS emp5   ON    ss.techid5 = emp5.techid 
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Branches`              AS rpp_bch      ON    ss.BranchID = rpp_bch.BranchID
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch`              AS d_bch    ON    CASE 
                                                                                    WHEN LENGTH(rpp_bch.GLSuffix) < 3 
                                                                                      THEN LPAD(CAST(rpp_bch.GLSuffix AS STRING),3,'0') = d_bch.branch_num
                                                                                    ELSE rpp_bch.GLSuffix = d_bch.branch_num
                                                                                  END
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.BranchSubRegions`      AS sb     ON    rpp_bch.subregionid = sb.subregionid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Locations`             AS loc    ON    ss.locationid  = loc.locationid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.BillTos`               AS bt     ON    bt.billtoid = loc.billtoid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Types`                 AS typ    ON    loc.typeid = typ.typeid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Classes`               AS cl     ON    srv.classid = cl.classid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Routes`                AS rt     ON    ss.routeid = rt.routeid
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Divisions`             AS dvs    ON    bt.DivisionID = dvs.DivisionID AND dvs.Active = true
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`      AS PEmp3  ON    ss.techid3 IS NOT NULL AND EMP3.EmployeeNum = PEmp3.Employee_Number
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`      AS PEmp5  ON    ss.techid5 IS NOT NULL AND EMP5.EmployeeNum = PEmp5.Employee_Number
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.vw_Dim_RPP_ServiceSetups_AnnualValue`  V     ON ss.setupID = V.setupid
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_RNA.vw_RPP_PriceIncrease_OriginalPrice` PI   ON ss.setupid = PI.setupid
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RPP_Portfolio_Activity_Daily`  PtActDly  ON PtActDly.SetupID = ss.setupid
LEFT JOIN 
          (SELECT setupid,invoicenum,invoicetype,productionnum,ordernum,invoicedate, 
                  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY setupid ORDER BY setupid,SAFE_CAST(invoicedate AS DATE)) AS rankValue 
            FROM `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.InvoiceCurrentHistory`WHERE invoicetype IN ('PR','IN','PI') ) i   ON  ss.setupid = i.setupid and rankValue = 1
                                                                                                                        AND (
                                                                                                                             (i.productionnum <> '' AND i.invoicetype = 'PR')
                                                                                                                             OR (IFNULL(i.ordernum,0) <> 0 AND i.invoicetype = 'IN') 
                                                                                                                             OR (i.invoicetype = 'PI' AND ss.setuptype = 'IN') 
                                                                                                                            )  
WHERE
    CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE()    
    AND CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE()
    AND i.invoicedate IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.rownum = 1     
    AND IFNULL(ss.SetupType, ' ') NOT IN ('IN','CE','CM','EA')   
                          -- IN = Invoice 
                          -- PR = Production
                          -- CE = Commission
                          -- CM = Credit Memo                               
    AND IFNULL(ss.serviceCode, ' ') NOT IN ('BALFWD', 'CREDITFWD')
    AND (ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL OR ss.TechID5 IS NOT NULL)
    AND (IFNULL(emp3.username, ' ') not like '%HOUSE%' OR IFNULL(emp5.username, ' ') not like '%HOUSE%')    
    AND SRV.description NOT LIKE '%INITIAL%'

GROUP BY
 ss.adddate, 
 rpp_bch.GLSuffix,
 loc.locationid,
 loc.locationCode,
 dvs.Code,
 loc.Company,
 loc.LName,
 loc.FName,
 ss.servicecode,
 SRV.description,
 ss.Initial,
 CL.code,
 ss.TechID3,
 ss.TechID5,
 EMP3.username,
 EMP3.fname,
 EMP3.lname,
 EMP3.jobtitle,
 EMP3.EmployeeNum,
 ss.TechShare3,
 EMP5.username,
 EMP5.fname,
 EMP5.lname,
 EMP5.jobtitle,
 EMP5.EmployeeNum,
 ss.TechShare5,
 ss.setupid,
 ss.SetupType, 
 i.invoiceDate,
 ss.CancelDate,
 freq_code,
 PI.OriginalPrice,
 V.skip,
 V.annualoccurrences,
 d_bch.branch_num,
 d_bch.coa_branch_num,
 d_bch.market_nm,
 d_bch.region_cd,
 d_bch.branch_nm,
 d_bch.branch_state_cd,
 PEmp5.Branch,
 PEmp3.Branch,
 loc.city,
 loc.state,
 loc.zip 
 )
 , Occurances_tb1 as (
 select distinct 
	setupid, 
	Frequency_code,
	Skip,	
	(CASE 
        WHEN Frequency_code = 'OTHER' AND Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable = 0 AND Subtotal > 0 THEN  ROUND(portfolio_CurrentTotal / Subtotal,0)
        WHEN Frequency_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260  --260 due to business days
        WHEN Frequency_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5)  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
        WHEN Frequency_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
        WHEN Frequency_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip  -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
        WHEN Frequency_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN 1 -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
        WHEN Frequency_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY','WEEKLY', 'BIWEEKLY') AND Skip = 0 THEN Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
         ELSE Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable
         END) AS `Frequency_Calc_withskip`
	FROM t1   
 )
 , t2 AS (
 SELECT	
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y',StartDate)                        AS Reporting_Year, -- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  FORMAT_DATE('%b',StartDate)                        AS Reporting_Month, -- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d-%Y', StartDate)                 AS Reporting_Date, -- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  SalesDate,         -- Reference and used for Reporting_Month and Date
	Service_Market,
	Service_Region,
  Service_Branch_Num, 
	Service_Branch,
	State,
	Division,
	Tech_Branch,
	Tech_Employee_Number,
	Tech_Name,
	t1.SetupID,
	Dataset,
	SetupType,
	LocationID,
	LocationCode,
	CustomerName,
	InvoiceType,
	Invoice_Number,
	Initial,
	ServiceClassType,
	Service_Class,
	Service_Code,
	Service_Code_Description,
	SalesGrouping,
	Sales_Share,
	Lead_Share,
	StartDate_ss,
  StartDate,
	CancelDate,
	Same_Day_Cancel,
	CAST (CASE 
    WHEN CancelDate IS NULL THEN 0 
    WHEN CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(StartDate AS DATE) <> CAST(CancelDate AS DATE) 
            AND DATE_DIFF(CAST(CancelDate AS DATE), CAST(StartDate AS DATE), DAY) < 365 
            AND o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip  > 0
      THEN o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip  - FLOOR(DATE_DIFF(CAST(CancelDate AS DATE), CAST(StartDate AS DATE), DAY) / (365/o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip))
    ELSE o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip 
    END as INT64) AS `Canceled_Visits`, 
  o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip,
	t1.Frequency_code,
	t1.Skip,
	Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable,
	OriginalPrice_fromPriceincreaseTable,
	Subtotal,
	Route_1_Sales_Share_Applied,
	AnnualValue,
	CASE 
    WHEN OriginalPrice_fromPriceincreaseTable > 0 
      THEN
        o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip * OriginalPrice_fromPriceincreaseTable
    ELSE
        o_tb1.Frequency_Calc_withskip * Subtotal
    END as TotalValue,
  customer_city,
  customer_state,
  customer_zip
FROM
	t1 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Occurances_tb1 o_tb1 ON t1.SetupID = o_tb1.SetupID AND t1.Frequency_code = o_tb1.Frequency_code AND t1.Skip = o_tb1.Skip 
  ) 
  SELECT
  Reporting_Year,
	Reporting_Month,
	Reporting_Date,
	SalesDate,
	Service_Market AS Service_Market_Name,
	Service_Region AS Service_Region_Num,
  Service_Branch_Num,
	Service_Branch AS Service_Branch_Name,
	State AS Service_Branch_State_Code,
	Division,
	Tech_Branch AS Tech_Branch_Num,
	Tech_Employee_Number AS Tech_Employee_Num,
	Tech_Name,
	SetupID,
	Dataset,
	SetupType,
	LocationID,
	LocationCode,
	CustomerName,
	InvoiceType,
	Invoice_Number,
	Initial,
	ServiceClassType,
	Service_Class,
	Service_Code,
	Service_Code_Description,
	SalesGrouping,
	Sales_Share,
	Lead_Share,
	StartDate_ss,
  StartDate,
	CancelDate,
	Same_Day_Cancel,
	CASE 
    WHEN Canceled_Visits > Frequency_Calc_withskip 
      THEN 
          Frequency_Calc_withskip 
      ELSE  
          Canceled_Visits 
      END AS Canceled_Visits, 
  Frequency_Calc_withskip AS Frequency_withskip,
	Frequency_code,
	Skip,
	Annualoccurences_fromFrequencyTable,
	OriginalPrice_fromPriceincreaseTable,
	Subtotal,
	CASE 
    WHEN SalesGrouping = 'Direct' ---ss.TechID3 IS NOT NULL 
        THEN       
           ( TotalValue * Sales_Share ) ---ss.TechShare3
    ELSE  
           ( TotalValue  * Lead_Share ) ---ss.TechShare5
    END AS Tech_Share_Amount,
	TotalValue AS AnnualValue, -- Same for both active and cancelled
  customer_city,
  customer_state,
  customer_zip
FROM
	t2

SELECT 
  /*
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y',I.OrderDate)                                    AS Reporting_Year, 
  FORMAT_DATE('%b',I.OrderDate)                                    AS Reporting_Month,
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d-%Y', I.OrderDate)                             AS Reporting_Date,
  */  
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y',CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE))                    AS Reporting_Year, -- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  FORMAT_DATE('%b',i.invoicedate)                                  AS Reporting_Month,-- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d-%Y', i.invoicedate)                           AS Reporting_Date,-- Switched to StartDate as per discussion with Annette
  SAFE_CAST(I.OrderDate AS DATE)                                   AS SalesDate,
  UPPER(bch.market_nm)                                             AS Service_Market_Name,
  bch.region_cd                                                    AS Service_Region_Num,
  TRIM(bch.branch_num)                                             AS Service_Branch_Num, 
  CONCAT(TRIM(CAST(bch.coa_branch_num AS STRING)), ' - ', UPPER(TRIM(bch.branch_nm)))  AS Service_Branch_Name,
  bch.branch_state_cd                                              AS Service_Branch_State_Code,
  CASE
    WHEN d.code = 'C' THEN 'COMMERCIAL'
    WHEN d.code = 'R' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
    WHEN d.code IN ('NATION', 'NATIONAL') THEN d.code
  ELSE '-'
  END AS Division, 
  CASE
      WHEN I.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND I.TechID3 IS NULL THEN PEmp5.Branch
      WHEN I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN PEmp3.Branch
  END AS Tech_Branch_Num,
  CASE
      WHEN I.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND I.TechID3 IS NULL THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(EMP5.EmployeeNum, '[^0-9]', '')
      WHEN I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(EMP3.EmployeeNum, '[^0-9]', '')
  END AS Tech_Employee_Num,
  CASE
      WHEN I.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND I.TechID3 IS NULL THEN CONCAT(INITCAP(EMP5.fname),' ',INITCAP(EMP5.lname))
      WHEN I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(INITCAP(EMP3.fname),' ',INITCAP(EMP3.lname))
  END AS Tech_Name,
  I.setupID                             AS SetupID,
  'J'                                   AS Dataset,
  CAST(null AS STRING)                  AS SetupType,
  L.locationid									        AS LocationID,
  L.locationcode 								        AS LocationCode,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(L.Company)) > 0 THEN UPPER(TRIM(L.Company)) 	
    ELSE UPPER(TRIM(CONCAT(TRIM(L.LName), ', ', TRIM(L.FName)))) 
  END AS CustomerName,
  I.InvoiceType				  								AS InvoiceType,
  CASE 
    WHEN I.InvoiceType in ('PR','CE') THEN CAST(I.ProductionNum AS STRING)
    ELSE CAST(I.InvoiceNum AS STRING) 
  END AS Invoice_Number,
  CAST(I.Initial AS INT)								AS Initial,
  CASE 
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'R' THEN 'Contract' 
    WHEN (LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 OR LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 5) AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'J' THEN 'Job'
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) = 'P' THEN 'Product'
    WHEN  LENGTH(TRIM(CL.Code)) = 4 AND RIGHT(UPPER(CL.Code), 1) IN ('D','F') THEN 'Other'
    WHEN  CL.Code IS NULL THEN 'Unclassified' 
  END		AS ServiceClassType, 
  CL.code				  				  		        AS Service_Class,
  I.servicecode								        	AS Service_Code,
  UPPER(SRV.description)								AS Service_Code_Description,
  CASE
    WHEN I.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND I.TechID3 IS NULL THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Direct'
  END AS SalesGrouping,  
  CASE WHEN I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN I.TechShare3 END AS Sales_Share,   -- Changed THEN TechShare5 to TechShare3
  CASE WHEN I.TechID5 IS NOT NULL AND I.TechID3 IS NULL THEN I.TechShare5 END AS Lead_Share,
  CAST(null AS DATE)                   AS StartDate_ss,
  CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE)          AS StartDate,
  'Y' AS StartedYN, --All are started since InvoiceType = NS is excluded in the WHERE clause
  CAST(null AS DATE)                   AS CancelDate,
  'No'                                 AS Same_Day_Cancel, 
  0                                    AS Canceled_Visits, 
  1                                    AS Frequency_withskip,       
  CASE 
    WHEN  I.TechID3 IS NOT NULL THEN SUM(Subtotal) * I.TechShare3
    ELSE  SUM(Subtotal) * I.TechShare5
  END  AS Tech_Share_Amount,
  SUM(I.subtotal)                      AS AnnualValue,
  l.city        AS customer_city,
  l.state       AS customer_state,
  LEFT(l.zip,5) AS customer_zip
FROM 
`data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.InvoiceCurrentHistory`           AS i
LEFT JOIN `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.Services`                   AS srv    ON    i.servicecode = srv.code
LEFT JOIN `data-shared-production.ppnw_dbo.Employees`             AS emp3   ON    i.techid3 = emp3.techid

	serviceCode ,

	"-",

	workdate
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		ss.setupid ,
		ss.adddate adddate_ss,
		i.invoicenum ,
		i.ordernum,
		i.productionnum ,
		i.invoicetype ,

		sso.description AS serviceDesc,
		ifnull(CAST(format_date('%Y%m%d',
		i.workdate) AS int64),
		0) AS workdate_yyymmdd,
		i.workdate,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.setupid,
		ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping,
		'')
	ORDER BY
		i.workdate) AS rn,
		CASE
			WHEN i.initial THEN 'Y'
			ELSE 'N'
		END AS ini_ind
	FROM
		`bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.ServiceSetups ss
	INNER JOIN `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.InvoiceCurrentHistory i ON
		ss.setupid = i.setupid
		AND 
		(
			(i.productionnum <> ''
			AND i.invoicetype = 'PR') 
			OR 
			(ifnull(i.ordernum,0) <> 0
			AND i.invoicetype = 'IN') 
		)
	LEFT JOIN `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Services sso
ON
		i.servicecode = sso.code

ON
		trim(ifnull(refservcode.service_class, '')) = trim(ifnull(ss.servicecode, ''))

		AND 
		CASE
			WHEN i.initial THEN 'Y'
			ELSE 'N'
		END = 'N'
) q

WITH ordered_salesContractgroup as (
 SELECT  
  'SS' 															as sTbl,
  'RPP' 														as source,    
  CASE WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('R') THEN 'C'
       WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('J') THEN 'J'
       WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('P') THEN 'P'
          ELSE ' ' END 											AS contract_Job_or_Product,
  ss.setuptype													AS `type`,  
  C.code														AS ServiceClass,
  r.code   														AS MarketCode, --Market Segment
  SB.code  														AS RegionCode,
  safe_cast(br.glsuffix as STRING) 								AS branchID,
  safe_cast(sbr.glsuffix AS STRING)               AS ServiceBranchID,
  l.zip															AS postalCode,
  l.state														AS state,
  CAST(ss.startdate AS DATE)                                    AS startDate,
  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE)	                                    AS `addDate`,
  ss.adduserid													AS adduserID,  
  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE)                                      AS orderDate,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE)	 	                                    AS workDate,
  ss.servicecode												AS serviceCode,
  ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping,'')						AS productGroup,
  s.description												    AS serviceDesc,
  "C"                                                           AS jobContract,
  e.employeeid 													AS employee_ID,
  SAFE_CAST(e.employeenum AS INT64)                             AS employeeNum,
  e.jobtitle													AS employeeJobTitle,
  e.username                                                    AS username,
  UPPER( CONCAT(e.lname,", ",e.fname))                          AS salesPerson,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS salesID,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                                           AS invoiceNum,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                    	                    AS orderNum,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS setupID,  
  l.locationid 													AS locationID,
  l.locationcode												AS locationCode,
  BT.BillToID                           AS BillToID,
  BT.BillToCode                         AS BillToCode, 
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.company)) > 0 THEN BT.company
    ELSE CONCAT(BT.lname,', ',BT.fname)
  END AS customer_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.phone)) = 12 THEN BT.phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.altphone)) = 12 THEN BT.altphone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.mobile)) = 12 THEN BT.mobile
  END AS customer_phone,  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added in heiracrchy of mobile, home and work
  BT.email AS customer_email,  
  CAST(ss.canceldate AS DATE)                                   AS cancelDate,
  ss.cancelreason                                               AS cancelReason,
  CASE WHEN ss.userdef19 != '' THEN 'Y' 
     ELSE 'N' END 												AS MigratedYN,
  ss.userdef19													AS MigratedValue,
  d.code                                                        AS division,  --MarketType
  ss.subtotal                                                   AS subtotal,
  --IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0) AS ContractValue, -- Added 01/30/2024 renamed annualValue-->ContractValue; Updated logic to use the new calc on 11/25/2024
  
  --Added on 11/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue,

  --Added on 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue_calc,


  
  0 AS InitialValue,
  0 AS ExcessInitialValue,
  0 AS JobNonRecurringValue,
  1 as ContractCount,  
  0 AS ExcessInitialCount,
  0 AS JobRecurringCount , --InitialCount,
  0 AS JobNonRecurringCount,
  0 AS TotalJobCount,
  i.detaileddescription as firstCompleted_jobDesc,
  i.orderid as firstCompletedJob_orderID,
  i.ordernum as firstCompletedJob_orderNum,
  i.invoicedate as firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate,
  i.workdate as firstCompletedJob_workDate,
  i.invoicetype as firstCompletedJob_invoiceType,
  i.description as firstCompletedJob_jobDesc,
  CASE WHEN i.description LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS firstCompletedJob_ini_YN,
  so.orderid as nextOpen_orderID,
  so.ordernum as nextOpenJob_orderNum,
  so.orderdate as nextOpenJob_orderDate,
  sso.description as nextOpenJob_jobDesc,
  CASE WHEN sso.description LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN so.subtotal ELSE 0 END AS initialValueNextJob,
  CASE WHEN sso.description Not LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN so.subtotal ELSE 0 END AS subtotalOtherValueNextJob,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.setupid ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) , SAFE_CAST(so.orderdate AS DATE)) as rankValue ,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid3 AS INT64)								AS tech3_TechSoldID,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid4 AS INT64)								AS tech4_SalesPersonSoldID,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid5 AS INT64)								AS tech5_TechLeadID,  
  SAFE_CAST(leademp.employeeid AS STRING)                       AS lead_employee_id,
  l.phone,
  l.altphone,
  ss.userdef19 AS OldSetupNum,
  
FROM
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.ServiceSetups ss

  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Services s
ON
  ss.servicecode = s.code
LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Classes c

LEFT JOIN `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.BranchSubRegions SB

  AND SB.active = true

ON

LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.FrequencyClasses fc
ON

LEFT JOIN
  -- Updated 8/26/2024 by Steven McCaffrey. Reason is due to include the PR since it's a IN type Production Invoice
  --`bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.InvoiceCurrentHistory i ON ss.setupid = i.setupid and i.invoicetype = 'IN'
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.InvoiceCurrentHistory i ON ss.setupid = i.setupid AND ((i.productionnum <> '' AND i.invoicetype = 'PR') OR (ifnull(i.ordernum,0) <> 0 AND i.invoicetype = 'IN'))
LEFT JOIN 
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.ServiceOrders so ON ss.setupid = so.setupid

LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Reference.unf_ref_service_code_map refservcode
ON

LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.S2.snp_RPP_Portfolio_Activity_Daily PtActDly

 ),

    ELSE CONCAT(BT.lname,', ',BT.fname)
  END AS customer_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.phone)) = 12 THEN BT.phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.altphone)) = 12 THEN BT.altphone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.mobile)) = 12 THEN BT.mobile
  END AS customer_phone,  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added in heiracrchy of mobile, home and work

     ELSE 'N' END 												AS MigratedYN,
  ss.userdef19													AS MigratedValue,
  d.code                                                        AS division,  --MarketType
  ss.subtotal                                                   AS subtotal,
  --IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0) AS ContractValue, -- Added 01/30/2024 renamed annualValue-->ContractValue
  --Added on 11/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue,

  --Added on 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation. 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue_calc,

when (sTbl = 'SS'  
	  and Ifnull(Division,'') NOT IN ('AMBIUS', 'STERITECH','NATION', 'NATIONAL' )

	  AND type NOT in ('PR')

when (sTbl = 'SS'  
	  and Ifnull(Division,'') NOT IN ('AMBIUS', 'STERITECH','NATION', 'NATIONAL' )
	  AND cancelreason NOT IN ('ADM') 	  
	  AND type in ('PR') ) then 'Exception-SS-Contracts-Resi-Com-TypeIn-PR'

-- Exception Type IN Termite

when (sTbl = 'IN'

	  AND cancelreason IN ('DUP', 'ADMNVOID', 'ADMINVOID')

-- Exception IN	Migrated
when (sTbl = 'IN'  
      and Ifnull(Division,'') NOT IN ('AMBIUS', 'STERITECH','NATION', 'NATIONAL' )
	  AND contract_Job_or_Product IN ('J' ,'P')

	  AND type IN ('PI', 'IN', 'NS')

-- Exception Type IN	   
when (sTbl = 'IN'

-- Exception Cancel reason IN	   
when (sTbl = 'IN'

-- New jobs (NAT)

      )	 then 'Exception-SO-NewJobs-National'
when (Division IS NULL

-- Exception IN subtotal less than equal 0
when (sTbl = 'IN'  
      and Ifnull(Division,'') NOT IN ('AMBIUS', 'STERITECH','NATION', 'NATIONAL' )
	  AND contract_Job_or_Product IN ('J' ,'P') 
      AND cancelreason NOT IN ('DUP', 'ADMNVOID', 'ADMINVOID')	  
	  AND type IN ('PI', 'IN', 'NS') 
	  AND MigratedYN = 'N'  
	  and ifnull(subtotal,0) <= 0
	   ) then 'Exception-IN-Jobs-Resi-Com-Subtotal-ZeroOrLessThanZero'		  
-- contracts (NAT)
when (sTbl = 'SS'  
	  and Ifnull(Division,'') IN ('NATION', 'NATIONAL' )

	  AND contract_Job_or_Product NOT IN ('J' , 'P')

      'Others'
