    , tCust.CUSNUM_ID
    , CASE 
        WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.mobile_phone)) = 12 THEN tCust.mobile_phone
        WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.home_phone)) = 12 THEN tCust.home_phone
        WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.work_phone)) = 12 THEN tCust.work_phone
      END AS customer_phone  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added in heiracrchy of mobile, home and work
    , tCust.email AS customer_email  
    , tAddr.address_1
    , tAddr.city
    , tAddr.state_code
    , tAddr.postal_code     
    , itemSa.TMX_SA_attributes_SID
    , itemSa.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
    , itemSa.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
    , itemSa.TMX_sales_employee_SID
    , itemSa.assigned_BUNIT_SID
    , itemSa.selling_BUnit_SID
    , itemSa.owning_BUnit_SID
    , itemLd.originating_BUnit_SID
    , itemLd.curr_assigned_employee_sid as lead_employee_SID
    , leademp.employee_id as lead_employee_id
	, salesemp.employee_id
	, salesemp.employee_jde_number
	, salesemp.last_name
	, salesemp.first_name
	, salesemp.Common_name
	, salesemp.job_code
    , salesemp.job_code_description
	, salesemp.employee_primary_designation_code
    , salesemp.employee_primary_designation_desc    
    , atrbSi.item_type_code
    , item_type_description    
    , service_type_description
    , svlnSa.service_line_code
    , itemSa.ACTID
    , itemSa.TMX_SA_item_SID    
    , itemSa.item_number
    , atrbSi.frequency_code
    , atrbSi.cancel_reason_code
    , atrbSi.cancel_reason_description
    , asgnBU.BU_type    
    , actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1
    , actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3
    , actvSa.report_classification
    , actvSa.report_multiplier
    , actvSa.report_value_multiplier
    , actfSa.activity_date_sid
    , actfSa.activity_date 
    , actfSa.tmx_sa_item_activity_sid
    , actfSa.annual_value as annual_value_act
	, actfSa.initial_value initial_val_act	
	, itemSa.item_amount    
    , itemSa.started_amt
    , itemSa.rawsale_amt
    , actfsa.discount_amt
    , CASE when atrbSI.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL') AND report_classification = 'New' then 1 else 0 end as base_qty    
    , CASE when actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' 
        then case when saatr.sa_type_code in ('GLD01','PLT01','TC568','TC569','TC570','TC571') --only care about INIs. Stashed excess rawsale in activity's annual_value
            then case when atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI' then itemSa.rawsale_amt + actfSa.annual_value end --because we're crazy round here
            --everybody else is normal
            else itemSa.rawsale_amt * actvSa.report_multiplier end end as raw_value 
    , CASE when svlnSa.service_line1_short in ('PC','PM','MS')
            and service_type_code = 'INI' 
            then 0
        when actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' 
            then actfSa.activity_quantity * actvSa.report_multiplier 
        else 0 end as raw_qty
    , CASE when svlnSa.service_line1_short in ('PC','PM','MS')
            and service_type_code = 'INI' 
            then 0
        when actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'Raw%Cancel'
            then actfSa.activity_quantity * actvSa.report_multiplier
        else 0 end as raw_cancel_qty        
    , CASE when svlnSa.service_line1_short in ('PC','PM')
            and service_type_code = 'INI' 
            then 0
        when actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'Raw%Cancel'
            then itemSa.rawsale_amt * actvSa.report_multiplier
        else 0 end as raw_cancel_value                
    , CASE
        when report_classification = 'Raw'
            or (svlnSa.service_line1_short in ('PC','PM','MS')
            and service_type_code = 'INI')
            then 0
        when actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like 'New%'
            or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE '%completion%'
            then actfSa.activity_quantity
        else 0 end as start_qty
    , CASE
        when report_classification <> 'Raw'
            and atrbSI.service_type_code in ('INI','ODM','ODR','SPC')
            and SA_item_activity_name3 <> 'un-cancel'
            and report_classification = 'n/a'
            then COALESCE(report_value_multiplier,1) * actfSa.activity_quantity 
        end as completion_qty
    , CASE
        when actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1 = 'new'
        and (
            actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like 'New%'
            or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%completion%'
 			or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%merchandise%'
 			or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%Merchandise%'
           or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'TC%renewal%'
        ) then 1     
        else 0 end as is_cvForStartedUnits
    , actfSa.excess_initial_amount as excess_initial_value_act
--    , CASE
--    	when 
--        (svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC')
--        	and atrbSI.service_type_code = 'INI' 
--     		then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0) - COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0) 
--        else 
--        	COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0) 
--        end as excess_initial_value_cv
    , COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0) as excess_initial_value_cv 
    , CASE
        when atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC' and actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw'
        	then COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
        when atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC' and actvSa.report_classification <> 'Raw'
        	then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0)	
        else 0 end as spc_value_cv
    , CASE
    /* gold- and platinum-tiered product */
    when 
        svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC'
        and atrbSI.service_type_code = 'INI' 
        and saatr.SA_type_code in ('GLD01','PLT01','TC568','TC569','TC570','TC571','UPP016', 'UPP019', 'UPP022', 'UPP023', 'UPP024', 'UPP025')
--        then COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0)
        then COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0) + COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0)
    /* other termite */
    when 
        (svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC'  or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%merchandise%' or actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE '%Merchandise%')
        and atrbSI.service_type_code = 'INI' 
--        then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0)
--        then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0) 
        then COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0) 
    /* pest */ --- Added 01/30/2024 after meeting with Kevin/John
    when 
        (svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) -- Updated to add 'PM' as that's apart of Pest Control 7/30/2024 - Steven McCaffrey
        and atrbSI.service_type_code in ( 'INI' ,'BIT')
--        then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0)
--        then COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0)
        then COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
    else 0 end as initial_value_cv
    , CASE
	    when atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC'
           --- or svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC' --Commented 01/30/2024 to pickup TC annual_value
        then 0
	    when actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw'
        	then COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
        else COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0) 
        end as annual_value_cv
    , CASE when report_classification = 'New'  and atrbSI.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL') then actfSa.annual_value else 0 end as recurring_value
    , case when STRPOS( lower(actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3), 'new') > 0
            and saatr.contract_group1 not in (
                'CLEARANCE LETTERS'
                , 'EXCLUSION SPC'
                , 'INSULATION'
                , 'OTHER'
                , 'RELATED REPAIR'
                , 'SOIL TREATMENT'
                , 'SPECIALS')
            /* both these conditions naturally exclude wdir */
            then actfSa.activity_quantity else 0 end as start_rate_qty
    , case when actvSa.report_classification = 'New' then 1 else 0 end as start_rate_numerator_multiplier        
    , case 
        when actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' and svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC' and atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI' then 1
        when actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' and svlnSa.service_line1_short <> 'TC' and atrbSi.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG') then 1
        else 0 end as start_rate_denominator_multiplier 
    , case when (atrbLd.lead_source_code IN ('PIG','DOOR') or salesemp.job_code in ('100873','100874','100875','100878','100879','100880','100883','100884','100885','100886','100890','100891','100894','100895','100897','100902','101014','101027','101028','101318','900891','100390','101075','101545')) THEN ('Y') ELSE ('N') END AS IndTAP_YN 
    , case when (atrbLd.lead_source_code IN ('PIG','DOOR')) 
    			THEN 'TechLead' 
    	   WHEN (salesemp.job_code in ('100873','100874','100875','100878','100879','100880','100883','100884','100885','100886','100890','100891','100894','100895','100897','100902','101014','101027','101028','101318','900891','100390','101075','101545')) 
    	   		THEN ('TechSale') ELSE ('') 
    	   		END 
    	   	AS TAPType
    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY itemSa.sales_agreement_number, itemsa.item_number ORDER BY itemSa.sales_agreement_number, itemsa.item_number,actfSa.activity_date_sid desc , actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1 ) as rank_latest
 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item as itemSa 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line as svlnSa  ON itemSa.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = svlnSa.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes as atrbSi  on atrbSi.tmx_sa_item_attributes_sid = itemSa.tmx_sa_item_attributes_sid
inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_attributes saatr ON itemSa.TMX_SA_attributes_SID = saatr.TMX_SA_attributes_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit as asgnBU  ON itemSa.assigned_BUNIT_SID = asgnBU.TMX_business_unit_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit as sellBu  on itemSa.selling_BUnit_SID = sellBu.TMX_business_unit_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_customer as tCust  on itemSa.TMX_customer_SID = tCust.TMX_customer_SID 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_address as tAddr  on itemSa.TMX_address_SID = tAddr.TMX_address_SID 
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_lead as itemLd  on itemSa.tmx_lead_sid = itemLd.tmx_lead_sid 
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_attributes atrbLd  on itemLd.TMX_lead_attribute_SID = atrbLd.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit origBu  on itemLd.originating_BUnit_SID = origBu.TMX_business_unit_SID 
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity_fact as actfSa  ON actfSa.TMX_SA_item_SID = itemSa.TMX_SA_item_SID 
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity as actvSa  ON actfSa.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = actvSa.TMX_SA_activity_SID
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_employee as salesemp ON itemSa.TMX_sales_employee_SID = salesemp.TMX_employee_SID
left  join `bidata-sharedus-production`.S0_TMX.tmx_employee as leademp ON itemLd.curr_assigned_employee_sid = leademp.TMX_employee_SID
LEFT JOIN 
  (
  SELECT 
    sales_agreement_number sanum,
    max(effective_date) startDate
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` 
  WHERE curr_ind='Y'
  GROUP BY sales_agreement_number
  ) q on q.sanum= itemSa.sales_agreement_number

WHERE
    (tAddr.country = 'USA' OR tAddr.country IS NULL) -- Added by Steven McCaffrey on 7/15/2024. Seems like it didn't filter for Mexico
    AND salesemp.job_code NOT IN ('100702', '102032','102033') -- Added by Steven McCaffrey on 8/6/2024. Exclude National Acct Sales Manager and Business Development Manager - PC. These are the job codes that reflect that. 
	AND itemSa.billable_yn = 'Y'
	--and itemSa.sales_agreement_number in ('31895281')	
    and svlnSa.service_line1_short in ('MS','PC','PM','TC')
    and asgnBU.BU_type in ('Branch','Satellite Branch')    
    and (report_classification = 'Raw'
        or (itemSa.raw_sale_yn = 'N'
            and actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1 = 'new')
        --or (itemSa.raw_sale_yn = 'N'
        --    and actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1 = 'cancel'  and actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3 = '1st year loss' and itemSa.original_effective_date is NULL)    
            )        
    /* Change made 2019-10-15 in consulation with Kevin and Wendy. Duplication items below were counted raw in NBRS but in QA'ing S&S, these came to light as causing duplication in raw counts. */
    and actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3 not in (
          'Raw - PC Uncancel' --duplication
        , 'Raw - TC Uncancel' --not used in calculations
        --, 'Raw - TC Converted with INI' --duplication
        , 'Raw Cancel- TC CVT with INI' --duplication
        --, 'Raw - WDIR' --not used in calculations
        , 'Raw Cancel- WDIR' --not used in calculations
        , 'Raw - Convert From'
    )

SELECT
  atrbSi.report_market_type AS market_type, -- Replace with market_type since dealing with NAT accounts. 20250918
  itemSa.inactive_status_code, -- This is based on converted items or bundles that were split or cancelled 20250918
  itemSa.inactive_status_description, -- This is based on converted items or bundles that were split or cancelled 20250918
  svlnSa.service_line1_short,
  svlnSa.service_line1_long,
  saatr.sa_type_code,
  service_type_code,
  atrbSi.item_code,
  atrbSi.services_per_year,
  itemSa.sales_agreement_number,
  itemSa.accounting_date,
  --itemSa.effective_date,
  q.startdate AS effective_date,
  itemSa.original_effective_date,    
  itemSa.cancel_date,
  itemSa.inactive_date,
  scheduled_date AS next_scheduled_date,
  itemSa.acquired_yn,
  itemSa.financed_yn,
  itemSa.auto_pay_yn,
  itemSa.raw_sale_yn,
  itemSa.billable_yn,
  asgnBu.BUNCOD_ID AS buncod_assigned,
  asgnBu.division_code AS division_code_assigned,
  asgnBu.region_code AS region_code_assigned,
  sellBu.BUNCOD_ID AS buncod_selling,
  origBu.BUNCOD_ID AS buncod_originated_lead,
  tCust.acquisition_BUnit_code AS buncod_acquisition,
  itemSa.route,
  RT.employee_jde_number AS routetech_employee_jde_number, 
  RT.common_name AS routetech_name,
  CASE atrbSi.service_type_code
    WHEN 'REG' THEN REG_route
    WHEN 'RNL' THEN REI_route
    ELSE route
  END AS main_route,
  atrbLd.lead_type_code,
  atrbLd.lead_source_code,
  tCust.Common_Name AS customer_name,  -- This is already either the Company Name or LastName, First Name format.
  tCust.CUSNUM_ID,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.mobile_phone)) = 12 THEN tCust.mobile_phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.home_phone))   = 12 THEN tCust.home_phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(tCust.work_phone))   = 12 THEN tCust.work_phone
  END AS customer_phone,  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added IN heiracrchy of mobile, home AND work
  tCust.email AS customer_email,  
  tAddr.address_1,
  tAddr.city,
  tAddr.state_code,
  tAddr.postal_code,    
  itemSa.TMX_SA_attributes_SID,
  itemSa.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID,
  itemSa.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID,
  itemSa.TMX_sales_employee_SID,
  itemSa.assigned_BUNIT_SID,
  itemSa.selling_BUnit_SID,
  itemSa.owning_BUnit_SID,
  itemLd.originating_BUnit_SID,
  itemLd.curr_assigned_employee_sid AS lead_employee_SID,
  leademp.employee_id AS lead_employee_id,
  salesemp.employee_id,
  salesemp.employee_jde_number,
  salesemp.last_name,
  salesemp.first_name,
  salesemp.Common_name,
  salesemp.job_code,
  salesemp.job_code_description,
  salesemp.employee_primary_designation_code,
  salesemp.employee_primary_designation_desc,
  atrbSi.item_type_code,
  item_type_description,  
  service_type_description,
  svlnSa.service_line_code,
  itemSa.ACTID,
  itemSa.TMX_SA_item_SID,
  itemSa.item_number,
  atrbSi.frequency_code,
  atrbSi.cancel_reason_code,
  atrbSi.cancel_reason_description,
  b.BU_type,
  actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1,
  actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3,
  actvSa.report_classification,
  actvSa.report_multiplier,
  actvSa.report_value_multiplier,
  actfSa.activity_date_sid,
  actfSa.activity_date,
  actfSa.tmx_sa_item_activity_sid,
  actfSa.annual_value AS annual_value_act,
  actfSa.initial_value initial_val_act,
  itemSa.item_amount,
  itemSa.started_amt,
  itemSa.rawsale_amt,
  actfsa.discount_amt,
  CASE
    WHEN atrbSI.service_type_code IN ('BIT','REG','RNL') AND report_classification = 'New' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS base_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' THEN
    CASE
      WHEN saatr.sa_type_code IN ('GLD01','PLT01','TC568','TC569','TC570','TC571') THEN
        CASE
          WHEN atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI' THEN itemSa.rawsale_amt + actfSa.annual_value
        END --because we're crazy round here
            --everybody ELSE is normal
      ELSE itemSa.rawsale_amt * actvSa.report_multiplier
    END
  END AS raw_value,
  CASE
    WHEN svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM','MS') AND service_type_code = 'INI' THEN 0
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' THEN actfSa.activity_quantity * actvSa.report_multiplier
    ELSE 0
  END AS raw_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM','MS') AND service_type_code = 'INI' THEN 0
    WHEN actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'Raw%Cancel' THEN actfSa.activity_quantity * actvSa.report_multiplier
    ELSE 0
  END AS raw_cancel_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM') AND service_type_code = 'INI' THEN 0
    WHEN actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'Raw%Cancel' THEN itemSa.rawsale_amt * actvSa.report_multiplier
    ELSE 0
  END AS raw_cancel_value,
  CASE
    WHEN report_classification = 'Raw' OR (svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM','MS') AND service_type_code = 'INI') THEN 0
    WHEN actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like 'New%' OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE '%completion%' THEN actfSa.activity_quantity
    ELSE 0
  END AS start_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN report_classification <> 'Raw'
          AND atrbSI.service_type_code IN ('INI','ODM','ODR','SPC')
          AND SA_item_activity_name3 <> 'un-cancel'
          AND report_classification = 'n/a'
          THEN COALESCE(report_value_multiplier,1) * actfSa.activity_quantity
  END AS completion_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1 = 'new'
         AND (
              actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like 'New%'
              OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%completion%'
              OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%merchandise%'
              OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 like '%Merchandise%'
              OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE 'TC%renewal%'
              ) THEN 1    
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_cvForStartedUnits,
  actfSa.excess_initial_amount AS excess_initial_value_act,
  COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0) AS excess_initial_value_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC' AND actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw'  THEN COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
    WHEN atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC' AND actvSa.report_classification <> 'Raw' THEN COALESCE(actfSa.initial_value,0)
    ELSE 0
  END AS spc_value_cv,
  CASE
    /* gold- AND platinum-tiered product */
    WHEN
        svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC'
        AND atrbSI.service_type_code = 'INI'
        AND saatr.SA_type_code IN ('GLD01','PLT01','TC568','TC569','TC570','TC571','UPP016', 'UPP019', 'UPP022', 'UPP023', 'UPP024', 'UPP025')
        THEN COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0) + COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0)
    /* other termite */
    WHEN
        (svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC'  
          OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE '%merchandise%'
          OR actvSa.sa_item_activity_name3 LIKE '%Merchandise%'
        )
        AND atrbSI.service_type_code = 'INI'
        THEN COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0) + COALESCE(actfSa.excess_initial_amount,0)
    /* pest */ --- Added 01/30/2024 after meeting with Kevin/John
    WHEN
        (svlnSa.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) -- Updated to add 'PM' AS that's apart of Pest Control 7/30/2024 - Steven McCaffrey
        AND atrbSI.service_type_code IN ( 'INI' ,'BIT')
        THEN COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
    ELSE 0
  END AS initial_value_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN atrbSI.service_type_code = 'SPC' THEN 0
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' THEN COALESCE(itemSa.rawsale_amt,0)
    ELSE COALESCE(actfSa.annual_value,0)
  END AS annual_value_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN report_classification = 'New'  AND atrbSI.service_type_code IN ('BIT','REG','RNL') THEN actfSa.annual_value
    ELSE 0
  END AS recurring_value,
  CASE
    WHEN  STRPOS( LOWER(actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3), 'new') > 0
          AND saatr.contract_group1 NOT IN (
                'CLEARANCE LETTERS'
                , 'EXCLUSION SPC'
                , 'INSULATION'
                , 'OTHER'
                , 'RELATED REPAIR'
                , 'SOIL TREATMENT'
                , 'SPECIALS')
          THEN actfSa.activity_quantity
    ELSE 0
  END AS start_rate_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'New' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS start_rate_numerator_multiplier,
  CASE
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' AND svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC' AND atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI' THEN 1
    WHEN actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' AND svlnSa.service_line1_short <> 'TC' AND atrbSi.service_type_code IN ('BIT','REG') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS start_rate_denominator_multiplier,
  CASE
    WHEN (atrbLd.lead_source_code IN ('PIG','DOOR') OR salesemp.job_code IN ('100873','100874','100875','100878','100879','100880','100883','100884','100885','100886','100890','100891','100894','100895','100897','100902','101014','101027','101028','101318','900891','100390','101075','101545')) THEN ('Y')
    ELSE ('N')
  END AS IndTAP_YN,
  CASE
    WHEN (atrbLd.lead_source_code IN ('PIG','DOOR')) THEN 'TechLead'
    WHEN (salesemp.job_code IN ('100873','100874','100875','100878','100879','100880','100883','100884','100885','100886','100890','100891','100894','100895','100897','100902','101014','101027','101028','101318','900891','100390','101075','101545'))
          THEN ('TechSale')
    ELSE ('')
  END AS TAPType,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY itemSa.sales_agreement_number, itemsa.item_number ORDER BY itemSa.sales_agreement_number, itemsa.item_number,actfSa.activity_date_sid desc , actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1, actfSa.annual_value desc) AS rank_latest,


-- Mission Values
    -- Contract Value
    CASE 
      WHEN atrbSi.service_type_code IN ('SPC','INI') THEN 0  -- Mark 0 for Jobs Nonrecurring(SPC) and Job Initials (INI)      
      WHEN atrbSi.service_type_code = 'BIT'
	          AND svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC'
	          AND saatr.SA_type_code 
	            IN ('GLD01', 'GLD02', 'PLT01','TC568', 'TC569', 'TC570', 'TC571', 'TC580', 'TC581', 'TC582', 'TC583', 'UPP024','UPP025','UPP042','UPP043','UPP050','UPP051','UTM002','UTM004','UTP002','UTP006','UTP010','UTP014','UTP022','UTP023')
            THEN 0 --- For TBSMBIL -BIT item for bundles the INI row has the value already added in the annual_value of the sa activity fact Example SA 33018682/TC581 -- 07102025
      WHEN report_classification = 'Raw' THEN rawsale_amt      
      ELSE actfSa.annual_value
    END AS contract_value_v3,

    --Job NonRecurring Value
    --SPC is considered a Nonrecurring Job
    CASE 
      WHEN service_type_code = 'SPC' AND report_classification = 'Raw' THEN rawsale_amt
      WHEN service_type_code = 'SPC' AND report_classification <> 'Raw' THEN initial_value
    ELSE 0 
    END AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,

    --Initial Value
    --INI is considered the Initial
    CASE 
      WHEN service_type_code = 'INI' AND report_classification = 'Raw' THEN rawsale_amt
      WHEN service_type_code = 'INI' AND report_classification = 'Cancel' and service_line1_short = 'TC' THEN initial_value + ifnull(tc_bit.RawAmt ,0) --09/07/2025 to get TC BIT new activity INI annual_value (same as Raw_amount from tmx_sa_item for the BIT item) 
      WHEN service_type_code = 'INI' AND report_classification <> 'Raw'THEN initial_value + actfSa.annual_value 
      ELSE 0
    END AS job_ini_value_v3,

actfSa.initial_value,

-- Mission Counts
CASE WHEN service_type_code = 'SPC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS job_recurring_count_v3,
CASE WHEN service_type_code = 'INI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS job_ini_count_v3,
CASE 
  WHEN service_type_code = 'INI' AND svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC' THEN 1 
  WHEN service_type_code NOT IN ('SPC', 'INI')  AND svlnSa.service_line1_short = 'TC' THEN 0 
  WHEN service_type_code NOT IN ('SPC', 'INI')  THEN 1 
  ELSE 0 
END AS contract_count_v3,


--TESTING FOR TRUSTED ADVISOR TOTAL SALES FOR TECHS 6/24/2025 - SM
CASE 
  WHEN actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3 NOT IN('TC renewal', 'TC renewal-Scope') AND UPPER(itemSa.billable_yn) = 'Y'
      AND (
          (UPPER(itemSa.raw_sale_yn) = 'N' 
           and UPPER(actvSa.SA_item_activity_name1) in ('NEW','CANCEL') )
           or (actvSa.report_classification = 'Raw' and actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3 = 'Raw - TC Converted with INI')
           )
    THEN
      CASE 
        WHEN actvSa.SA_item_activity_name3 = 'Raw - TC Converted with INI' AND startdate IS NOT NULL 
            THEN itemSa.rawsale_amt * actvSa.report_value_multiplier
        WHEN (atrbSi.service_type_code = 'SPC') OR (service_line1_short IN ('TC', 'MS') AND  atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI')
            THEN 
                CASE 
                  WHEN saatr.SA_type_code in 
                          ( 'GLD01', 'PLT01' , 'TC568', 'TC569', 'TC570',
                            'TC571', 'UPP024', 'UPP025', 'UTM002', 'GLD02', 'UPP042',
                            'TC582', 'UPP043', 'UPP051', 'UTP006', 'UTP014', 'UTP022', 'TC580', 'UPP050', 'UTM004',
                            'UTP023', 'TC583' , 'UTP010', 'TC581', 'UTP002'
                          ) 
                        AND service_type_code = 'INI' AND report_classification = 'Cancel' and service_line1_short = 'TC' 
                           THEN  ( ifnull(tc_bit.RawAmt ,0) + actfSa.initial_value + actfSa.excess_initial_amount ) 
                            --09/07/2025 to get TC BIT new activity INI annual_value (same as Raw_amount from tmx_sa_item for the BIT item) 
                  
                  WHEN saatr.SA_type_code in 
                          ( 'GLD01', 'PLT01' , 'TC568', 'TC569', 'TC570',
                            'TC571', 'UPP024', 'UPP025', 'UTM002', 'GLD02', 'UPP042',
                            'TC582', 'UPP043', 'UPP051', 'UTP006', 'UTP014', 'UTP022', 'TC580', 'UPP050', 'UTM004',
                            'UTP023', 'TC583' , 'UTP010', 'TC581', 'UTP002'
                          ) 
                          AND atrbSi.service_type_code = 'INI'
                    THEN (actfSa.annual_value + actfSa.initial_value + actfSa.excess_initial_amount ) 
                  
                  ELSE (actfSa.initial_value + actfSa.excess_initial_amount)
                END
        ELSE (itemSa.annual_value + actfSa.excess_initial_amount)
        END
END AS TA_TotalSales,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(salesemp.job_code,'') NOT IN ('100702', '102032','102033') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS NonNAT_salesemployeejobcode

--CREATE OR REPLACE table `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_survey_l360_V2` AS

WITH
  details AS (
  SELECT
    SurveyId,
    EmpJDE,
    ServiceLine as service_line,
    ServiceLineCode,
    ServiceType,
    Comment as CommentDetail,
    TechNPS,
    --CustomerTenure,
    SAFE_CAST(WorkOrder AS STRING) as workordernumber, Branch, SAFE_CAST(BranchID AS INT64) as terminix_bucode__c, 
    INITCAP(BranchName) as BranchName, RegionID, RegionName, 
    CASE 
    WHEN RegionName IS NOT NULL AND RegionName != '' THEN
      ARRAY_TO_STRING(
        ARRAY(
          SELECT 
            if(LENGTH(number) > 3,CONCAT('R', LPAD(number, 4, '0')),CONCAT('R', LPAD(number, 3, '0')))
          FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(RegionName, r'(\d{3,4}|\d{1,2})')) AS number
          WHERE LENGTH(number) <= 4
        ), 
        ' ' #TODO Review if replacable with null
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS Region_Code,
     INITCAP(DivsionName) as Market_Name,
    MarketType,SalesAgreement,SurveySource,DateSubmitted as createddate
   
  FROM (
      #Removing duplicates reduces to 2859498
    SELECT
      DISTINCT *
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_survey_detail`) ),
  employees AS (
  SELECT
    Employee_Number,
    First_Name as Employee_First_Name,
    Last_Name as Employee_Last_Name,
    IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(Termination_Date AS DATE),CURRENT_DATE()) Termination_Date,
    IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(Original_Hire_Date AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(Hire_Date AS DATE)) Hire_Date,
    DATE_DIFF(IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(Termination_Date AS DATE),CURRENT_DATE()), IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(Original_Hire_Date AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(Hire_Date AS DATE)), DAY) Employee_Tenure
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` )
SELECT
  * except(SurveyId)
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_survey_l360` survey
LEFT JOIN
  details
ON
  survey.Survey_Id = details.SurveyId
LEFT JOIN
  employees
ON
  SAFE_CAST(details.EmpJDE AS STRING) = employees.Employee_Number

SELECT
   cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Division_Number
  ,billtomarket as Division_Market_Name
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Region_Number
  ,billtoregion as Region_Name
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Business_Unit_Class
  ,left(billtobranch, 3) Branch_Number
  ,billtobranch as Branch_Name
  ,cast(locationcode as string) as Customer_Number
  ,cast(setupid as string) as SalesAgreement_Number
  ,cast(FORMAT_TIMESTAMP("%Y-%m-%d",setupstartdate, "UTC") as date) as SalesAgreement_Effective_Date
  ,CASE
    WHEN billtolname = '' or billtofname = '' THEN billtosalutationname
    ELSE concat(initcap(billtolname), ", ",initcap(billtofname))
  END AS Full_Name
  ,concat(initcap(billtoaddress), ' ', initcap(billtoaddress2)) as Street
  ,initcap(billtocity) as City
  ,billtostate as State
  ,billtozip as Zip 
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Phone_Location
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Phone_Type
  ,left(billtophone, 3) as Customer_Area_Code
  ,right(billtophone, 8) as Customer_Phone_Number 
  ,billtoemail as Customer_Email
  ,code as Invoice_Service_Line 
  ,round(balance,0) as AR_Collections_Amt
  ,concat(left(format_date('%B', invoicemonth),3), ' ', extract(YEAR FROM invoicemonth)) as Invoice_Month
  ,description as Level2_Service_Line
  ,cast(productionnum as string) as WorkOrder_Reference_Number
  ,extract(month FROM workdate) as Renewal_Month
  ,cast(workdate as date) as WO_Completion_Date
  ,cast(invoicedate as date) as Invoice_Due_Date
  ,age as Age
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Latest_WorkOrder_Status
	,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as WorkOrder_Item
  ,ordertype as Service_Type
  ,CASE
     WHEN DATE_DIFF(cast(invoicedate as date),cast(CURRENT_DATE() as date),Day) < 0 THEN 'PastDue'
     ELSE 'FutureDue'
  END as Invoice_Due_Date_Status
  ,CASE
     WHEN SIGN(Age) = -1 THEN 'Future'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 0 and 30 THEN '0-30'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 31 and 60 THEN '31-60'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 61 and 90 THEN '61-90'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 91 and 120 THEN '91-120'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 121 and 150 THEN '121-150'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 151 and 180 THEN '151-180'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 181 and 210 THEN '181-210'
     WHEN AGE BETWEEN 211 and 240 THEN '211-240'
     WHEN AGE > 240 THEN '241++'
  END as Age_Status
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as InvMktType
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Payment_Type_Flag
	,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as SLSAH_Source_Type
  ,'RNA' as Historical_Company_Source
FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RNA_INPDetails_Daily

SELECT 
   cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Division_Number
  ,market as Division_Market_Name
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Region_Number
  ,region as Region_Name
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Business_Unit_Class
  ,branchnumber as Branch_Number
  ,branch as Branch_Name
  ,companyname as RNA_Brand
  ,cast(locationcode as string) as Customer_Number
  ,cast(setupid as string) as SalesAgreement_Number
  ,cast(FORMAT_TIMESTAMP("%Y-%m-%d",setupstartdate, "UTC") as date) as SalesAgreement_Effective_Date
  ,CASE
    WHEN lname = '' or fname = '' THEN salutationname
    ELSE concat(initcap(lname), ", ",initcap(fname))
  END AS Full_Name
  ,concat(initcap(address), ' ', initcap(address2)) as Street
  ,initcap(city) as City
  ,state as State
  ,zip as Zip
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Phone_Location
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Phone_Type
  ,left(phone, 3) as Customer_Area_Code
  ,right(phone, 8) as Customer_Phone_Number
  ,email as Customer_Email
  ,code as Invoice_Service_Line
  --,Null as WorkOrder_Count
  ,round(order_total,0) as AR_Collections_Amt
  ,concat(left(format_date('%B', adddate),3), ' ', extract(YEAR FROM adddate)) as Invoice_Month
  ,description as Level2_Service_Line
  ,cast(ordernum as string) as WorkOrder_Reference_Number
  ,extract(month FROM invoicedate) as Renewal_Month
  ,CASE
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) = '00:00:00' or extract(YEAR from workdate) < (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN Null
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(YEAR from workdate) >= (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN cast(DATE_TRUNC(workdate, MONTH) as date)
  END AS Service_Begin_Date
  ,CASE
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) = '00:00:00' or extract(YEAR from workdate) < (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN Null
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(YEAR from workdate) >= (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN LAST_DAY(cast(workdate as date))
  END AS Service_End_Date
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Cancel_Code
  ,cast('Not Applicable' as string) as Latest_WorkOrder_Status
  ,CASE
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) = '00:00:00' or extract(YEAR from workdate) < (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN 'Not Scheduled'
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(YEAR from workdate) >= (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) and cast(DATE_TRUNC(workdate, MONTH) as date) > current_date() THEN 'Future Service Window'
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(date from workdate) < CURRENT_DATE() and extract(YEAR from workdate) >= (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN 'Missed Schedule Date'
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(date from workdate) <= LAST_DAY(current_date()) and extract(date from workdate) >= cast(DATE_TRUNC(current_date(), MONTH) as date) THEN 'Scheduled In-Month'
    ELSE 'Scheduled Future-Month'
  END AS PNI_Category
  ,CASE
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) = '00:00:00' or extract(YEAR from workdate) < (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN 'Not Scheduled'
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(date from workdate) < CURRENT_DATE() and extract(YEAR from workdate) >= (extract(YEAR from CURRENT_DATE())-1) THEN 'Missed Schedule Date'
    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' and extract(date from workdate) <= LAST_DAY(current_date()) and extract(date from workdate) >= cast(DATE_TRUNC(current_date(), MONTH) as date) THEN 'Scheduled In-Month'
    ELSE 'Scheduled Future-Month'
  END AS PNI_Status
  ,CASE

    WHEN extract(time from workdate) != '00:00:00' THEN extract(date from workdate)

with
  -- Get the current day of week and the most recent Friday for which data exists in the
  -- terminix data warehouse daily revenue tables.
  most_recent_friday as (
  select
    format_date('%a', current_date) as current_day_of_week,
    parse_date('%Y%m%d', cast(max(acctdate_SID) as string)) as latest_friday,
        from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tdw_daily_revenue_detail
   where format_date('%a', cast(parse_date('%Y%m%d', cast(acctdate_SID as string)) as date)) = 'Fri'
  ),
  -- finds the last committed revenue day to use from the TDW versus when to use estimated
  -- revenue from DOR tables. The logic is that we normally select up through current
  -- day - 2 as real revenue and day - 1 is estimated. But on Sunday and Monday,
  -- we treat Friday as the most recent day of real revenue.
  dor_last_committed as (
    select
          case
          when current_day_of_week in ('Sun','Mon') then true
          else false
          end as use_weekend_logic,
      case
      when current_day_of_week in ('Sun', 'Mon') then latest_friday
      else current_date('America/Chicago') - 1
      end as last_committed_revenue_date
      from most_recent_friday
  ),
  -- get the most recent update time for the tmx_dor table for the specified date
  dor_update_time as (
    select
          max(upload_time) as last_update_time,
      max(upload_date) as last_upload_date,
          from bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_dor
          where upload_date = current_date('America/Chicago')
  ),
  -- pull the various bits of metadata together into one place
  dor_dates as (
        select
          use_weekend_logic,
          last_committed_revenue_date,
          last_update_time,
      last_upload_date
          from dor_last_committed
          cross join dor_update_time
  ),
  tmx_dor as (

     select 
     acctdate_SID
     ,TMX_business_Unit_SID
     ,TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
     ,completed_sales_amt
     ,onetime_amt
     ,renewal_collections_amt
     ,recurring_amt
     --,adjustments_amt
     ,case when market_type_code = 'NAT' then 0 else adjustments_amt end adjustments_amt # added 12/15/2025 per Kevin Kennedy's request for NAT adj not    coming in correctly in source system mission - DC          
     ,merchandise_sales_amt
     ,market_type_code
     ,upload_date
     ,upload_time
     from bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_dor
  )
select
   parse_date("%Y%m%d",cast(acctdate_SID as string)) date,
   buncod_id,
   market_type_code,
   'Pest Control' product_grouping,
   'Job' service_type_code,
   (onetime_amt) Amount
   FROM tmx_dor a
        inner join bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line b on a.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = b.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
        inner join bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit c on a.TMX_business_Unit_SID = c.TMX_business_Unit_SID
        cross join dor_dates d
  where upload_date = last_upload_date
    and upload_time = d.last_update_time
    and ((d.use_weekend_logic = true and parse_date("%Y%m%d",cast(acctdate_SID as string)) between d.last_committed_revenue_date and current_date)
         or
        (d.use_weekend_logic = false and parse_date("%Y%m%d",cast(acctdate_SID as string)) = d.last_committed_revenue_date))
    and service_line1_short in ('PC','PM')

  union all

 SELECT

  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.phone)) = 12 THEN BT.phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.altphone)) = 12 THEN BT.altphone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.mobile)) = 12 THEN BT.mobile

     ELSE 'N' END 												AS MigratedYN,

select

    CAST(Posting_Date AS DATE) AS TransactionDate,
    (Amount * -1) Amount,
    'National Accounts' type,
    Global_Dimension_2_Code LOB,
    case
        when Global_Dimension_2_Code = '372' then 'Termite Control'
        when Global_Dimension_2_Code <> '372' then 'Pest Control'
        else 'Other'
    end as product_grouping,
    case
        when left(trim(GL_Account_No), 6) = '110200' then 'Contract'

        else 'Other'

where cast(Posting_Date as date) >= cast(concat(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 year)),'-','01','-','01') as date)
  and left(trim(cast(Document_No AS STRING)), 1) = "0"
  and left(trim(GL_Account_No), 6) IN('110200','110400','111000','111800')

select
    cal.WeekDay,
    cal.Year,
    cal.Month,
    bu.branch_num as Branch,
    jde.TransactionDate,
    jde.Amount,
    'National Accounts' as type,
    jde.LOB,
    case
        when jde.LOB = '372' then 'Termite Control'
        else 'Pest Control'
    end as product_grouping,
    case
        when jde.account_name_GMDL01 in ('Contract revenue') then 'Contract'
        when jde.account_name_GMDL01 in ('Job revenue') then 'Job'
        else 'Other'
    end as service_type_code,
    jde.report_market_type as DivisionCode

  and jde.document_type_GLDCT = 'J2'

  and cast(jde.TransactionDate as date) >= cast(concat(extract(year from date_sub(current_date(), interval 2 year)),'-','01','-','01') as date)

CASE WHEN employee_primary_designation_code = 'SUMMSLS' THEN 'HAWX - Summer Sales' ELSE NULL END AS SummerSalesIND,

SELECT
    'TDW'                           AS Source,
  a.sales_agreement_number          AS Contract,
  a.market_type                     AS MarketType,
  MAX(inactive_status_code)         AS inactive_status_code, 
  MAX(inactive_status_description)  AS inactive_status_description,
  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product)      AS ServiceType,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.Mapped_Service))     AS ProductCode,
  item_code,
  MAX(services_per_year) AS services_per_year,
  sa_type_code,
  service_line1_long            AS ProductGroup,
  MAX(accounting_date)          AS SellDate,
  MAX(effective_date)           AS StartDate, --MAX(original_effective_date) StartDate - Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(original_effective_date)  AS Original_StartDate,
  MAX(a.cancel_date)            AS CancelDate,
  --MAX(next_scheduled_date)      AS next_scheduled_date,
  MAX(NS.scheduled_date)        AS next_scheduled_date,
  MAX(activity_date)            AS activity_date,
  MAX(lead_source_code)         AS lead_source_code,
  MAX(renewalind)               AS renewalind,
  MAX(NonNAT_salesemployeejobcode) AS NonNAT_salesemployeejobcode,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedBranch,
  buncod_assigned               AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  division_code_assigned,
  region_code_assigned,
  postal_code                   AS Geography,
  state_code                    AS State,
  city_code                     AS City,
  employee_id                   AS SalesPersonID,
  SalesPerson                   AS SalesPerson,
  job_code_description          AS SalesPersonJobTitle,
  NULL                          AS SalesRole,
  employee_jde_number           AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  customer_name,
  customer_phone,
  a.customer_email,
  a.route,
  routetech_employee_jde_number,
  routetech_name,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)          AS ContractValue,   --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS InitialValue,    --Added 01/30/2024
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM')) AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(rawsale_amt) - SUM(annual_value_cv)
    ELSE  SUM(excess_initial_value_cv)
  END AS ExcessInitialValue,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)                           AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)   AS TotalJobValue, -- Initial value + JobNonRecurringValue
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN SUM(annual_value_cv) + (SUM(initial_value_cv) - SUM(annual_value_cv)) + SUM(spc_value_cv) 
    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
  END AS TotalValue,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)         AS JobINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
  SUM(spc_value_cv)             AS JobNonINIValue, --Added 02/06/2025
--  CASE
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) = 'TC') AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0 THEN (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)) -- For TC INI Value has the first year value -- 02/06/2025
--    WHEN  (MAX(service_line1_short) IN ('PC', 'PM'))
--    THEN  SUM(rawsale_amt)  
--    ELSE  SUM(annual_value_cv) + SUM(excess_initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv)
--  END AS TotalValue_v2, --Added 02/06/2025
  (SUM(initial_value_cv) + SUM(spc_value_cv) + SUM(annual_value_cv)) AS TotalValue_V2,
  SUM(base_qty)                 AS BaseQty,
  SUM(raw_qty)                  AS raw_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS ContractCount,
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonRecurringCount,  --SPC counts -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  0   AS ExcessInitialCount, -- For tmx count is part of ContractCount -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
    END AS JobRecurringCount, -- InitialCount -- -- To be removed 02/06/2025
  (
  CASE
    WHEN (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) <> 'C') OR (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  ) AS TotalJobCount, --Total job counts  
  1 AS TotalCount, -- To be removed 02/06/2025
 
  CASE
    WHEN  (MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' AND SUM(initial_value_cv) > 0) THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobINICount, -- InitialCount Added 02/06/2025 - New count column for INI, to be used AS a seperate Dashboard and not part of TotalCount_v2, AS it is counted with Contract count.
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
    ELSE  0
  END AS JobNonINICount, -- Added 02/06/2025 - Non INI SPC counts are only counted in TotalCount_v2,
  (
  -- Added 02/06/2025 - Contract Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract so the 1 is represents the contract not the INI 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) = 'C' THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  )
  +
  (
-- Added 02/06/2025 - Jobs(Non-INI): One-time or Special Count = 1, The INI is inside of a contract. 
    CASE
      WHEN  MAX(contract_Job_or_Product) IN ('P','J') THEN 1
      ELSE  0
    END
  ) AS TotalCount_v2,
  --(ContractCount + JobNonINICount)  -- Changed 02/06/2025 based on new logic considering INI count part of contract
  --Maybe consider TotalCount_v2 as just 1 or in the next stage do ContractCount+JobNonINICount for a more streamlined and business look
  CASE
    WHEN  MAX(effective_date) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE  'N'
  END AS StartedYN, -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
  MAX(a.cancel_reason_code) AS cancel_reason_code,
  MAX(indTAP_YN) AS indTAP_YN,
  MAX(TAPType) AS TAPType,
  MAX(lead_employee_id) AS lead_employee_id,
  -- Calculated fields
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN effective_date IS NULL
        THEN annual_value_cv -- Switched to effective_date to match Flagship starts sales report
      ELSE
        starts_value
    END
     ) AS ContractValue_cv,
  SUM(recurring_value)        AS RecurringValue_cv,
  SUM(raw_value)              AS RawValue_cv,
  SUM(initial_value_cv)       AS InitialValue_cv,
  SUM(spc_value_cv)           AS SpcValue_cv,
  SUM(annual_value_cv)        AS AnnualValue_cv,
  SUM(discount_amt)           AS discount_amt_cv,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN  (service_type_code <> 'RNL') THEN rawsale_amt
      ELSE  0
    END
    ) AS rawsale_amt_cv,
  CASE
    WHEN  employee_primary_designation_code = 'SUMMSLS' THEN 'HAWX - Summer Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS SummerSalesIND,
  TMXR.Status AS RenewalStatus,

  -- Mission new values for values - Steven McCaffrey 3/22/2025
  SUM(contract_value_v3) as contract_value_v3,
  SUM(job_nonrecurring_value_v3) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_value_v3) AS job_ini_value_v3,
  SUM(job_recurring_count_v3) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  SUM(job_ini_count_v3) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  SUM(contract_count_v3) AS contract_count_v3,
  SUM(TA_TotalSales) AS TA_TotalSales


FROM      bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_tdw_stage2_Contract_V2          AS a
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_Product_Mission_PestPac_Service_Map`   AS p    ON TRIM(a.sa_type_code) = TRIM(p.Template)
                                                                                               AND TRIM(a.item_code) = TRIM(p.Item)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SalesAgreement_Number ORDER BY SalesAgreement_Number, ar_activity_accounting_date DESC) AS RowNum
          FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tmx_termite_renewals
          ) AS TMXR ON a.sales_agreement_number = TMXR.SalesAgreement_Number AND RowNum = 1 
LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S3.WO_NextScheduled_Date NS ON a.sales_agreement_number = NS.sales_agreement_number

GROUP BY
  a.market_type,
  buncod_assigned,

  region_code_assigned,
  postal_code,
  state_code,
  city_code,
  employee_id,

     				end

from t3 a

SELECT 
-- View: bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_unf_Contract_V2
-- Description: Sales unified view 
-- Created: 2025-04-01 17:18:34.750000+00:00
-- Modified: 2025-11-21 18:34:15.723000+00:00

-- SQL Definition:

  a.`SOURCE`, --tdw
  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS Contract,
  SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS salesID ,
  a.MarketType AS CustomerType,
  CASE 
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(inactive_status_code)) = 'INA' AND UPPER(TRIM(inactive_status_description)) = 'CONVERTED'
    THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS inactive_converted_ind,
  a.ServiceType,
  CASE
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'C' THEN 'Contract (Recurring)'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'I' THEN 'Job - INI'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'J' THEN 'Job'
    WHEN a.ServiceType = 'P' THEN 'Product'
  END AS ServiceType_Description,
  a.ProductCode,
  --a.ProductGroup, Old Product Group. This comes from Mission. The new ones below are pulled from the new source

  sc.product_category_nm AS Category,
 sc.service_line_nm	AS ServiceLine,
 sc.service_desc AS Service_Code_Description,
 sc.product_group_nm AS ProductGroup,
 sc.lob_cd AS LOB,
 sc.lob_desc AS LOB_Description,

  SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) SellDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) AS SellDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) StartDate ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYearMonth ,
  CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.StartDate) AS INT64) AS StartDateYear ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.CancelDate AS DATE) CancelDate ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYearMonth ,
  IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.CancelDate) AS INT64),0) AS CancelDateYear ,
  a.cancel_reason_code CancelReasonCode,
  a.division_code_assigned AS MarketCode,
  a.region_code_assigned AS RegionCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedBranch) >= 3 THEN a.AssignedBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedBranchCode,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedServiceBranch) >= 3 THEN a.AssignedServiceBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedServiceBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedServiceBranch,
  --a.AssignedBranch AS AssignedBranchCode, --Commentted out to add the code above in order to add leading 0's
  a.`Geography` AS Zip,
  a.State ,
  customer_name,-- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_phone, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  customer_email, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
  IFNULL(a.SalesPersonID, '') AS SalesPersonID,
  IFNULL(a.SalesPerson, '') AS SalesPerson,
  IFNULL(SAFE_CAST(a.SalesRole AS STRING), '') AS SalesRole,

  IFNULL(a.ExcessInitialValue,0) AS ExcessInitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.JobNonRecurringValue,0) AS JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0) AS TotalJobValue,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0) AS TotalValue, --Added 01/30/2024
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue,0) AS TotalValue_calc,
  IFNULL(a.TotalValue_v2,0) AS TotalValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.TotalJobValue,0) AS TotalJobValue_V2,
  IFNULL(a.ContractValue,0) AS ContractValue_V2,

  TotalJobCount AS TotalJobCount,
  TotalCount AS TotalCount,
  TotalCount_V2 AS TotalCount_V2,
  ContractCount AS ContractCount_V2,
  JobINICount AS JobINICount_V2,
  JobNonINICount AS JobNonINICount_V2,
  a.StartedYN AS StartedInd,

  CASE
    WHEN a.StartedYN='Y' AND a.Startdate >= a.SellDate THEN DATE_DIFF(a.StartDate, a.SellDate, DAY)
    ELSE 0
  END AS DaysToStart,
  CASE
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS RawCancelInd,
  CASE
    WHEN a.StartedYN <> 'Y' AND a.CancelDate IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' AND a.CancelDate >= a.SellDate THEN DATE_DIFF(a.CancelDate , a.SellDate, DAY)
    ELSE 0
  END AS DaysToRawCancel,
  IndTAP_YN AS TAPInd,
  TAPType AS TAPType,
  lead_employee_id AS lead_employee_id,
  SAFE_CAST('' AS STRING) AS SetupOrderType ,
  SAFE_CAST(a.SalesEmployeeNumberRTX AS STRING) AS SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
  SAFE_CAST(routetech_employee_jde_number AS STRING) AS TechOnSiteEmployeeNumber, 
  routetech_name AS TechOnSiteEmployeeName, 
  route AS RouteCode, 
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS LocationID,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS LocationCode,
 SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS BillToID,
 SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS BillToCode,
  SAFE_CAST(SummerSalesIND AS STRING) AS SummerSalesIND,
  CASE
    WHEN
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      OR
      SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
        DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
        DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      THEN 'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY,
  CASE
    WHEN a.StartDate IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        OR
        SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), YEAR) AND
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        THEN 'T'
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY_Start,
  '' AS OldSetupNum,
  RenewalStatus,
  '' AS freq_code, -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as blank
  false AS service_has_an_initial, -- This is for RNA Renewal Calc just marking as null
  next_scheduled_date,

  IFNULL(contract_value_v3,0) AS contract_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_nonrecurring_value_v3,0) AS job_nonrecurring_value_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_value_v3,0) AS job_ini_value_v3,

  IFNULL(job_recurring_count_v3,0) AS job_recurring_count_v3,
  IFNULL(job_ini_count_v3,0) AS job_ini_count_v3,
  IFNULL(contract_count_v3,0) AS contract_count_v3

LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_product` sc ON a.ProductCode = UPPER(TRIM(sc.service_cd))
WHERE
      IFNULL(CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%Y', a.SellDate) AS INT64),0) >= ( EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE())-3 )
      AND SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE()
      AND renewalind = 0 --This is to mark if service_type_code <> 'RNL'
      AND NonNAT_salesemployeejobcode = 1 -- This is to remove the NAT Sales Job Codes from Sales 1=NON NATIONAL 0 = NATIONAL

with a as (SELECT

  snp_date,
  cast(date_sub(snp_date, interval 1 month )as timestamp) as activity_date,
  activity_type,
  svc_code as service_code,
  market_type,
  business_unit,
  class_code,
  zip,
  activity_amount,
  yearmonth,
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    src_system,
    contract_id, --this is concat(FOLCUSTID,'-',FOLWKST,'-',FOLWO_)
    snp_date,
    yearmonth,
    svc_code, -- this is  concat(FOLLOB,FOLTOS,FOLSVC) -- there can be multiple svc_codes per contract
    market_type,

    --district as business_unit, -- 11/15/2024
    class_code,
    zip,
    start,
    price_increase,
    additions,
    deductions,
    `new`,
    adjustments,
    terminations,
    aquisitions,
    branch_change,
    netchange,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly`
   ) p
 UNPIVOT(activity_amount FOR activity_type IN (price_increase,
      additions ,
      deductions,
      `new`,
      adjustments,
      terminations,
      aquisitions,
      branch_change))
       WHERE activity_amount  <> 0
),
u as (SELECT
  src_system,
  contract_id,
  snp_date,
  cast(date_sub(snp_date, interval 1 month )as timestamp) as activity_date,
  activity_type,
  svc_code as service_code,
  market_type,
  business_unit,
  class_code,
  zip,
  activity_units,
  yearmonth,

    snp_date,
    yearmonth,
    svc_code, -- this is  concat(FOLLOB,FOLTOS,FOLSVC) -- there can be multiple svc_codes per contract
    market_type,
    CAST(district as string) AS business_unit, -- 10/09/2024 modified per David Comas request

    additions_units,

      deductions_units,
      new_units,
      adjustments_units,
      terminations_units,
      aquisitions_units,
      branch_change_units))
    WHERE activity_units  <> 0
)
select 
 coalesce(a.src_system,u.src_system) as src_system,
  coalesce(a.contract_id,u.contract_id) as contract_id ,
  coalesce(a.snp_date,u.snp_date) as snp_date,
 coalesce(a.activity_date,u.activity_date) as activity_date,
  coalesce(a.service_code,u.service_code) as service_code,
  coalesce(a.market_type,u.market_type) as market_type,

  CAST(coalesce(a.business_unit,u.business_unit) AS string) as business_unit, -- 11/15/2024

  coalesce(a.zip,u.zip) as zip,

       when 'aquisitions' then 'acquisitions'

       coalesce(a.activity_type,u.activity_type)
       end

 a.activity_amount,

        'RES'
   end as CustomerType, --- Added 10/30/2024  -a.CustomerType,
	a.ClassificationCode,
	a.Zip,
	a.lob_code ,
	W.Contract_ProductGroup,
	ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping,
	'') product_grouping,
	CASE
		WHEN ( (ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') <> 'Pest Control')
		or (last_day(date_sub(AsOfDate,
		interval 1 month)) < '2023-10-01')
		OR (ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,
		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate)) < '2023-10-01')   			
    	) 
    		THEN ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,

		--NEW Business and Other activities for Pest control

		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate))
	END AS Portfolio_startdate ,
	---W.workdate Portfolio_startdate,

		'') <> 'Pest Control')
		or (last_day(date_sub(AsOfDate,
		interval 1 month)) < '2023-10-01')
		OR (ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,
		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate)) < '2023-10-01')
	    	)
	    		THEN ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,
		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate))
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') = 'Pest Control'
		--and a.GainLossFlag = 'Sales' 
		    	THEN W.workdate
		-- NEW Business and Other activities for Pest control 
		ELSE ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,
		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate))
	END
						) AS int64),
	    0) AS Portfolio_startdate_yyyymmdd,
	CASE
		WHEN ( (ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') <> 'Pest Control')
		--OR (a.GainLossFlag <> 'Sales') 
		OR (last_day(date_sub(AsOfDate,
		interval 1 month)) < '2023-10-01')
		OR (ifnull(a.SetupAddDate,
		ifnull(ss.Adddate,
		sst.Adddate)) < '2023-10-01')
    		)
    		THEN 'Y'
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') = 'Pest Control'
		and W.workdate is not null
		-- and a.GainLossFlag = 'Sales' 
    		THEN 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS Portfolio_Started_ind,
	CASE
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') <> 'Pest Control' THEN 'N'
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') = 'Pest Control'

		ELSE 'N'
	END AS Newbus_Pest_Control_ind,

			--						,a.SetupAddDate) -- Added 11/14/2024
			--CAST('2023-09-01 20:00:00.000' as timestamp)	-- Added 11/14/2024
			CAST(null as timestamp)	-- Added 11/14/2024
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') <> 'Pest Control' THEN cast(AsOfDate as timestamp)
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') = 'Pest Control'
		and a.GainLossFlag = 'Sales' THEN W.workdate
		-- NEW Business Pest control 
		ELSE cast(AsOfDate as timestamp)
	END AS activity_date,
	ifnull(CAST(format_date('%Y%m',
	CASE
	  WHEN a.GainLossFlag = 'Sales' and ifnull(ifnull(ss.userdef19, sst.userdef19),'') <> '' and (last_day(date_sub(AsOfDate,	interval 1 month)) > '2023-10-01')

			--ifnull(ss.Adddate,

			--ifnull(ifnull(ss.startdate,

			--						,a.SetupAddDate) -- Added 11/14/2024
			--CAST('2023-09-01 20:00:00.000' as timestamp)	-- Added 11/14/2024
			CAST(null as timestamp)	-- Added 11/14/2024
		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,

		WHEN ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping ,
		'') = 'Pest Control'

with most_recent_friday as (
    -- get the current day of week and the most recent Friday (including today if today is Friday)
    -- this is used to determine which days to select as revenue from TMX GLGLE tables and which
    -- days to estimate from DOR tables. The logic is that we normally select up through current
    -- day - 2 as real revenue and day - 1 is estimated. But on Saturday, Sunday, and Monday,
    -- we treat Friday as the most recent day of real revenue.
    select
        format_date('%a', current_date) as current_day_of_week,
        parse_date('%Y%m%d', cast(max(acctdate_SID) as string)) as latest_friday,
    from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tdw_daily_revenue_detail
    where format_date('%a', cast(parse_date('%Y%m%d', cast(acctdate_SID as string)) as date)) = 'Fri'
),
tmx_dor_date_logic as (
    select
        case
            when current_day_of_week in ('Sun', 'Mon') then latest_friday
            else current_date - 2
        end as last_committed_revenue_date
    from most_recent_friday
)
select
    date,
    Branch,
    round(sum(Amount),0) as Amount,
    product_grouping,
    report_market_type,
    service_type_code,
    rev_committed_ind,
    source_system
from (
    select
        cast(TransactionDate as date)   date,
        Branch,
        Amount,
        case
            when DivisionCode = 'R' then 'RES'
            else 'COM'
        end as report_market_type,
        case
            when product_grouping = 'Termite' then 'Termite'
            else 'Pest'
        end as product_grouping,
        case when right(LOB,1) = 'J' then 'Job'
             when right(LOB,1) = 'R' then 'Contract'
             else 'Other'
        end as service_type_code,
        True as rev_committed_ind,
        'rpp' as source_system
    from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_rpp_daily_revenue_detail

    union all

    select
        cast(TransactionDate as date) as date,
        Branch,
        Amount,
        DivisionCode as report_market_type,
        case
            when product_grouping = 'Termite Control' then 'Termite'
            else 'Pest'
        end as product_grouping,
        service_type_code,
        True as rev_committed_ind,
        'nav13' as source_system,
    from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_NA_daily_revenue_detail

    union all

    select
        cast(TransactionDate as date) as date,
        Branch,
        Amount,
        DivisionCode as report_market_type,
        case
            when product_grouping = 'Termite Control' then 'Termite'
            else 'Pest'
        end as product_grouping,
        service_type_code,
        True as rev_committed_ind,
        'jde' as source_system
    from `bidata-sharedus-production`.S1.vw_iris_jde_daily_revenue_detail

    union all

    select
        cast(parse_date("%Y%m%d",cast(acctdate_SID as string)) as date) as date,
        JDEBuncod as Branch,
        GL_base_amount as Amount,
        report_market_type,
        case
            when service_line1_long in ('Termite Control') then 'Termite'
            when service_line1_long in ('Pest Control', 'Pest Mosquito', 'Merchandise Sales') then 'Pest'
            else 'Pest'
        end as product_grouping,
        case
            when service_type_code in ("ODR", "REG", "RNL") then "Contract"
            when service_type_code in ("INI", "SPC") then "Job"
            when service_type_code = "BIT" and service_line1_long = "Termite Control" then "Job"
            when service_type_code = "BIT" and service_line1_long != "Termite Control" then "Contract"
            else "Other"
        end as service_type_code,
        True as rev_committed_ind,
        'tdw' as source_system
    from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.vw_tdw_daily_revenue_detail
    where
        parse_date('%Y%m%d', cast(acctdate_SID as string)) <= (select last_committed_revenue_date from tmx_dor_date_logic)

    union all

    select
        date,
        buncod_id Branch,
        Amount,
        market_type_code report_market_type,
        case
            when product_grouping = 'Termite Control' then 'Termite'
            else 'Pest'
        end as product_grouping,
        service_type_code,
        False as rev_committed_ind,
        'tdw' as source_system
    from bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_dor
    where case when format_date('%a', current_date) in ('Sun', 'Mon') then date >= current_date - 2 else date >= current_date - 1 end
)
group by date, Branch, product_grouping, report_market_type, service_type_code, source_system, rev_committed_ind

    WID.PropertyState,
    WID.PropertyPostCode,

      WHEN UPPER(WID.LeadSystem) = 'CCM' THEN 'PIG Lead Sent to Branch/OSP'
      WHEN UPPER(WID.LeadSystem) IN ('LEADEXEC', 'LEAD_EXEC') THEN 'Lead Sent to ISP Queue'

TS.LimitMTD_LY AS limit_mtd_ly_ind,
TS.LimitMTD_LY_Start AS limit_mtd_ly_start_date_ind,
TS.RenewalStatus AS termite_renewal_status,
CASE
  WHEN TS.SellDateYear < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 'Y'
  WHEN TS.RenewalStatus IS NULL AND TS.SellDateYear = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 'Y'
  ELSE 'N'
END AS termite_renewal_current_sell_year_remove_ind,
CASE
  WHEN TS.StartDateYear < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 'Y'
  WHEN TS.RenewalStatus IS NULL AND TS.StartDateYear = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 'Y'
  ELSE 'N'
END AS termite_renewal_current_start_year_remove_ind,
CASE
  WHEN (StartedInd = 'Y' AND CAST(StartDate AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE())
    THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
END AS started_view_ind,
CASE
  WHEN StartedInd = 'Y'
    AND DATE_DIFF(StartDate,SellDate,DAY) <= 2
    THEN 1
  ELSE 0
END AS started_within_two_days_ind,
CASE
  WHEN StartedInd = 'Y'
    AND SellDateYearMonth = StartDateYearMonth
    THEN 1
  ELSE 0
END AS started_in_month_ind,
CASE WHEN StartedInd = 'Y' THEN DATE_DIFF(StartDate, SellDate,DAY) ELSE 0 END AS days_to_start,
CASE
  WHEN DATE_DIFF(TS.StartDate,TS.SellDate, MONTH) > 6 THEN "Y"
  ELSE "N"
END AS sold_to_start_greater_than_6_months,

--Employee Information
TS.EmployeeNum AS employee_num,
CASE
  WHEN TS.SalesPerson = 'OWN, QOTH' THEN 'ECOMM'
  WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(TS.SalesPerson)) = 0 THEN '*NON-SALES PROFESSIONAL'
  ELSE TS.SalesPerson
END AS sales_person_nm,
EMP.Job_Title AS job_title,
EMP.Harmonized_Sales_Role,
EMP.Sales_Org AS sales_org,
TS.TechOnSiteEmployeeNumber AS tech_onsite_employee_num,
TS.TechOnSiteEmployeeName AS tech_onsite_employee_nm,
TS.RouteCode AS route_code,

--Branch Information
TS.AssignedBranchCode AS assigned_branch_code,
TS.AssignedServiceBranch AS assigned_service_branch_code,
BCH.Branch_num AS current_state_branch_code,
BCH.Branch_nm AS branch_nm,
BCH.Brand_nm AS brand_nm,
BCH.branch_status_cd AS branch_status_cd,
CONCAT(BCH.coa_branch_num, " - ", BCH.Branch_nm) AS assigned_branch_code_nm,
CONCAT(BCH.Region_cd, " - ", BCH.Region_Nm) AS assigned_region_code_nm,
CONCAT(BCH.Market_Cd, " - ", BCH.Market_nm) AS assigned_market_code_nm,
BCH.heritage_org_cd AS branch_heritage_org,
BCH.operating_system_nm AS branch_operating_system,

--Sales $ Values
TS.contract_value_v3 AS contract_value,
TS.job_nonrecurring_value_v3 AS job_non_ini_value,
TS.job_ini_value_v3 AS job_ini_value,
TS.job_nonrecurring_value_v3 + job_ini_value_v3 AS total_job_value,
TS.job_nonrecurring_value_v3 + job_ini_value_v3 + TS.contract_value_v3 AS total_value,

--Sales Unit Counts
TS.contract_count_v3 + rpp_ini_count_increase_renewal AS contract_count,
TS.job_recurring_count_v3 AS job_non_ini_count,
TS.job_ini_count_v3 AS job_ini_count,
TS.contract_count_v3 + TS.job_recurring_count_v3 + TS.rpp_ini_count_increase_renewal AS total_count,

--Customer Information
TS.CustomerType AS customer_type,
TS.Customer_Name AS customer_name,
TS.Customer_Phone AS customer_phone,
TS.Zip AS location_zip, 

--PestPac Specific Data
TS.LocationCode AS location_code,
TS.LocationID AS location_id,
TS.BillToCode AS bill_to_code,
TS.BillToID AS bill_to_id,
freq_code,
service_has_an_initial,
CASE
  WHEN TS.SOURCE = 'RPP'
        AND TS.ServiceType_Description = 'Contract (Recurring)'
        AND service_has_an_initial = TRUE
        AND freq_code = 'ANNUAL'
  THEN "REMOVE - RPP 2nd YEAR"
  ELSE "KEEP"
END AS rpp_renewal

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractTotalSales_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw_V2` AS TS
LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees AS EMP ON TS.EmployeeNum = EMP.Employee_Number
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch` AS BCH ON TS.AssignedBranchCode = BCH.branch_num
LEFT JOIN bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_product AS P ON TS.ProductCode = P.service_cd

SELECT
