  business,
  --extract(year from lst.src_system_cre_date)*100 + extract(month from (lst.src_system_cre_date)) as received_yearmonth, 
  date_trunc(l.src_system_cre_date,day) as received_date,
  case when l.src_system ='PNS' then 'SE' else l.src_system end as source_system,
 --lead_attributes
  case market_type when 'COM' then 'Commercial' when 'RES' then 'Residential' else coalesce(market_type,'Residential') end as market_type, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Type_Mapped,lead_type) as lead_type,
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,lead_source) as lead_source, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_1, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_2, 
  case when l.src_system in('TMLE','TDW') then lfm.Lead_Form_Type_Mapped else null end as lead_form_type,
  case when l.src_system in('TMLE','TDW') then lfm.Affiliate_Mapped else null end as lead_form_affiliate,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Name_Mapped,concat('Not Mapped - ',primary_pest)) as primary_pest,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Report_Group_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as primary_pest_report_group,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Type_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A ') as primary_pest_type_1, 
  lppm.Solution_Mapped as primary_pest_solution,
--lead_field_assingment 
coalesce(upper(b.brand_nm),upper(lfa.brand)) as brand,

  case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end as assigned_branch, 
   case when assigned_branch is null then (case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end ) else (case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end  ) end as report_branch, 
  coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee) as assigned_employee,
  --lae.Job_Family_Group as assigned_employee_job_role,   
--lead_proposals
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then sum(lpp.quantity) else sum(lp.quantity) end as services_proposed,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then sum(lpp.service_amount) else sum(lp.service_amount) end as value_proposed,
--lead_sales */
  --'Not yet available' as start_date,
  min(ls.eff_date) as sold_date,
  sum(ls.quantity) as services_sold,
  sum(ls.total_amount) as value_sold_raw,
  sum(ls.job_amount) as sold_job_amount,
  sum(ls.contract_amount) as sold_contract_amount,
  sum(ls.product_amount) as sold_product_amount,
  --lead_sales_link to contractstarted
  sum(starts.value_sold_started) as value_sold_started,
  sum(starts.started_contract_count) as started_contract_count,
  --lead_stage
  sum(lstag.contacts_stage_count) as contacts_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.MQL_stage_count) as MQL_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.SQL_stage_count) as SQL_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.scheduled_stage_count) as scheduled_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.inspected_stage_count) as inspected_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.proposed_stage_count) as proposed_stage_count,
  sum(lstag.sold_stage_count) as sold_stage_count,
--lead_status
  coalesce(lcrm.Cancel_Reason_Mapped, concat('Not Mapped - ',cancel_reason)) as cancel_reason,  
  count(lstat.cancel_date) as canceled_count,
  count(lstat.closed_lost_date) as closed_lost_count,
  count(lstat.closed_won_date) as closed_won_count
FROM
  (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct rtx_lead_sid, src_system, src_system_attr_id, src_system_attr_id_value, upstream_src_system, upstream_src_system_attr_id, upstream_src_system_attr_id_value, src_system_cre_date from unnest (lead_source_system) order by system_order desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system` ) l
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_business` lb on l.src_system = lb.Source_System
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
               market_type,lead_type,lead_source,primary_pest
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes` ) la on l.rtx_lead_uid = la.rtx_lead_uid
  left join (select `Key`,Lead_Source_Mapped,Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,Lead_Type_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_lead_source`) lsm on upper(lsm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",coalesce(lead_type,""),"|",coalesce(lead_source,"")))
  left join (select `Key`,Pest_Name_Mapped, Pest_Report_Group_Mapped, Pest_Type_1_Mapped, Solution_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_primary_pest`) lppm on upper(lppm.key) = concat(Mapping,"|",upper(primary_pest))
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,

             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' then assignment_value end as assigned_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as assigned_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'originating_branch' then assignment_value end as originating_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'originating_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'sales_employee' then assignment_value end as sales_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'sales_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'brand' then assignment_value end as brand 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'brand' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'brand' then assignment_value end as brand_first 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'brand' order by eff_date asc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'lead_followup' then assignment_value end as lead_followup 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'lead_followup' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'marketing_partner' then assignment_value end as marketing_partner 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'marketing_partner' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`
              ) lfa on l.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid
   left join (select `Key`,Lead_Form_Type_Mapped,Affiliate_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_lead_form`) lfm on upper(lfm.key) = upper(concat(lead_followup,"|",coalesce(brand_first,""),"|",coalesce(marketing_partner,"")))
  left join   (select branch_num, brand_nm from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch`) b on lfa.assigned_branch = b.branch_num
  left join (select `Key`,Cancel_Reason_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_cancel_reason`) lcrm on upper(lcrm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",cancel_reason))
 -- left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` lae on lfa.assigned_employee = lae.Employee_Number
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid, sum(quantity) as quantity,sum(service_amount) as service_amount,max(eff_date) as eff_date
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_proposals` group by rtx_lead_uid
             ) lp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lp.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, service_amount, eff_date from unnest (proposals) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`  
  )           lpp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lpp.rtx_lead_uid --lpp take last record because proposals can be deleted in Winning Formula
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, total_amount, job_amount, contract_amount, product_amount, eff_date from unnest (sales) order by eff_date asc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_sales`  
  )           ls on l.rtx_lead_uid = ls.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Cancelled' then eff_date end as cancel_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Cancelled' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Lost' then eff_date end as closed_lost_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Lost' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Won' then eff_date end as closed_won_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Won'order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
               from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_status`) lstat on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstat.rtx_lead_uid
    left join (select  rtx_lead_uid,contacts_stage_count,
mql_stage_count,
sql_stage_count,
case when sql_stage_count = 0 then 0 else scheduled_stage_count end as scheduled_stage_count,
case when sql_stage_count = 0 then 0 else inspected_stage_count end as inspected_stage_count,
case when sql_stage_count = 0 then 0 else proposed_stage_count end as proposed_stage_count,
sold_stage_count
    from (select
              rtx_lead_uid,
              max(contacts_multiplier) as contacts_stage_count,
              case when max(mql_multiplier)> 0 then max(mql_multiplier) - min(remove_duplicates)  else 0 end as mql_stage_count,
              case when max(sql_multiplier)> 0 then max(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source) else 0 end as sql_stage_count,
              max(scheduled_multiplier) as scheduled_stage_count,
              max(inspected_multiplier) as inspected_stage_count,
              max(proposed_multiplier) as proposed_stage_count,
              max(sold_multiplier) as sold_stage_count
              from (SELECT 
              s.rtx_lead_uid,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then 1 else 0 end as contacts_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'  then 1 
              when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then 1  else 0 end as mql_multiplier,
              case when cancel_reason = 'duplicate' then 1 else 0 end as remove_duplicates,
              case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then 1 else 0 end as sql_multiplier,
              case when cancel_reason = 'bad_source' then 1 when cancel_reason = 'duplicate' then 1 else 0 end as remove_bad_source,
              case when stage = 'Scheduled' then 1 
              when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1
              else 0 end as scheduled_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when  assignment_value in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data') then 'bad_source' when  lower(assignment_value) like ('%duplicate%') then 'duplicate' else 'include' end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment` )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid  
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid)) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid
  left join    (select sl.rtx_lead_uid, sum(TotalValue) as value_sold_started, sum(ContractCount) as started_contract_count
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_sale_link` sl
              left join (select Contract, TotalValue, ContractCount from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractStarted_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw`
              )  ss on sl.sale_system_attr_id_value = ss.Contract
              group by sl.rtx_lead_uid) starts on l.rtx_lead_uid = starts.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(src_system_cre_date,DAY) >= timestamp(date_add(date_trunc(current_date()-1, year), interval -1 year))
GROUP BY 
business,
  date_trunc(l.src_system_cre_date,day)  ,
  l.src_system,
 --lead_attributes
  market_type, 
  lead_type, 
  lsm.Lead_Type_Mapped,
  lead_source,
  lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,
  lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,
  lsm.Lead_Channel_2_Mapped, 
  primary_pest,
  lppm.Pest_Report_Group_Mapped,
  lppm.Pest_Type_1_Mapped,
  lppm.Solution_Mapped,
--lead_field_assingment 
coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee),
  lfa.assigned_branch,
  originating_branch,
   cancel_reason,
   coalesce(upper(b.brand_nm),upper(lfa.brand)),
   Lead_Form_Type_Mapped,
   Affiliate_Mapped

 -- left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees` lae on lfa.assigned_employee = lae.Employee_Number

              max(sold_multiplier) as sold_stage_count,

              max(mql_stage_date) as mql_stage_date,
              max(sql_stage_date) as sql_stage_date,
              max(scheduled_stage_date) as scheduled_stage_date,
              max(inspected_stage_date) as inspected_stage_date,
              max(proposed_stage_date) as proposed_stage_date,
              max(sold_stage_date) as sold_stage_date
              from (SELECT 
              s.rtx_lead_uid,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then 1 else 0 end as contacts_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'  then 1 
              when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then 1  else 0 end as mql_multiplier,
              case when cancel_reason = 'duplicate' then 1 else 0 end as remove_duplicates,
              case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then 1 else 0 end as sql_multiplier,
              case when cancel_reason = 'bad_source' then 1 when cancel_reason = 'duplicate' then 1 else 0 end as remove_bad_source,
              case when stage = 'Scheduled' then 1 
              when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1
              else 0 end as scheduled_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then min(eff_date) end as contacts_stage_date 
              ,case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as mql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as sql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Scheduled' then min(eff_date) end as scheduled_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Inspected' then min(eff_date) end as inspected_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Proposed' then min(eff_date) end as proposed_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sold' then min(eff_date) end as sold_stage_date
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when  assignment_value in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data') then 'bad_source' when  lower(assignment_value) like ('%duplicate%') then 'duplicate' else 'include' end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment` )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid   
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid)) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(src_system_cre_date,DAY) >= timestamp(date_add(date_trunc(current_date()-1, year), interval -1 year))

SELECT 
--lead_tracker source system uid vw
  l.rtx_lead_uid,
  l.src_system_attr_id_value AS lead_ID,
--lead_tracker source system uid vw to business map
  business,
  l.src_system_cre_date as received_date,
  case when l.src_system ='PNS' then 'SE' else l.src_system end as source_system,
 --lead_attributes
  case market_type when 'COM' then 'Commercial' when 'RES' then 'Residential' else coalesce(market_type,'Residential') end as market_type,  
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Type_Mapped,lead_type) as lead_type,
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,lead_source) as lead_source, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_1, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_2, 
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Name_Mapped,concat('Not Mapped - ',primary_pest)) as primary_pest,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Report_Group_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as primary_pest_report_group,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Type_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A ') as primary_pest_type_1, 
  lppm.Solution_Mapped as primary_pest_solution,
--lead_contact
  name as contact_name, 
  phone as contact_phone, 
  email as contact_email,
  address as contact_address, 
  city as contact_city, 
  state as contact_state, 
  postal_code as contact_zip_code,
--lead_field_assingment 
  coalesce(upper(b.brand_nm),upper(lfa.brand)) as brand,
  case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end as originating_branch,  
    case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end as assigned_branch,  
   case when assigned_branch is null then (case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end ) else (case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end  ) end as report_branch,
   coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee) as assigned_employee_id,
 -- lfa.creating_employee as created_by_employee_code,
  coalesce(lcrm.Cancel_Reason_Mapped, concat('Not Mapped - ',cancel_reason)) as cancel_reason,  
--lead_field_assingment > Fact_RTX_Employees
  concat(lse.Last_Name,', ',lse.Preferred_First_Name) as sales_employee,
  lse.Employee_Number as sales_employee_id,
  coalesce(lae.Employee_Number,lfa.createdby_employee,lfa.creating_employee) as created_by_employee_id,
  lse.RTX_Branch_Code as sales_employee_branch,
  lse.Job_Family_Group as sales_employee_job_role,
  lae.RTX_Branch_Code as created_by_employee_branch,
  lae.Job_Family_Group as created_by_employee_job_role,   
--lead_inspections 
 li.scheduled_date,
  li.inspected_date,
--lead_proposals
  lp.eff_date as proposed_date,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then lpp.quantity else lp.quantity end as services_proposed,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then lpp.service_amount else lp.service_amount end as value_proposed,
--lead_sales */
  ls.eff_date as sold_date,
  --'Not yet available' as start_date,
  ls.quantity as services_sold,
  ls.total_amount as value_sold_raw,
  ls.job_amount as sold_job_amount,
  ls.contract_amount as sold_contract_amount,
  ls.product_amount as sold_product_amount,
--lead_stales_link to contractstarted
  starts.value_sold_started,
  starts.started_contract_count,
--lead_stage_vw
  lstg.stage as lead_status,
--lead_status
  lstat.cancel_date,
  lstat.closed_lost_date,
  lstat.closed_won_date ,
--lead_stage
  lstag.contacts_stage_count,
  lstag.MQL_stage_count,
  lstag.SQL_stage_count,
  lstag.scheduled_stage_count,
  lstag.inspected_stage_count,
  lstag.proposed_stage_count,
  lstag.sold_stage_count,
  lstag.contacts_stage_date,
  lstag.MQL_stage_date,
  lstag.SQL_stage_date,
  lstag.scheduled_stage_date,
  lstag.inspected_stage_date,
  lstag.proposed_stage_date,
  lstag.sold_stage_date,
--lead_status 
  case when lstat.cancel_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as canceled_count,
  case when lstat.closed_lost_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as closed_lost_count,
  case when lstat.closed_won_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as closed_won_count
FROM
  (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct rtx_lead_sid, src_system, src_system_attr_id, src_system_attr_id_value, upstream_src_system, upstream_src_system_attr_id, upstream_src_system_attr_id_value, src_system_cre_date from unnest (lead_source_system) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system` ) l 
   left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_business` lb on l.src_system = lb.Source_System
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct market_type,lead_type,lead_source,primary_pest from unnest (attributes) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes` ) la on l.rtx_lead_uid = la.rtx_lead_uid
left join (select `Key`,Lead_Source_Mapped,Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,Lead_Type_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_lead_source`) lsm on upper(lsm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",coalesce(lead_type,""),"|",coalesce(lead_source,"")))
  left join (select `Key`,Pest_Name_Mapped, Pest_Report_Group_Mapped, Pest_Type_1_Mapped, Solution_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_primary_pest`) lppm on upper(lppm.key) = concat(Mapping,"|",upper(primary_pest))
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct name, address, city, state, postal_code, phone, email from unnest (contact) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_contact`  )lc on l.rtx_lead_uid = lc.rtx_lead_uid
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'sales_employee' then assignment_value end as sales_employee 
             from unnest (fields)  where assignment_type = 'sales_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'creating_employee' then assignment_value end as createdby_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'creating_employee' order by eff_date asc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as creating_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date asc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as assigned_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'originating_branch' then assignment_value end as originating_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'originating_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' then assignment_value end as assigned_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'brand' then assignment_value end as brand 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'brand' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`
              ) lfa on l.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid
  left join   (select branch_num, brand_nm from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch`) b on lfa.assigned_branch = b.branch_num
  left join (select `Key`,Cancel_Reason_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_cancel_reason`) lcrm on upper(lcrm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",cancel_reason))
  left join (select Employee_Number,RTX_Branch_Code,Job_Family_Group,Last_Name, Preferred_First_Name from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`) lse on lfa.sales_employee = lse.Employee_Number
  left join (select Employee_Number,RTX_Branch_Code,Job_Family_Group from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`) lae on lfa.creating_employee = lae.Employee_Number
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when activity_type = 'Scheduled' then activity_date end as scheduled_date 
              from unnest (activities) where activity_type = 'Scheduled'  order by eff_date desc limit 1).* ,
              (select as struct case when activity_type = 'Inspected' then activity_date end as inspected_date 
              from unnest (activities) where activity_type = 'Inspected' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* ,
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_inspections`
              ) li on l.rtx_lead_uid = li.rtx_lead_uid 
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid, sum(quantity) as quantity,sum(service_amount) as service_amount,max(eff_date) as eff_date
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_proposals` group by rtx_lead_uid
             ) lp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lp.rtx_lead_uid 
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, service_amount, eff_date from unnest (proposals) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`  
  )           lpp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lpp.rtx_lead_uid --lpp take last record because proposals can be deleted in Winning Formula
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, total_amount, job_amount, contract_amount, product_amount, eff_date from unnest (sales) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_sales`  
  )           ls on l.rtx_lead_uid = ls.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct stage from unnest (stage) order by stage_order desc,cre_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_stage`) lstg on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstg.rtx_lead_uid
 left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Cancelled' then eff_date end as cancel_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Cancelled' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Lost' then eff_date end as closed_lost_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Lost' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Won' then eff_date end as closed_won_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Won'order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
               from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_status`) lstat on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstat.rtx_lead_uid
left join    (select sl.rtx_lead_uid, sum(TotalValue) as value_sold_started, sum(ContractCount) as started_contract_count
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_sale_link` sl
              left join (select Contract, TotalValue, ContractCount from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractStarted_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw`
              )  ss on sl.sale_system_attr_id_value = ss.Contract
              group by sl.rtx_lead_uid) starts on l.rtx_lead_uid = starts.rtx_lead_uid
 left join (select
              rtx_lead_uid,
              sum(contacts_multiplier) as contacts_stage_count,
              sum(mql_multiplier) - min(remove_duplicates) as mql_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source) as sql_stage_count,
              (sum(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source)) * max(scheduled_multiplier) as scheduled_stage_count,
              (sum(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source)) * max(inspected_multiplier) as inspected_stage_count,
              (sum(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source)) * max(proposed_multiplier) as proposed_stage_count,
              (sum(sql_multiplier) - min(remove_bad_source)) * max(sold_multiplier) as sold_stage_count,
              max(contacts_stage_date) as contacts_stage_date,
              max(mql_stage_date) as mql_stage_date,
              max(sql_stage_date) as sql_stage_date,
              max(scheduled_stage_date) as scheduled_stage_date,
              max(inspected_stage_date) as inspected_stage_date,
              max(proposed_stage_date) as proposed_stage_date,
              max(sold_stage_date) as sold_stage_date
              from (SELECT 
              s.rtx_lead_uid,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then 1 else 0 end as contacts_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'  then 1 else 0 end as mql_multiplier,
              case when cancel_reason = 'duplicate' then 1 else 0 end as remove_duplicates,
              case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then 1 else 0 end as sql_multiplier,--to exclude bad source
              case when cancel_reason in( 'bad_source','duplicate' ) then 1 else 0 end as remove_bad_source,
              case when stage = 'Scheduled' then 1 
              when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1
              else 0 end as scheduled_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then min(eff_date) end as contacts_stage_date 
              ,case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as mql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as sql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Scheduled' then min(eff_date) end as scheduled_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Inspected' then min(eff_date) end as inspected_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Proposed' then min(eff_date) end as proposed_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sold' then min(eff_date) end as sold_stage_date
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when  assignment_value in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data') then 'bad_source' when  lower(assignment_value) like ('%duplicate%') then 'duplicate' else 'include' end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`  )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid   
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(src_system_cre_date, DAY) >= timestamp(date_add(date_trunc(current_date()-1, year), interval -1 year)) --timestamp(date_add(current_date()-1, interval -2 month)) --TIMESTAMP("2023-01-01")

SELECT
DDtl.*, -- Pulling all information from the Daily Detail and joining to the Emp Workday History to provide more insigts of the technican at the time of the sales 
BCH.region_cd AS Region_Code,   --Current State Region Code
BCH.region_nm AS Region_Name,   --Current State Region Name
BCH.market_cd AS Market_Code,   --Current State Market Code
BCH.market_nm AS Market_Name,   --Current State Market Name
BCH.branch_num AS Branch_Code,  --Current State Branch Code
CONCAT(BCH.branch_num,' - ',BCH.branch_nm) AS Branch_Name,  --Current State Branch Number and Branch Name concat for Power-BI Reporting
BCH.operating_system_nm AS Eligibility_Status,  --Current State Eligibility Status
EMP_WDHIST.Function_Code,  -- Function code is filterd out to 205 215 in the WHERE 
EMP_WDHIST.Employment_Status_Code,  -- Shows the status code at the start of each month for an employee. A/L (Active/On Leave) are the ones filtered out in the WHERE 
EMP_WDHIST.Continuous_Service_Date,  -- Indicates the start date of an employee 
EMP_WDHIST.File_Date  -- Indicates the date on which a file is pulled and stored in Employee Workday History. First day of each month in a date format Ex. 12/1/2025

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch` BCH
--Employee Workday History table is a sudo employee history that is built and maintained until the full solution is build out. The history is based on an employees history at the start of each month
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees_WorkdayHistory` AS EMP_WDHIST ON CASE WHEN LENGTH(EMP_WDHIST.Branch_Code) < 3 THEN LPAD(EMP_WDHIST.Branch_Code,3,'0') ELSE EMP_WDHIST.Branch_Code END = BCH.branch_num
LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_TAPSales_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw`  AS DDtl ON SAFE_CAST(EMP_WDHIST.Employee_ID AS STRING) = DDtl.Tech_Employee_Num 
                                            AND                                                                                                                                      
CONCAT(Reporting_Year ,' ', Reporting_Month) = CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM File_Date) AS STRING),' ', CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%b', File_Date) AS STRING))
WHERE
EMP_WDHIST.Function_Code IN ('205','215') --205 and 215 are considered the techs apart of the trusted advisor. Asked from stakeholders
  AND EMP_WDHIST.Employment_Status_Code IN ('A', 'L') 
          -- A - indicated employment status at the start of the month is active 
          -- L - indicated employment status at the start of the month is on leave

  --Changing the Market_Code from the E.Market_Code to the B.market_cd since the Market_Code in E does not contain the correct Market_Code prior to 7/1/2024. 
  --The stakeholders want the current Market_Code for better YOY comparisions 
  AND BCH.market_cd IN ('M530', 'M531','M532','M534','M535','M536','M537','M538','M539')

SELECT * FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.IntradaySales`;

SELECT 
Employee_ID,
UPPER(Employee_Name) AS Employee_Name,
Location_Code,
B.region_cd AS Region_Code,
B.region_nm AS Region_Name, 
B.market_cd AS Market_Code,
B.market_nm AS Market_Name,
B.branch_num AS Branch_Code,
CONCAT(B.branch_num,' - ',B.branch_nm) AS Branch_Name,
Function_Code,
Employment_Status_Code,
Continuous_Service_Date,
File_Date,
DATE_DIFF(File_Date,Continuous_Service_Date, DAY) AS DaysInService,
CASE 
  WHEN DATE_DIFF(File_Date,Continuous_Service_Date, DAY) > 365 
    THEN "EXPERIENCED TECHNICIAN" 
    ELSE "ROOKIE TECHNICIAN"
END AS Level,
FORMAT_DATE('%b', File_Date) AS Month,
CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM File_Date) AS STRING),' ', CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%m', File_Date) AS STRING)) AS Period,
--D.SalesGrouping,
--D.DataSet,
SUM(CASE WHEN D.Dataset <> 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 AND  D.SalesGrouping = 'Direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_count,
SUM(CASE WHEN D.Dataset <> 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 AND D.SalesGrouping = 'Lead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lead_count,
SUM(CASE WHEN D.Dataset = 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_count,
SUM(CASE
               WHEN Dataset <> 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 AND SalesGrouping = 'Direct'
                   THEN D.Tech_Share_Amount
               ELSE 0 END)                                                                                   AS direct_value,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN Dataset <> 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 AND SalesGrouping = 'Lead'
                   THEN D.Tech_Share_Amount
               ELSE 0 END)                                                                                   AS lead_value,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN Dataset = 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 THEN D.Tech_Share_Amount
               ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_value,
SUM(D.Tech_Share_Amount) AS SalesTotal,
IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN Employment_Status_Code = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS IsTechActive,
IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN Employment_Status_Code = 'A' AND D.Dataset <> 'Cancels' AND D.Tech_Share_Amount <> 0 AND D.SalesGrouping IN ('Direct','Lead') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS IsTechContributing, 
IFNULL(MIN(CASE WHEN Employment_Status_Code = 'A' 
          AND (
                (D.SalesGrouping NOT IN ('Direct','Lead') OR IFNULL(D.SalesGrouping,'') = '') 
                    OR  (D.Dataset = 'Cancels') 
                    OR  (D.Tech_Share_Amount = 0)
              )
 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IsTechNOTContributing,
CASE 
  WHEN DATE_DIFF(File_Date,Continuous_Service_Date, DAY) > 365 
    THEN 2000 
    ELSE 850
END AS Technician_Goal,
B.operating_system_nm AS Eligibility_Status

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch` B

LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees_WorkdayHistory` AS E ON CASE WHEN LENGTH(E.Branch_Code) < 3 THEN LPAD(E.Branch_Code,3,'0') ELSE E.Branch_Code END = B.branch_num

LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_TAPSales_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw` AS D ON SAFE_CAST(E.Employee_ID AS STRING) = D.Tech_Employee_Num 
                                            AND                                              
                                              CONCAT(Reporting_Year ,' ', Reporting_Month) = CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM File_Date) AS STRING),' ', CAST(FORMAT_DATE('%b', File_Date) AS STRING))

WHERE 
  E.Function_Code IN ('205','215') 
  AND E.Employment_Status_Code IN ('A', 'L')
  -- AND File_Date >= '2025-01-01' (TAP sales already filtered to last year and later in source view)
  AND B.market_cd IN ('M530', 'M531','M532','M534','M535','M536','M537','M538','M539')
  -- AND D.SetupID = 33372528
  -- AND Employee_ID = 70026748 
  -- AND D.LocationCode = 136804505
  
GROUP BY
  Employee_ID,
  Employee_Name,
  Location_Code,
  B.region_cd,
  B.market_cd,
  Function_Code,
  Employment_Status_Code,
  E.Continuous_Service_Date,
  E.File_Date,
  --D.SalesGrouping,
  --D.DataSet,
  B.market_nm,
  B.Region_nm,
  B.branch_nm,
  B.branch_num,
  B.operating_system_nm

  ORDER BY File_Date, UPPER(Employee_Name)

WITH contact_cte AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Branch_Num ORDER BY createdtimestamp DESC) AS contact_rn
    FROM S3.Branch_Contact
),
market_cte AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Branch_Num ORDER BY createdtimestamp DESC) AS market_rn
    FROM S3.Branch_Market
),
status_cte AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Branch_Num ORDER BY createdtimestamp DESC) AS status_rn
    FROM S3.Branch_Status
),
latest_records AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.*,main.Field_Pest_Operations,main.RegionType,
        bm.BranchMarketCode, bm.BranchMarketName, bm.BranchRegionCode, bm.BranchRegionName,
        bm.BranchBrand, bm.ContractSystem, bm.BranchLOB,bm.BranchType,
        bs.HeritageOrg, bs.BranchStatus,
         bm.market_rn, bs.status_rn
    FROM S3.Branch main
    LEFT JOIN contact_cte bc ON bc.Branch_Num = main.Branch_Num
    LEFT JOIN market_cte bm ON bc.Branch_Num = bm.Branch_Num
    LEFT JOIN status_cte bs ON bc.Branch_Num = bs.Branch_Num
)
SELECT 
    BranchMarketCode AS market_cd,
    BranchMarketName AS market_nm,
    BranchRegionCode AS region_cd,
    BranchRegionName AS region_nm,
    Branch_Num AS branch_num,
    COA AS coa_branch_num,
    BranchName AS branch_nm,
    BranchType as branch_type,
    HeritageOrg AS heritage_org_cd,
    Field_Pest_Operations AS field_pest_operations_ind,
    BranchBrand AS brand_nm,
    ContractSystem AS operating_system_nm,
    BranchStatus AS branch_status_cd,
    BranchAddress1 AS branch_address_st1,
    BranchAddress2 AS branch_address_st2,
    BranchCity AS branch_city_nm,
    BranchState AS branch_state_cd,
    BranchZipCode AS branch_zip_cd,
    BranchPhoneNumber AS branch_phone_num,
    BranchEmailAddress AS branch_email_id,
    BranchManagerId AS branch_manager_num,
    BranchManager AS branch_manager_nm,
    RegionalDirectorId AS regional_manager_num,
    RegionalDirector AS regional_manager_nm,
    CASE 
        WHEN HeritageOrg = 'hRNA' THEN 'hRNA'  
        WHEN HeritageOrg = 'hTMX' AND ContractSystem = 'PestPac' THEN 'TMX: Migrated to PP'  
        WHEN HeritageOrg = 'hTMX' AND ContractSystem = 'Mission' THEN 'TMX: Not Migrated'  
        WHEN HeritageOrg = 'RTX'  THEN 'RTX: Re-branched'  
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS migration_status,
    BranchLOB as branch_lob_nm,
    RegionType as region_type
FROM latest_records
WHERE contact_rn = 1 AND market_rn = 1 AND status_rn = 1
order by cast(Branch_Num as int64)

dim.branch_zip_cd,  dim.branch_phone_num,dim.branch_email_id, dim.branch_manager_num, dim.branch_manager_nm,
dim.regional_manager_num, dim.regional_manager_nm,dim.migration_status, dim.branch_lob_nm, dim.region_type,

WITH
branch_contact AS (
    SELECT
        Branch_Num,
        createdtimestamp,
        BranchAddress1,
        BranchAddress2,
        BranchCity,
        BranchState,
        BranchZipCode,
        BranchPhoneNumber,
        BranchEmailAddress,
        BranchManagerId,
        BranchManager,
        RegionalDirectorId,
        RegionalDirector,
        COA,
        BranchName
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Branch_Contact`
),
branch_market AS (
    SELECT
        Branch_Num,
        createdtimestamp,
        BranchMarketCode,
        BranchMarketName,
        BranchRegionCode,
        BranchRegionName,
        ContractSystem,
        BranchType,
        BranchBrand,
        BranchLOB
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Branch_Market`
),
branch_status AS (
    SELECT
        Branch_Num,
        createdtimestamp,
        HeritageOrg,
        BranchStatus
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Branch_Status`
),

timeline AS (
    SELECT
        Branch_Num,
        MIN(createdtimestamp) AS start_date,  -- Preserve original timestamp
        change_ts,
        LEAD(change_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY Branch_Num ORDER BY change_ts) AS end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Branch_Num,
            createdtimestamp,
  TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300) AS change_ts
          FROM branch_contact
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            Branch_Num,
            createdtimestamp,
  TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300) AS change_ts
          FROM branch_market
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            Branch_Num,
            createdtimestamp,
  TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300) AS change_ts
          FROM branch_status
    )
    GROUP BY Branch_Num, change_ts
),

joined AS (
    SELECT
        t.Branch_Num,
        t.start_date,
        t.end_date,
        ARRAY_AGG(c ORDER BY c.createdtimestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS contact,
        ARRAY_AGG(m ORDER BY m.createdtimestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS market,
        ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY s.createdtimestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status
    FROM timeline t
    LEFT JOIN branch_contact c
        ON c.Branch_Num = t.Branch_Num
       AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(C.createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300)  = t.change_ts
    LEFT JOIN branch_market m
        ON m.Branch_Num = t.Branch_Num
       AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(m.createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300) = t.change_ts
    LEFT JOIN branch_status s
        ON s.Branch_Num = t.Branch_Num
       AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(s.createdtimestamp)), 300) * 300) = t.change_ts
    GROUP BY t.Branch_Num, t.start_date, t.end_date
)
SELECT
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchMarketCode IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.branchMarketCode end  AS market_cd,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchMarketName IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchMarketName end AS market_nm,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchRegionCode IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchRegionCode end  AS region_cd,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchRegionName IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchRegionName end AS region_nm,
    main.Branch_Num,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.COA IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.COA end  AS coa_branch_num,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchName IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchName end AS branch_nm,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchType IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchType end AS branch_type,
    case when status.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(status.HeritageOrg IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else status.HeritageOrg end AS heritage_org_cd,
    LAST_VALUE(main.Field_Pest_Operations IGNORE NULLS) OVER win AS field_pest_operations_ind,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchBrand IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchBrand end AS brand_nm,
   case when market.branch_num is null then  LAST_VALUE(market.ContractSystem IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.ContractSystem end AS operating_system_nm,
    case when status.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(status.BranchStatus IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else status.BranchStatus end AS branch_status_cd,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchAddress1 IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchAddress1 end AS branch_address_st1,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchAddress2 IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchAddress2 end  AS branch_address_st2,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchCity IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchCity end AS branch_city_nm,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchState IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchState end AS branch_state_cd,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchZipCode IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchZipCode end AS branch_zip_cd,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchPhoneNumber IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchPhoneNumber end AS branch_phone_num,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchEmailAddress IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchEmailAddress end AS branch_email_id,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchManagerId IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchManagerId end AS branch_manager_num,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.BranchManager IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.BranchManager end AS branch_manager_nm,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.RegionalDirectorId IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else  contact.RegionalDirectorId end AS regional_manager_num,
    case when contact.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(contact.RegionalDirector IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else contact.RegionalDirector end AS regional_manager_nm,
    CASE
        WHEN LAST_VALUE(status.HeritageOrg IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'hRNA' THEN 'hRNA'
        WHEN LAST_VALUE(status.HeritageOrg IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'hTMX'
             AND LAST_VALUE(market.ContractSystem IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'PestPac'
             THEN 'TMX: Migrated to PP'
        WHEN LAST_VALUE(status.HeritageOrg IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'hTMX'
             AND LAST_VALUE(market.ContractSystem IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'Mission'
             THEN 'TMX: Not Migrated'
        WHEN LAST_VALUE(status.HeritageOrg IGNORE NULLS) OVER win = 'RTX'
             THEN 'RTX: Re-branched'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS migration_status,
    case when market.branch_num is null then LAST_VALUE(market.BranchLOB IGNORE NULLS) OVER win else market.BranchLOB end AS branch_lob_nm,
    joined.start_date,
    joined.end_date,
    CASE
        WHEN joined.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END AS ind_flag
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Branch` main
LEFT JOIN joined
    ON main.Branch_Num = joined.Branch_Num
WINDOW win AS (
    PARTITION BY joined.Branch_Num ORDER BY joined.start_date
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)  
ORDER BY CAST(main.Branch_Num AS INT64), start_date

SELECT 
--lead_tracker source system uid vw
  l.rtx_lead_uid,
  l.src_system_attr_id_value AS lead_ID,
--lead_tracker source system uid vw to business map
  business,
  l.src_system_cre_date as received_date,
  l.src_system  as source_system,
 --lead_attributes
  case market_type when 'COM' then 'Commercial' when 'RES' then 'Residential' else market_type end as market_type,  
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Type_Mapped,lead_type) as lead_type,
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Source_Mapped,new_lead_source,lead_source) as lead_source, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_1, 
  coalesce(lsm.Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as lead_channel_2, 
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Name_Mapped,concat('Not Mapped - ',primary_pest)) as primary_pest,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Report_Group_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A') as primary_pest_report_group,
  coalesce(lppm.Pest_Type_1_Mapped,'Not Mapped - N/A ') as primary_pest_type_1, 
  lppm.Solution_Mapped as primary_pest_solution,
--lead_contact
  name as contact_name, 
  phone as contact_phone, 
  email as contact_email,
  address as contact_address, 
  city as contact_city, 
  state as contact_state, 
  postal_code as contact_zip_code,
--lead_field_assingment 
  upper(b.brand_nm) as brand,
  case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end as originating_branch,  
    case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end as assigned_branch,  
   case when assigned_branch is null then (case when length(originating_branch) > 3 then originating_branch  
   else lpad(originating_branch,3,'0') end ) else (case when length(assigned_branch) > 3 then assigned_branch  
   else lpad(assigned_branch,3,'0') end  ) end as report_branch,
   coalesce(lfa.sales_employee,lfa.assigned_employee) as assigned_employee_id,
 -- lfa.creating_employee as created_by_employee_code,
  coalesce(lcrm.Cancel_Reason_Mapped, concat('Not Mapped - ',cancel_reason)) as cancel_reason,  
--lead_field_assingment > Fact_RTX_Employees
  concat(lse.Last_Name,', ',lse.Preferred_First_Name) as sales_employee,
  lse.Employee_Number as sales_employee_id,
  coalesce(lae.Employee_Number,lfa.createdby_employee,lfa.creating_employee) as created_by_employee_id,
  lse.RTX_Branch_Code as sales_employee_branch,
  lse.Job_Family_Group as sales_employee_job_role,
  lae.RTX_Branch_Code as created_by_employee_branch,
  lae.Job_Family_Group as created_by_employee_job_role,   
--lead_inspections 
 li.scheduled_date,
  li.inspected_date,
--lead_proposals
  lp.eff_date as proposed_date,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then lpp.quantity else lp.quantity end as services_proposed,
  case when l.src_system = 'LPP' then lpp.service_amount else lp.service_amount end as value_proposed,
--lead_sales */
  ls.eff_date as sold_date,
  --'Not yet available' as start_date,
  ls.quantity as services_sold,
  ls.total_amount as value_sold_raw,
  ls.job_amount as sold_job_amount,
  ls.contract_amount as sold_contract_amount,
  ls.product_amount as sold_product_amount,
--lead_stales_link to contractstarted
  starts.value_sold_started,
  starts.started_contract_count,
--lead_stage_vw
  lstg.stage as lead_status,
--lead_status
  lstat.cancel_date,
  lstat.closed_lost_date,
  lstat.closed_won_date ,
--lead_stage
  lstag.contacts_stage_count,
  lstag.MQL_stage_count,
  lstag.SQL_stage_count,
  lstag.scheduled_stage_count,
  lstag.inspected_stage_count,
  lstag.proposed_stage_count,
  lstag.sold_stage_count,
  lstag.contacts_stage_date,
  l.src_system_cre_date as MQL_stage_date, --20250827 change for consistency between Vintage view and SALTI,
  lstag.SQL_stage_date,
  lstag.scheduled_stage_date,
  lstag.inspected_stage_date,
  lstag.proposed_stage_date,
  lstag.sold_stage_date,
--lead_status 
  case when lstat.cancel_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as canceled_count,
  case when lstat.closed_lost_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as closed_lost_count,
  case when lstat.closed_won_date is not null then 1 else 0 end as closed_won_count
FROM
  (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct rtx_lead_sid, src_system, src_system_attr_id, src_system_attr_id_value, upstream_src_system, upstream_src_system_attr_id, upstream_src_system_attr_id_value, src_system_cre_date from unnest (lead_source_system) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system` ) l 
   left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_business` lb on l.src_system = lb.Source_System
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct market_type,lead_type,lead_source,primary_pest from unnest (attributes) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes` ) la on l.rtx_lead_uid = la.rtx_lead_uid
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid, lead_source as new_lead_source from `bidata-sharedus-production.Playground.rtx_leads_tdw_attributes_new_version_202508_copy` qualify row_number() over (partition by rtx_lead_uid order by cre_date desc) = 1 ) tdw on l.rtx_lead_uid = tdw.rtx_lead_uid
left join (select `Key`,Lead_Source_Mapped,Lead_Channel_1_Mapped,Lead_Channel_2_Mapped,Lead_Type_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_lead_source`) lsm on upper(lsm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",coalesce(lead_type,""),"|",coalesce(new_lead_source,lead_source,"")))
  left join (select `Key`,Pest_Name_Mapped, Pest_Report_Group_Mapped, Pest_Type_1_Mapped, Solution_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_primary_pest`) lppm on upper(lppm.key) = concat(Mapping,"|",upper(primary_pest))
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct name, address, city, state, postal_code, phone, email from unnest (contact) order by cre_date desc limit 1).*
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_contact`  )lc on l.rtx_lead_uid = lc.rtx_lead_uid
  left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'sales_employee' then assignment_value end as sales_employee 
             from unnest (fields)  where assignment_type = 'sales_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'creating_employee' then assignment_value end as createdby_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'creating_employee' order by eff_date asc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as creating_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date asc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' then assignment_value end as assigned_employee 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_employee' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'originating_branch' then assignment_value end as originating_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'originating_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' then assignment_value end as assigned_branch 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'brand' then assignment_value end as brand 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'brand' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
             (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason 
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`
              ) lfa on l.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid
  left join   (select branch_num, brand_nm from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch`) b on lfa.assigned_branch = b.branch_num
  left join (select `Key`,Cancel_Reason_Mapped from `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_cancel_reason`) lcrm on upper(lcrm.key) = upper(concat(Mapping,"|",cancel_reason))
  left join (select Employee_Number,RTX_Branch_Code,Job_Family_Group,Last_Name, Preferred_First_Name from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`) lse on lfa.sales_employee = lse.Employee_Number
  left join (select Employee_Number,RTX_Branch_Code,Job_Family_Group from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_RTX_Employees`) lae on lfa.creating_employee = lae.Employee_Number
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when activity_type = 'Scheduled' then activity_date end as scheduled_date 
              from unnest (activities) where activity_type = 'Scheduled'  order by eff_date desc limit 1).* ,
              (select as struct case when activity_type = 'Inspected' then activity_date end as inspected_date 
              from unnest (activities) where activity_type = 'Inspected' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* ,
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_inspections`
              ) li on l.rtx_lead_uid = li.rtx_lead_uid 
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid, sum(quantity) as quantity,sum(service_amount) as service_amount,max(eff_date) as eff_date
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_proposals` group by rtx_lead_uid
             ) lp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lp.rtx_lead_uid 
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, service_amount, eff_date from unnest (proposals) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`  
  )           lpp on l.rtx_lead_uid = lpp.rtx_lead_uid --lpp take last record because proposals can be deleted in Winning Formula
left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct quantity, total_amount, job_amount, contract_amount, product_amount, eff_date from unnest (sales) order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_sales`  
  )           ls on l.rtx_lead_uid = ls.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join ( select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct stage from unnest (stage) order by stage_order desc,cre_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_stage`) lstg on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstg.rtx_lead_uid
 left join (select rtx_lead_uid,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Cancelled' then eff_date end as cancel_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Cancelled' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Lost' then eff_date end as closed_lost_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Lost' order by eff_date desc limit 1).*,
              (select as struct case when status = 'Closed Won' then eff_date end as closed_won_date
              from unnest (status) where status = 'Closed Won'order by eff_date desc limit 1).*
               from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_status`) lstat on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstat.rtx_lead_uid
left join    (select sl.rtx_lead_uid, sum(TotalValue) as value_sold_started, sum(ContractCount) as started_contract_count
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_sale_link` sl
              left join (select Contract, TotalValue, ContractCount from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_ContractStarted_Txn_Na_Daily_Dtl_Vw`
              )  ss on sl.sale_system_attr_id_value = ss.Contract
              group by sl.rtx_lead_uid) starts on l.rtx_lead_uid = starts.rtx_lead_uid
 left join (select
              rtx_lead_uid,
              sum(contacts_multiplier) as contacts_stage_count,
              sum(mql_multiplier) as mql_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) as sql_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(scheduled_multiplier) as scheduled_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(inspected_multiplier) as inspected_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(proposed_multiplier) as proposed_stage_count,
              sum(sql_multiplier) * max(sold_multiplier) as sold_stage_count,
              max(contacts_stage_date) as contacts_stage_date,
              max(mql_stage_date) as mql_stage_date,
              max(sql_stage_date) as sql_stage_date,
              max(scheduled_stage_date) as scheduled_stage_date,
              max(inspected_stage_date) as inspected_stage_date,
              max(proposed_stage_date) as proposed_stage_date,
              max(sold_stage_date) as sold_stage_date
              from (SELECT 
              s.rtx_lead_uid,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then 1 else 0 end as contacts_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then 1 else 0 end as mql_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' and cancel_reason is null then 1 else 0 end as sql_multiplier,--to exclude bad source
              case when stage = 'Scheduled' then 1 
              when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1
              else 0 end as scheduled_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Inspected' then 1
              when stage = 'Proposed' then 1
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as inspected_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Proposed' then 1 
              when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as proposed_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Sold' then 1 
              else 0 end as sold_multiplier,
              case when stage = 'Contacts' then min(eff_date) end as contacts_stage_date 
              ,case when stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as mql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead' then min(eff_date) end as sql_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Scheduled' then min(eff_date) end as scheduled_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Inspected' then min(eff_date) end as inspected_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Proposed' then min(eff_date) end as proposed_stage_date
              ,case when stage = 'Sold' then min(eff_date) end as sold_stage_date
              FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s
               left join (select rtx_lead_uid,  (select as struct case when assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' then assignment_value end as cancel_reason
             from unnest (fields) where assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' order by eff_date desc limit 1).* 
              from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment` )lfa on s.rtx_lead_uid = lfa.rtx_lead_uid and cancel_reason in ('Bad Sourcing','Bad data')  
              group by rtx_lead_uid,stage,cancel_reason) cte
              group by rtx_lead_uid) lstag on l.rtx_lead_uid = lstag.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
 TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(src_system_cre_date, DAY) >= timestamp(date_add(date_trunc(current_date()-1, year), interval -1 year)) --timestamp(date_add(current_date()-1, interval -2 month)) --TIMESTAMP("2023-01-01")

with job_split as (
select
yearmonth,
Branch,
product_grouping,
avg(amt) OVER (
        PARTITION BY Branch, product_grouping
        ORDER BY yearmonth
        RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_3_month_avg
from 
(SELECT 
safe_cast(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', date) as int64) as yearmonth,
coa_branch_num as Branch,
product_grouping,
SUM(Amount) amt

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.vw_daily_revenue` rev
left join bidata-sharedus-production.S4.dim_branch br on rev.Branch = br.branch_num

where service_type_code = 'Job' 
and rev_committed_ind = true
and safe_cast(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', date) as int64) <= safe_cast(Format_date('%Y%m', CURRENT_DATE()) as int64)


group by safe_cast(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', date) as int64),
Branch,
product_grouping

)),
product_group_total as (
select
yearmonth,
Branch,
sum(rolling_3_month_avg) OVER (
        PARTITION BY yearmonth,Branch
        ORDER BY product_grouping
    ) AS product_group_total

from job_split 
), split as(

select 
js.yearmonth,
js.Branch,
product_grouping,
rolling_3_month_avg,
product_group_total,
row_number() over (partition by js.yearmonth,
js.Branch,
product_grouping) as rn


from product_group_total pgt
join job_split js on pgt.Branch = js.Branch and pgt.yearmonth = js.yearmonth

), pct as(

select 
yearmonth,
Branch,
product_grouping,
ROUND(rolling_3_month_avg,2) as rolling_3_month_avg,
ROUND(product_group_total,2) as product_group_total,
case when product_group_total = 0 then 0 else round(rolling_3_month_avg/product_group_total,2) end as job_pct_split

from split

where rn = 2

), final as(

select 

*

from (
SELECT 
left(Branch,4) as coa_branch_cd,
concat(cast(Year as string),CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(CAST(Month AS STRING)) = 1 THEN LPAD(CAST(Month AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ELSE CAST(Month AS STRING)
  END) as yearmonth,
ifnull(ROUND(Job_Revenue * (select job_pct_split from pct where concat(cast(Year as string),CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(CAST(Month AS STRING)) = 1 THEN LPAD(CAST(Month AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ELSE CAST(Month AS STRING)
  END) = cast(pct.yearmonth as string) and cast(left(rev.Branch,4) as int64) = pct.Branch and product_grouping = 'Pest'),2),0) PC_Job_Rev,
ifnull(ROUND(Job_Revenue * (select job_pct_split from pct where concat(cast(Year as string),CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(CAST(Month AS STRING)) = 1 THEN LPAD(CAST(Month AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ELSE CAST(Month AS STRING)
  END) = cast(pct.yearmonth as string) and cast(left(rev.Branch,4) as int64) = pct.Branch and product_grouping = 'Termite'),2),0) TC_Job_Rev,
  ifnull(Job_Revenue,0) as Total_Job_Rev,
  ifnull(Contract_Revenue,0) as Total_Contract_Rev,
  ifnull(Product_Revenue,0) as Total_Product_Rev,
  ifnull(Other_Revenue,0) as Total_Other_Rev,
  ifnull(Total_Revenue,0) as Total_Revenue, 

FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.rev_objective rev

)

)
select 
coa_branch_cd,
yearmonth,
if((PC_Job_Rev = 0 or PC_Job_Rev is null) and (TC_Job_Rev = 0 or TC_Job_Rev is null),Total_Job_Rev,PC_Job_Rev) as PC_Job_Rev,
TC_Job_Rev,
Total_Job_Rev,
Total_Contract_Rev,
Total_Product_Rev,
Total_Other_Rev,
 Total_Revenue, 

from final

	l.locationcode,

	ss.setupid,
	fc.code freq_code,
	fc.description freq_desc ,
	fc.annualoccurrences,

		'1',
		'')) = 12 THEN 0
		ELSE LENGTH(replace(skipmonths,
		'1',
		''))
	END AS Skip,	
	--, ss.* ,  l.*

	ss.comment

	SELECT

  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Schedules sc

	ss.scheduleid = sc.scheduleid

  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.FrequencyClasses fc

	sc.frequencyid = fc.frequencyid

  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Schedules scb
ON
	ss.billingscheduleid = scb.scheduleid
LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.FrequencyClasses fcb

	),
actv AS

-- Created to pull the next scheduled date for contracts in the backlog
SELECT
  SOURCE,
  Contract,
  WorkOrder,             -- Pulls the Workorder based on the NextScheduledDate for a SOURCE|Contract
  NextScheduledDateTime, -- Pulls in the earliest ScheduledDate based on SOURCE|Contract. If all are NULL it'll pull the first NULL item
  ScheduledFlag          -- For RPP it will be marked N if no scheduled date or the time is missing. Time missing is more of a expected but not actually scheduled.
FROM 
  (
    SELECT
      SOURCE,
      Contract,
      WorkOrder,
      ScheduledDate AS NextScheduledDateTime, -- Renamed to provide more insight.Return the earliest scheduled date and time is in some of the rows
      ScheduledFlag,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SOURCE, Contract ORDER BY ScheduledDate) AS ScheduledDateRank,
      COUNT(ScheduledDate) OVER (PARTITION BY SOURCE, Contract) AS NonNullDateCount
    FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_unf_WorkOrder_Open_Dtl
    WHERE Contract IS NOT NULL AND ScheduledDate IS NOT NULL -- Added by Steven McCaffrey on 11/26/2024 to filter prior to the where clause to eliminate the nulls prior
  ) AS RankedScheduledDate
WHERE 
  ScheduledDateRank = 1 
  --AND (NextScheduledDateTime IS NOT NULL OR NonNullDateCount = 0) -- Removed by Steven McCaffrey on 11/26/2024 since we moved in the inner select above

--Order by i.ordernum

WITH ordered_salesContractgroup as (
 SELECT  
  'SS' 															as sTbl,
  'RPP' 														as source,    
  CASE WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('R') THEN 'C'
       WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('J') THEN 'J'
       WHEN LEFT(C.code,1) IN ('1','3') AND RIGHT(C.code,1) IN ('P') THEN 'P'
          ELSE ' ' END 											AS contract_Job_or_Product,
  ss.setuptype													AS `type`,  
  C.code														AS ServiceClass,
  r.code   														AS MarketCode, --Market Segment
  SB.code  														AS RegionCode,
  safe_cast(br.glsuffix as STRING) 								AS branchID,
  safe_cast(sbr.glsuffix AS STRING)               AS ServiceBranchID,
  l.zip															AS postalCode,
  l.state														AS state,
  CAST(ss.startdate AS DATE)                                    AS startDate,
  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE)	                                    AS `addDate`,
  ss.adduserid													AS adduserID,  
  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE)                                      AS orderDate,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE)	 	                                    AS workDate,
  ss.servicecode												AS serviceCode,
  ifnull(refservcode.product_grouping,'')						AS productGroup,
  s.description												    AS serviceDesc,
  "C"                                                           AS jobContract,
  e.employeeid 													AS employee_ID,
  SAFE_CAST(e.employeenum AS INT64)                             AS employeeNum,
  e.jobtitle													AS employeeJobTitle,
  e.username                                                    AS username,
  UPPER( CONCAT(e.lname,", ",e.fname))                          AS salesPerson,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS salesID,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                                           AS invoiceNum,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                    	                    AS orderNum,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS setupID,  
  l.locationid 													AS locationID,
  l.locationcode												AS locationCode,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.company)) > 0 THEN BT.company
    ELSE CONCAT(BT.lname,', ',BT.fname)
  END AS customer_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.phone)) = 12 THEN BT.phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.altphone)) = 12 THEN BT.altphone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.mobile)) = 12 THEN BT.mobile
  END AS customer_phone,  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added in heiracrchy of mobile, home and work
  BT.email AS customer_email,  
  CAST(ss.canceldate AS DATE)                                   AS cancelDate,
  ss.cancelreason                                               AS cancelReason,
  CASE WHEN ss.userdef19 != '' THEN 'Y' 
     ELSE 'N' END 												AS MigratedYN,
  ss.userdef19													AS MigratedValue,
  d.code                                                        AS division,  --MarketType
  ss.subtotal                                                   AS subtotal,
  IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0) AS ContractValue, -- Added 01/30/2024 renamed annualValue-->ContractValue

  --Added on 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue_calc,


  
  0 AS InitialValue,
  0 AS ExcessInitialValue,
  0 AS JobNonRecurringValue,
  1 as ContractCount,  
  0 AS ExcessInitialCount,
  0 AS JobRecurringCount , --InitialCount,
  0 AS JobNonRecurringCount,
  0 AS TotalJobCount,
  i.detaileddescription as firstCompleted_jobDesc,
  i.orderid as firstCompletedJob_orderID,
  i.ordernum as firstCompletedJob_orderNum,
  i.invoicedate as firstCompletedJob_invoiceDate,
  i.workdate as firstCompletedJob_workDate,
  i.invoicetype as firstCompletedJob_invoiceType,
  i.description as firstCompletedJob_jobDesc,
  CASE WHEN i.description LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS firstCompletedJob_ini_YN,
  so.orderid as nextOpen_orderID,
  so.ordernum as nextOpenJob_orderNum,
  so.orderdate as nextOpenJob_orderDate,
  sso.description as nextOpenJob_jobDesc,
  CASE WHEN sso.description LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN so.subtotal ELSE 0 END AS initialValueNextJob,
  CASE WHEN sso.description Not LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN so.subtotal ELSE 0 END AS subtotalOtherValueNextJob,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.setupid ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) , SAFE_CAST(so.orderdate AS DATE)) as rankValue ,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid3 AS INT64)								AS tech3_TechSoldID,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid4 AS INT64)								AS tech4_SalesPersonSoldID,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid5 AS INT64)								AS tech5_TechLeadID,  
  SAFE_CAST(leademp.employeeid AS STRING)                       AS lead_employee_id,
  l.phone,
  l.altphone
FROM
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.ServiceSetups ss

ON
  ss.servicecode = s.code
LEFT JOIN
  `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.Classes c
ON
  s.classid = c.classid
LEFT JOIN

  ss.LocationID = l.LocationID

LEFT JOIN

ON

LEFT JOIN `bidata-us-production`.S1_PP.BranchSubRegions SB
  ON br.subregionid = SB.subregionid
