SELECT 
	a.`SOURCE`, --tdw
	SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) as Contract,
	SAFE_CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) AS salesID ,
	a.MarketType as CustomerType,
	a.ServiceType,
	CASE
		WHEN a.ServiceType = 'C' THEN 'Contract (Recurring)'
		WHEN a.ServiceType = 'J' THEN 'Job'
		WHEN a.ServiceType = 'P' THEN 'Product'
	END AS ServiceType_Description,
	a.ProductCode,
	a.ProductGroup,
	SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) SellDate ,
	ifnull(cast(format_date('%Y%m', a.SellDate) as int64),0) as SellDateYearMonth ,
	ifnull(cast(format_date('%Y', a.SellDate) as int64),0) as SellDateYear ,
	SAFE_CAST(a.StartDate AS DATE) StartDate ,
	cast(format_date('%Y%m', a.StartDate) as int64) as StartDateYearMonth ,
	cast(format_date('%Y', a.StartDate) as int64) as StartDateYear ,
	SAFE_CAST(a.CancelDate AS DATE) CancelDate ,
	ifnull(cast(format_date('%Y%m', a.CancelDate) as int64),0) as CancelDateYearMonth ,
	ifnull(cast(format_date('%Y', a.CancelDate) as int64),0) as CancelDateYear ,
	a.cancel_reason_code CancelReasonCode,
	a.division_code_assigned as MarketCode,
	a.region_code_assigned as RegionCode,

  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedBranch) >= 3 THEN a.AssignedBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedBranchCode,
	CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(a.AssignedServiceBranch) >= 3 THEN a.AssignedServiceBranch
    ELSE LPAD(a.AssignedServiceBranch,3,'0')
  END AS AssignedServiceBranch,

	--a.AssignedBranch as AssignedBranchCode, --Commentted out to add the code above in order to add leading 0's
	a.`Geography` as Zip,
	a.State ,
	customer_name,-- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
	customer_phone, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
	customer_email, -- Added on 9/25/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to include some customer information
	ifnull(a.SalesPersonID, '') SalesPersonID,
	ifnull(a.SalesPerson, '') SalesPerson,
	ifnull(SAFE_CAST(a.SalesRole AS STRING), '') SalesRole,
	ifnull(a.SalesPersonJobTitle,'') SalesPersonJobTitle,
	ifnull(a.ContractValue,0) ContractValue,	
	ifnull(a.ContractValue,0) ContractValue_calc, --Added 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey. Added here for the UNION but the change was due to RPP Sales CV Calc
	ifnull(a.InitialValue,0) InitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
	ifnull(a.ExcessInitialValue,0) ExcessInitialValue, --Added 01/30/2024
	ifnull(a.JobNonRecurringValue,0) JobNonRecurringValue, --Added 01/30/2024
	ifnull(a.TotalJobValue,0) TotalJobValue,
	ifnull(a.TotalValue,0) TotalValue,	--Added 01/30/2024
	ifnull(a.TotalValue,0) TotalValue_calc,	--Added 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey. Added here for the UNION but the change was due to RPP Sales CV Calc
	ifnull(start_qty,0) AS start_qty,
  ifnull(a.BaseQty, 1) BaseQty,
	ContractCount,
    JobNonRecurringCount,
	ExcessInitialCount,
 	JobRecurringCount,--Initial count
    TotalJobCount ,
	TotalCount,
	a.StartedYN as StartedInd,	  
	case when a.StartedYN='Y' and a.Startdate >= a.SellDate then DATE_DIFF(a.StartDate, a.SellDate, DAY) else 0 end AS DaysToStart,        
	case when a.StartedYN <> 'Y' and a.CancelDate is not NULL and IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' then 'Y' else 'N' END AS RawCancelInd,
	case when a.StartedYN <> 'Y' and a.CancelDate is not NULL and IFNULL(a.cancel_reason_code,'') <> '' and a.CancelDate >= a.SellDate then DATE_DIFF(a.CancelDate , a.SellDate, DAY) else 0 END AS DaysToRawCancel,
	IndTAP_YN as TAPInd,
	TAPType,
	lead_employee_id ,
	SAFE_CAST('' AS STRING) as SetupOrderType ,
	SAFE_CAST(a.SalesEmployeeNumberRTX AS STRING) as SalesEmployeeNumberRTX,
	SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS	LocationID,     --Added by Steven McCaffrey to create hyperlink in Power-BI to PP. Needed to add a NULL here for the UNION Statement
	SAFE_CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS  LocationCode,    --Added by Steven McCaffrey to create hyperlink in Power-BI to PP. Needed to add a NULL here for the UNION Statement
	SAFE_CAST(SummerSalesIND AS STRING) AS SummerSalesIND,
	 CASE WHEN   
        SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
        OR 
        cast(format_date('%Y', a.SellDate) as int64) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE())
      THEN 'T'
      ELSE 'F'
  END AS LimitMTD_LY,
	'' AS OldSetupNum

FROM
	bidata-sharedus-production.Test.Mission_StartQty a
	where ifnull(cast(format_date('%Y', a.SellDate) as int64),0) >= ( extract(year from current_date())-3 )
			and SAFE_CAST(a.SellDate AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE()
	--WHERE Contract = 31895281 ;

        	and sum(initial_value_cv) > 0   
     		then sum(rawsale_amt) - sum(annual_value_cv) 
     	else 
        	sum(excess_initial_value_cv)
        end as ExcessInitialValue ,
	sum(spc_value_cv) JobNonRecurringValue , --Added 01/30/2024
	sum(initial_value_cv) + sum(spc_value_cv) TotalJobValue , -- Initial value + JobNonRecurringValue 
--	sum(annual_value_cv + excess_initial_value_cv + spc_value_cv) TotalValue , --Added 01/30/2024

    	when 
        (max(service_line1_short) = 'TC')
        	and sum(initial_value_cv) > 0   
     		then sum(annual_value_cv) + (sum(initial_value_cv) - sum(annual_value_cv)) + sum(spc_value_cv)
     	--when (max(service_line1_short) = 'PC')

        end as TotalValue ,

  ss.adduserid													AS adduserID,  
  CAST(ss.adddate AS DATE)                                      AS orderDate,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE)	 	                                    AS workDate,

  e.jobtitle													AS employeeJobTitle,
  e.username                                                    AS username,
  UPPER( CONCAT(e.lname,", ",e.fname))                          AS salesPerson,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS salesID,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                                           AS invoiceNum,
  CAST(NULL AS INT64)                    	                    AS orderNum,
  ss.setupid                                                    AS setupID,  
  l.locationid 													AS locationID,
  l.locationcode												AS locationCode,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.company)) > 0 THEN BT.company
    ELSE CONCAT(BT.lname,', ',BT.fname)
  END AS customer_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.phone)) = 12 THEN BT.phone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.altphone)) = 12 THEN BT.altphone
    WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(BT.mobile)) = 12 THEN BT.mobile
  END AS customer_phone,  -- This is to provide the customers phone number if added in heiracrchy of mobile, home and work
  BT.email AS customer_email,  
  CAST(ss.canceldate AS DATE)                                   AS cancelDate,
  ss.cancelreason                                               AS cancelReason,
  CASE WHEN ss.userdef19 != '' THEN 'Y' 
     ELSE 'N' END 												AS MigratedYN,
  ss.userdef19													AS MigratedValue,
  d.code                                                        AS division,  --MarketType
  ss.subtotal                                                   AS subtotal,
  IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0) AS ContractValue, -- Added 01/30/2024 renamed annualValue-->ContractValue

  --Added on 10/31/2024 by Steven McCaffrey to fix the ContractValue calculation 
  CASE 
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * ss.subtotal --260 due to business days
    WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * ss.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
    WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
    WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * ss.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
    WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN ss.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
    WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * ss.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
  ELSE IFNULL(PtActDly.CurrentTotal,0)
  END AS ContractValue_calc,


  
  0 AS InitialValue,
  0 AS ExcessInitialValue,
  0 AS JobNonRecurringValue,
  1 as ContractCount,  
  0 AS ExcessInitialCount,
  0 AS JobRecurringCount , --InitialCount,

  CASE WHEN sso.description Not LIKE '%INITIAL%' THEN so.subtotal ELSE 0 END AS subtotalOtherValueNextJob,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.setupid ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(i.invoicedate AS DATE) , SAFE_CAST(so.orderdate AS DATE)) as rankValue ,
  SAFE_CAST(ss.techid3 AS INT64)								AS tech3_TechSoldID,

C.customer_name,
C.setupID,
C.locationCode,
C.division,
C.startDate,

freq_code,
annualoccurrences,
Skip,
CASE 
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260  --260 due to business days
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * 5  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
  WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * 2 -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
  WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN 1 -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
ELSE annualoccurrences
END AS annualoccurences_calc,

V.subtotal,
annualvalue,

CASE 
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * C.subtotal --260 due to business days
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * C.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
  WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * C.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
  WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN C.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
  WHEN UPPER(TRIM(freq_code)) IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * C.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
ELSE 0
END AS annualvalue_calc,

CASE 
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip = 0 THEN 260 * C.subtotal --260 due to business days
  WHEN freq_code = '1X DAILY' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 5) * C.subtotal  --Skip contains number of active months * 5 for business days
  WHEN freq_code = '2X A MONTH' AND Skip > 0 THEN (Skip * 2) * C.subtotal -- Reason is that when skip <> 0 it just takes that * subtotal. Since twice a month it needs to multiple that skip by 2.
  WHEN freq_code = 'MONTHLY' AND Skip > 0 THEN Skip * C.subtotal -- Reason is that you want to calcualte off of the Skip Months
  WHEN freq_code = 'ANNUAL' AND Skip <> 0 THEN C.subtotal -- ANNUAL is still annual which means once. Even when there are skip months > 0 
  WHEN freq_code IN ('ANNUAL','2X A MONTH','BIMONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY', 'SEMIANNUAL', 'TRIANNUAL','MONTHLY') AND Skip = 0  THEN V.annualoccurrences * C.subtotal -- These are accurate in terms when there are no skip months. It's another story when there are skip months.
ELSE C.ContractValue
END AS annualvalue_calc_w_CV,

V.bF_annualoccurrences,
V.billingamount,
C.ContractValue,

CASE
WHEN freq_code IS NULL THEN 'No Schedule Indicated' 
WHEN Skip <> 0 AND freq_code NOT IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'Skip Months Review'

WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'ContractValue(Billing)'
WHEN Skip <> 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'ContractValue(Billing)'
END AS Issue_Bucket_Category,

CASE 
WHEN freq_code IS NULL THEN 'No Schedule Indicated'

CASE WHEN ROUND(C.ContractValue,0) - ROUND (V.annualvalue,0) <> 0 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS IsInErrorFile

WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('2X A MONTH','ANNUAL','BIMONTHLY','QUARTERLY','TRIANNUAL','WEEKLY','SEMIANNUAL') THEN 'ContractValue(Billing)'
WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'ContractValue(Billing)'
WHEN Skip <> 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'ContractValue(Billing)'
END AS Issue_Bucket_Category,

CASE 
WHEN freq_code IS NULL THEN 'No Schedule Indicated' 
WHEN Skip <> 0 AND freq_code NOT IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'Skip months is out of balance with the true number of occurences per year. Look at PP Schedule Months and the Skipped months and the occurences is different than the provided Skip provided.' 
WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('1X DAILY','BIWEEKLY','OTHER','QUARTERLY') THEN 'Issue with the Annual Occurrences. Please review in PP the accual occurances to what is displayed'
WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('2X A MONTH','ANNUAL','BIMONTHLY','QUARTERLY','TRIANNUAL','WEEKLY','SEMIANNUAL') THEN 'Issue seems to be with the Contract(Billing) and not calculating the occurances correctly'
WHEN Skip = 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'Seems that the calculation for annualvalue is accurate in that it is subtotal*monthly(12). ContractValue(Billing) typically adds a 13th payment in most cases. '
WHEN Skip <> 0 AND freq_code IN ('MONTHLY') THEN 'Seems that the calculation for annualvalue is accurate in that it is subtotal*skip. ContractValue(Billing) typically adds a payment in most cases'
END Issue_Bucket_Desc,

SELECT
  SOURCE,
  Contract,
  WorkOrder,             -- Pulls the Workorder based on the NextScheduledDate for a SOURCE|Contract
  NextScheduledDateTime, -- Pulls in the earliest ScheduledDate based on SOURCE|Contract. If all are NULL it'll pull the first NULL item
  ScheduledFlag          -- For RPP it will be marked N if no scheduled date or the time is missing. Time missing is more of a expected but not actually scheduled.
FROM 
  (
    SELECT
      SOURCE,
      Contract,
      WorkOrder,
      ScheduledDate AS NextScheduledDateTime, -- Renamed to provide more insight.Return the earliest scheduled date and time is in some of the rows
      ScheduledFlag,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SOURCE, Contract ORDER BY ScheduledDate) AS ScheduledDateRank,
      COUNT(ScheduledDate) OVER (PARTITION BY SOURCE, Contract) AS NonNullDateCount
    FROM bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_unf_WorkOrder_Open_Dtl
    WHERE Contract IS NOT NULL AND ScheduledDate IS NOT NULL
  ) AS RankedScheduledDate
WHERE 
  ScheduledDateRank = 1 
  --(NextScheduledDateTime IS NOT NULL OR NonNullDateCount = 0)

SELECT *
FROM bidata-sharedus-production.W3_Contract_Checker.T0_unf_Contract_All
WHERE CustomerType IN ('COM', 'NAT')
  AND (
    -- Case 1: ServiceType = 'C'
    (ServiceType = 'C' AND
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING)) < DATE('2024-04-01') AND
      (
        SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING)) > DATE('2023-06-01') OR
        CancelDateYearMonth IS NULL OR
        CancelDateYearMonth = 0
      )
    )
    OR
    -- Case 2: ServiceType ≠ 'C'
    (ServiceType != 'C' AND
      SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING)) BETWEEN DATE('2023-06-01') AND DATE('2024-04-01')
    )
  );

SELECT 
  *,
  
  -- Create transformed sell/start date
  CASE 
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING)) < DATE('2023-06-01') 
    THEN DATE('2023-06-01')
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS SellDateYearMonthTF,

  -- Create transformed cancel/end date
  CASE 
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' AND (CancelDateYearMonth IS NULL OR CancelDateYearMonth = 0 OR SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING)) > DATE('2024-04-01')) 
    THEN DATE('2024-04-01')
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' THEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS CancelDateYearMonthTF,

  -- Months active for ServiceType = C
  CASE 
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' THEN 
      DATE_DIFF(
        CASE 
          WHEN (CancelDateYearMonth IS NULL OR CancelDateYearMonth = 0 OR SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING)) > DATE('2024-04-01'))
          THEN DATE('2024-04-01')
          ELSE SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING))
        END,
        CASE 
          WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING)) < DATE('2023-06-01') 
          THEN DATE('2023-06-01')
          ELSE SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING))
        END,
        MONTH
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS MonthsActiveContract,

  -- Prorated contract value
  CASE 
    WHEN ServiceType = 'C' THEN 
      (DATE_DIFF(
        CASE 
          WHEN (CancelDateYearMonth IS NULL OR CancelDateYearMonth = 0 OR SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING)) > DATE('2024-04-01'))
          THEN DATE('2024-04-01')
          ELSE SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(CancelDateYearMonth AS STRING))
        END,
        CASE 
          WHEN SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING)) < DATE('2023-06-01') 
          THEN DATE('2023-06-01')
          ELSE SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', CAST(SellDateYearMonth AS STRING))
        END,
        MONTH
      ) / 12.0) * Contract_Value_V3
    ELSE NULL
  END AS Contract_Value_Prorated

FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.W3_Contract_Checker.T1_ContractsActiveInYear_Job_INI_DuringYear`;

SELECT 
  Contract,
  SUM(IFNULL(Contract_Value_Prorated, 0)) AS Total_Contract_Value_Prorated,
  SUM(IFNULL(Job_NonRecurring_Value_V3, 0)) AS Total_Job_NonRecurring_Value_V3,
  SUM(IFNULL(Job_Ini_Value_V3, 0)) AS Total_Job_Ini_Value_V3,
  SUM(
    IFNULL(Contract_Value_Prorated, 0) + 
    IFNULL(Job_NonRecurring_Value_V3, 0) + 
    IFNULL(Job_Ini_Value_V3, 0)
  ) AS Total_Contract_Value_All
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.W3_Contract_Checker.T2_ContractsProRated_TimeFrame`
WHERE Contract IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Contract
ORDER BY Total_Contract_Value_All DESC;

SELECT 
  SUM(Total_Contract_Value_All) AS Sum_Contract_Value,
  SUM(Total_WorkOrderAmount) AS Sum_WorkOrder_Amount
FROM (
  SELECT 
    a.Contract,
    a.Total_Contract_Value_All,
    b.Total_WorkOrderAmount,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(b.Total_WorkOrderAmount - a.Total_Contract_Value_All, a.Total_Contract_Value_All) * 100 AS Percent_Difference
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.W3_Contract_Checker.T3_GroupedByContract` a
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.New_W3_WorkOrderTaxonomy.HALFTIER5_ContractBasedGrouping` b
  ON CAST(a.Contract AS STRING) = CAST(b.Contract AS STRING)
);

  FirstEndDate AS LatestPriceDate,
  FirstSource AS SourceLP,
  FirstUniqueCustomerID AS UniqueCustomerIDLP,
  FirstBranchID AS BranchIDLP,
  FirstMarketType AS MarketTypeLP,

  CASE
    WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdAmount
    ELSE SecondAmount
  END AS InitialPrice,

  CASE
    WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdEndDate
    ELSE SecondEndDate
  END AS InitialPriceDate,

  CASE
    WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdSource
    ELSE SecondSource
  END AS SourceIP,

    WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdUniqueCustomerID
    ELSE SecondUniqueCustomerID
  END AS UniqueCustomerIDIP,

    ELSE SecondBranchID
  END AS BranchIDIP,

    WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdMarketType
    ELSE SecondMarketType
  END AS MarketTypeIP,

  SAFE_MULTIPLY(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      FirstAmount - (
        CASE
          WHEN FirstAmount = SecondAmount AND FirstEndDate <> SecondEndDate THEN ThirdAmount
          ELSE SecondAmount
        END
      ),
      CASE

SELECT "RPP" as Source
      ,(case when regexp_contains(CAST(bu.glsuffix as string), r'^[^A-Za-z]*([A-Za-z])[^A-Za-z]*([A-Za-z]).*') = true then cast(bu.branchid as string)
             when length(bu.glsuffix) = 4 then lpad(CAST(bu.glsuffix AS string), 4,'0') 
                  else lpad(CAST(bu.glsuffix AS string), 3,'0') end) as BranchID --changed to account for 4000 series branch Dan Carpenter 4/1/2025
      ,so.setupid as Contract
      ,so.ordernum as WorkOrder
      ,case
            when lo.divisionid = 163 then 'RES'
            when lo.divisionid = 160 then 'COM'
            when lo.divisionid = 162 then 'NAT'
            else 'RES' end as MarketType
      ,so.originalworkdate as DueDate
      ,so.workdate as ScheduledDate

      ,so.techid1 as AssignedTech
      ,Case
            when emp.lname = 'HOUSE' then null 
            when emp.lname <> 'HOUSE' then concat(emp.lname, ',', emp.fname) 
            when so.techid1 = 7615 then 'CALLAHAN, ANTHONY'
            else null
            end as TechName
      ,IF(so.posted = True, so.workdate, null) as EndDate
      ,CASE 
            WHEN so.posted = False THEN 'Open'
            else
      CASE 
	      When so.postingnsreason is null then 'Completed'
            else 'Canceled'       
            END END as Status   
      ,if(so.posted = False and so.postingnsreason is not null, so.workdate, null) as CancelDate   
      ,' ' as CancelReasonCode
      ,' ' as CancelReasonDescription                                  
      ,so.total as WorkOrderAmount
      ,rte.code as ServiceRouteCode     
      ,Case
            when emp2.lname = 'HOUSE' then null 
            when emp2.lname <> 'HOUSE' then concat(emp2.lname, ',', emp2.fname) 
            when so.techid1 = 7615 then 'CALLAHAN, ANTHONY'
            else null
            end as AssignedTechName 
      ,RTRIM(so.servicecode) as ProductKey  
      ,pm.product_grouping
      ,'' service_line2
      ,'' service_line3
      ,CASE 
            WHEN so.ordertype = 'CB' THEN 'XTR'
            else
            if(sv.description LIKE '%INITIAL%', 'INI', 'REG')

SELECT DISTINCT 
  CONCAT(UniqueCustomerID,'_',Source) AS UniqueCustomerID_Source,

  -- We detect if a row is anomalous
  CASE
    WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration > 6 AND w.ActualDuration < 10
      AND w.ServiceType IN ('REG', 'XTR', 'ODR', 'SPC', 'INI', 'REI', 'ODM')) THEN 'Y'
    WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration < 1
      AND w.ActualDuration > (w.PlannedDuration * 12) AND w.ActualDuration > 60
      AND w.ServiceType IN ('REG', 'XTR', 'ODR', 'SPC', 'INI', 'REI', 'ODM')) THEN 'Y'
    WHEN w.ActualDuration = 0 THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS Anomaly,

  -- We create the ActualDuration_V2 when we don't have confidence we can use the ScheduledDuration
  CASE
    WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration > 6 AND w.ActualDuration < 10
      AND w.ServiceType IN ('REG', 'XTR', 'ODR', 'SPC', 'INI', 'REI', 'ODM')) THEN w.PlannedDuration
    WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration < 1
      AND w.ActualDuration > (w.PlannedDuration * 12) AND w.ActualDuration > 60
      AND w.ServiceType IN ('REG', 'XTR', 'ODR', 'SPC', 'INI', 'REI', 'ODM')) THEN w.PlannedDuration
    WHEN w.ActualDuration = 0 THEN w.PlannedDuration
    ELSE w.ActualDuration
  END AS ActualDuration_v2,

  -- We use MajorAnomaly to see where a row is anomalous EVEN WHEN we use PlannedDuration as the time
    CASE
      WHEN (
        -- Only run major anomaly logic if row is already an Anomaly
        (
          (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration > 6 AND w.ActualDuration < 10)
          OR (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration < 1
              AND w.ActualDuration > (w.PlannedDuration * 12) AND w.ActualDuration > 60)
          OR (w.ActualDuration = 0)
        )
        AND (
          (w.WorkOrderAmount / 
            CASE
              WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration > 6 AND w.ActualDuration < 10) THEN w.PlannedDuration
              WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration < 1
                AND w.ActualDuration > (w.PlannedDuration * 12) AND w.ActualDuration > 60) THEN w.PlannedDuration
              WHEN w.ActualDuration = 0 THEN w.PlannedDuration
              ELSE w.ActualDuration
            END
          ) > 6
          OR
          (w.WorkOrderAmount / 
            CASE
              WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration > 6 AND w.ActualDuration < 10) THEN w.PlannedDuration
              WHEN (w.ActualDuration > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount > 0 AND w.WorkOrderAmount / w.ActualDuration < 1
                AND w.ActualDuration > (w.PlannedDuration * 12) AND w.ActualDuration > 60) THEN w.PlannedDuration
              WHEN w.ActualDuration = 0 THEN w.PlannedDuration
              ELSE w.ActualDuration
            END
          ) < 1
        )
      )
      THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS MajorAnomaly,

  *

  SELECT

    LAG(TotalContractValue) OVER (
      PARTITION BY Contract, UniqueCustomerID, BranchID, Source
      ORDER BY MonthYear ASC

    -- Explicitly using the current month's MonthYear directly:
